The coast and the wooded interior belong to a region inhabited by indigenous communities long before Spanish rule reached the island, and their languages remain part of the area's history.
simp_chinese: 欣戈奥格位于棉兰老岛北岸，同名海湾的岸边向内陆逐渐升高。这个地名也写作金戈奥格，源自一个与好运有关的马诺博语词汇。早在西班牙统治抵达棉兰老之前，原住民社群就在这片海岸与林木覆盖的内陆居住，他们的语言至今仍是当地历史的一部分。

english: Hınıs lies on a fertile, undulating plain among the mountains north of Muş. Known in Armenian as Khnus, the district supported farming villages as well as the fortified town. It came under Ottoman rule during Süleyman's Persian campaign, and became a frontier sancak of Erzurum. A register of 1642 records the castle buildings in disrepair and grants them to officials on condition that they restore them; Armenian and Muslim taxpayers lived throughout the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 赫尼斯坐落在穆什以北群山之间起伏而肥沃的平原上，亚美尼亚语称克努斯。除了设防城镇，地区内还有耕作村庄。在苏莱曼的波斯战役期间，赫尼斯归入奥斯曼帝国，成为埃尔祖鲁姆的边疆桑贾克。1642年的登记册记载城堡建筑失修，将其交给官员并要求修复；周围地区则有亚美尼亚人和穆斯林纳税者居住。

english: Hino occupies the wooded upper valley of the Hino River in the mountains of Hōki. Its streams and hills yielded iron sand, while the forests supplied charcoal for the traditional tatara furnaces. The local steel known as Inga-hagane was prized for making blades. During the Edo period, washing hillsides to extract iron sand sent large quantities of sediment down the river, helping extend the shoreline near its mouth.
simp_chinese: 日野位于伯耆山地的日野川上游，河谷森林茂密。溪流与山坡出产铁砂，树林则为传统踏鞴炉提供木炭。当地钢材以“印贺钢”之名受到制刀匠重视。江户时代，人们冲洗山坡采集铁砂，大量泥沙随河而下，使河口附近的海岸线向海推进。

english: Hinomisaki projects into the Sea of Japan at the western end of the Shimane Peninsula. Its indented rocky coast faces the setting sun, and a shrine here has long been associated with the protection of the night. Just offshore lies Fumishima, a sacred island whose columnar rock resembles a stack of scrolls. Black-tailed gulls gather there to breed, filling the air above the waves.
simp_chinese: 日御碕从岛根半岛西端伸入日本海，曲折岩岸面向落日，当地神社自古与守护夜晚的信仰相联系。近海的经岛是神圣之地，柱状岩石有如层叠的经卷。黑尾鸥聚集在岛上繁殖，飞翔于波涛之上。

english: Hinono'ei is an Arapaho word for an Arapaho person. The Arapaho ranged across the northern plains and the country east of the Rocky Mountains, hunting bison and maintaining ties with other peoples. Before horses became available, dogs pulled travois carrying household goods. Horses acquired through Indigenous networks in the eighteenth century enabled families to travel farther and carry heavier loads. By 1806 the Arapaho had formed an alliance with the Cheyenne, strengthening their position among the peoples of the plains.
simp_chinese: 希诺诺埃是阿拉帕霍语中对阿拉帕霍人的称呼。阿拉帕霍人活动于北方平原和落基山脉以东地区，猎取野牛，并与其他民族保持联系。得到马匹之前，他们用狗拖曳搬运架运送家当。十八世纪经原住民网络获得马匹后，家庭能够走得更远、携带更重的物资。到1806年，阿拉帕霍人与夏延人结盟，增强了他们在平原诸民族中的地位。

english: The Hinsepu were a Nez Perce group associated with the Grande Ronde River, one of the waterways of the Nimíipuu homeland. Their wider country stretched across river valleys and uplands between the Blue and Bitterroot mountains. At Weippe Prairie, Nez Perce families gathered camas roots; in 1805 they met members of the Lewis and Clark expedition after the travelers crossed the Bitterroots.
simp_chinese: 欣塞普是与大龙德河相关的内兹佩尔塞人群体，这条河是尼米普人家园中的水道之一。他们更广阔的土地横跨蓝山与比特鲁特山脉之间的河谷和高地。在韦佩草原，内兹佩尔塞人的家庭采集卡马斯根茎；1805年，他们在此遇见穿越比特鲁特山的刘易斯与克拉克探险队成员。

english: Hinthada lies on the Irrawaddy in the northern delta of Lower Burma. Here the great river leaves the narrower country upstream and enters a plain of branching waterways and seasonal floods. The surrounding district once belonged to the Mon kingdom of Pegu before being incorporated into the Burmese kingdom in the eighteenth century. River traffic connected the settlement with Prome to the north and the ports and villages of the delta downstream.
simp_chinese: 兴实塔位于下缅甸三角洲北部的伊洛瓦底江畔。大河在这里离开上游较狭窄的地带，进入支流分散、季节性洪水频繁的平原。周围地区曾属于勃固的孟人王国，十八世纪被纳入缅甸王国。江上交通将这处聚落与北面的卑谬以及下游三角洲的港口和村落连接起来。

english: Hinyaa Kwáan is a Tlingit community of the Prince of Wales Island country, where salmon streams flow through forest to the island’s many bays. Families spent part of the year together in winter villages and travelled to fishing and gathering places in other seasons. The rivers and lakes of the island supported important sockeye runs; people built fishing structures in tidal waters to guide and catch returning salmon. Tuxekan was one of the Hinyaa villages on the island’s northern shore.
simp_chinese: 欣亚宽是威尔士亲王岛一带的特林吉特社群。鲑鱼溪流穿过森林，汇入岛上众多海湾。家庭在一年中的部分时间聚居于越冬村庄，其他季节则前往渔场和采集地。岛上河流与湖泊有重要的红鲑洄游，人们在潮间水域建造渔具，引导并捕捉回游的鱼群。图克塞坎是岛屿北岸的欣亚村庄之一。

sources.title: 299389135 Traditional Knowledge and Harvesting of Salmon by HUNA and HINYAA LINGIT FIS Final Report 02-104 Anchorage US Department of Interior Fish and Wildlife Service Office of Subsistence Management

english: Hinyankaga is a recorded name for the Moreau River, also known as the Owl River. It flows across the northern Plains from its western forks to the Missouri, collecting tributaries along a broad valley. In 1804 members of the Lewis and Clark expedition passed the river while traveling toward Arikara communities upstream. Their journals preserve several names and spellings for this Missouri tributary.
simp_chinese: 欣扬卡加是莫罗河的一个记载名称，河流也称为猫头鹰河。它从西方的源头支流流出，穿越北部平原，在宽阔河谷中汇集溪流，最终注入密苏里河。1804年，刘易斯与克拉克探险队前往上游的阿里卡拉社群时经过此河，他们的日记保存了这条支流的多个名称和拼写。

english: Hipalán was one of the indigenous territories of La Gomera in the Canary Islands. Historical accounts place it around the eastern part of the island, in the area of San Sebastián. Early writers described La Gomera as divided into four territories, each with its own leader; they named Pedro Halhagal as the leader of Hipalán. The island came under the authority of Castilian lords during the fifteenth century, transforming the lives of its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 伊帕兰是加那利群岛中拉戈梅拉岛的原住民领地之一。历史记载将其置于岛屿东部、圣塞瓦斯蒂安一带。早期史家称拉戈梅拉分为四个各有首领的地区，并记载伊帕兰的首领名叫佩德罗·阿尔阿加尔。十五世纪，岛屿落入卡斯蒂利亚领主统治之下，居民的生活随之改变。

english:
Hiraka lay in southern Tsugaru, on routes entering the plain from Kazuno and Hinai. Daikōji Castle occupied a slight rise beside the Rokuga River, giving this district a fortified centre at the inland gateway. By the 1530s it appears to have come under Nanbu control; a regional list compiled around 1546 associates Hiraka with a Nanbu lord at Daikōji.

Around 1574–1576, Ōura Tamenobu attacked the castle twice, and its commander Takimoto Shigeyuki is said to have withdrawn toward Nanbu territory. The struggles belonged to Tamenobu's consolidation of Tsugaru. He placed his son-in-law Takehiro at Daikōji in 1599, but a succession dispute led to Takehiro's expulsion in 1609. In 1610 the castle was dismantled as work proceeded on Hirosaki Castle, with its materials reused in the new construction. Hiraka's former stronghold thus supplied part of the fabric of the domain's new political centre.
simp_chinese:
平贺位于津轻南部，是鹿角、比内通往津轻平原的内陆门户。大光寺城坐落于六羽川旁略高的地面，为这一交通要地提供设防中心。到十六世纪三十年代，城堡似已归南部氏控制；约1546年编成的地方名录，将平贺与大光寺的南部氏领主相联系。

约1574至1576年，大浦为信两次进攻大光寺城，城代泷本重行据说撤往南部领地。这些争夺属于为信整合津轻势力的过程。1599年，他将女婿建广安置于此，建广又因继承纷争于1609年遭放逐。1610年，弘前城营建之际，大光寺城被拆除，建筑材料转用于新城。平贺旧日据点的一部分，由此成为藩政新中心的实体构材。

english: Hirakubo Cape forms the northern tip of Ishigaki Island, at the end of a long peninsula. Coral reefs spread beneath the surrounding waters, where the Pacific lies to the east and the East China Sea to the west. The cape stands apart from the island's southern settlements, with the sea on either side and the ridges of Ishigaki stretching away behind it.
simp_chinese: 平久保崎位于石垣岛最北端，是狭长半岛的尽头。周围海底分布着珊瑚礁，东侧是太平洋，西侧是东海。岬角远离岛屿南部的聚落，两侧皆为海水，身后则是向远方延伸的石垣山岭。

english: Hirmata was a market in the Gibe country of southwestern Ethiopia, at the site that grew into Jimma. Its position on the caravan route between Shewa and Kaffa helped draw traders from many regions. In the early nineteenth century Amhara, Oromo and people from the lake country and the southern kingdoms came to exchange goods here. The growing kingdom of Jimma made the market an important centre of its commercial life.
simp_chinese: 希尔马塔是埃塞俄比亚西南吉贝地区的一处市场，后来发展成吉马。它位于绍阿与卡法之间的商队路线上，吸引各地商人前来。十九世纪初，阿姆哈拉人、奥罗莫人以及来自湖区和南方诸王国的人们在此交换货物。随着吉马王国成长，这座市场成为其商业生活的重要中心。

english: Hiroo lies on the Pacific coast of Tokachi, between the Hidaka mountains and the sea. Known as Biro in early records, it became a base for the Matsumae domain's trade with the Tokachi Ainu during the seventeenth century. Its harbor grew more important in the late eighteenth century as northern defense attracted official attention and kelp fetched higher prices. Marine products and other goods passed through the trading district connecting this coast with southern Ezo.
simp_chinese: 广尾位于十胜的太平洋海岸，夹在日高山脉与大海之间。早期记载称此地为“比罗”，十七世纪这里成为松前藩与十胜阿伊努人交易的据点。十八世纪后期，随着北方防务受到重视、昆布价格上涨，港口的重要性进一步增加。海产及其他货物经此交易场所流通，将海岸与虾夷地南部连接起来。

english:
Hirson lay in the wooded country of Thiérache, within the lands of the dukes of Guise. Its castle and mills stood in a frontier region exposed to repeated warfare. The castle chapel was attached to the nearby abbey of Saint-Michel, which also held a share of the mill. The town's old mill, recorded in the twelfth century, ground grain and later included facilities for pressing oil and fulling cloth.

Spanish forces besieged Hirson's castle in 1636, and Turenne retook it the following year. Another Spanish siege in 1650 left the castle almost entirely destroyed, and it was never rebuilt. The mills were also ruined; in 1653 the miller and carpenter Antoine de Landouzy rebuilt them, using stone from the remains of the fortress.
simp_chinese:
伊尔松位于蒂耶拉什的林地中，属于吉斯公爵的领地。城堡和磨坊所在的边疆屡受战争侵扰。城堡礼拜堂隶属于附近的圣米歇尔修道院，后者也拥有磨坊的一部分权益。镇上的旧磨坊早在十二世纪便有记载，除磨制谷物外，后来还设有榨油和缩绒设施。

1636年，西班牙军队围攻伊尔松城堡，蒂雷纳于次年将其收复。1650年西班牙军队再次围攻，城堡几乎被彻底摧毁，此后没有重建。磨坊也遭毁坏；1653年，磨坊主兼木匠安托万·德·朗杜齐利用堡垒废墟的石料将其重建。

english:
Hisar was founded in 1354 by Firuz Shah Tughlaq, Sultan of Delhi, as Hisar-e-Firoza, the Fort of Firuz. Its walls enclosed a palace complex with halls, a mosque and underground chambers, while four gates opened onto the surrounding plain. The sultan also built the Gujri Mahal near his palace. Hisar became a center of authority on the western approaches to Delhi, but its fort was burned by Timur's soldiers during his invasion in 1398.

Babur rewarded his son Humayun with Hisar after a successful campaign against Ibrahim Lodi. Sher Shah Suri took it in 1540, and Humayun recovered it in 1555 before assigning it to Akbar. In 1798 the Irish soldier George Thomas occupied Hisar as part of a territory ruled from Hansi; he was driven out in 1801. The East India Company's authority reached the region in 1803, and Hisar later replaced Hansi as the district headquarters in 1832.
simp_chinese:
希萨尔由德里苏丹菲鲁兹·沙·图格鲁克于1354年创建，原名希萨尔－菲鲁扎，意为“菲鲁兹之堡”。城墙内的宫殿建筑群有殿堂、清真寺和地下房间，四座城门通向周围平原。苏丹还在宫殿附近修建了古杰里宫。希萨尔成为德里西部通道上的统治中心，但1398年帖木儿入侵时，其军队焚烧了堡垒。

胡马雍在对易卜拉欣·洛迪的征战中获胜后，巴布尔将希萨尔赏给了他。舍尔沙·苏尔于1540年夺取此城，胡马雍1555年收复后又将其交给阿克巴。1798年，爱尔兰士兵乔治·托马斯占领希萨尔，将其纳入以汉西为中心的领地；他于1801年被逐。东印度公司的权力于1803年进入这一地区，1832年希萨尔取代汉西成为地方行政中心。

english:
Hishikari belonged to the contested country around the upper Sendai River in southern Kyushu. During the sixteenth century the Hishikari family and their Sagara allies resisted the expanding Shimazu. Ōkuchi Castle was an important stronghold in their struggle, and control of the surrounding district changed with the fortunes of these competing houses.

In 1569 the Hishikari and Sagara made peace and submitted to the Shimazu. Niiro Tadamoto was appointed to govern Ushikuso-in that year, establishing Shimazu authority in the neighbouring Ōkuchi district. These events formed part of the broader campaigns through which the Shimazu extended their power across Satsuma, Ōsumi and Hyūga. Hishikari's early modern setting emerged from this transition from competing local lordships to the territorial government of the Shimazu.
simp_chinese:
菱刈位于南九州川内川上游一带的争夺地区。十六世纪，菱刈氏及其盟友相良氏抵抗不断扩张的岛津氏。大口城是双方交锋中的重要据点，周围地区的控制权也随着诸家势力的消长而变化。

1569年，菱刈氏与相良氏议和，向岛津氏降服。同年，新纳忠元受任治理牛屎院，岛津氏由此确立对邻近大口地区的统治。这些事件属于岛津氏向萨摩、大隅及日向扩张的一系列战争。菱刈的近世格局，就在地方领主相互竞争逐渐转向岛津氏领国统治的过程中形成。

english: The Hisiometaneo, or Ridge People, were a Cheyenne band of the northern and central Plains. Their name recalls the ridges and hills of their country. They maintained close ties with other Cheyenne communities and with Lakota neighbors, moving across grasslands north of the Platte and later into the hill country farther south. Like other Cheyenne bands, they gathered for common councils and dispersed into smaller camps for hunting and travel.
simp_chinese: 希西奥梅塔尼奥人或称山脊人，是北部和中央平原的一个夏延群体，其名称让人想起活动地区的山脊与丘陵。他们与其他夏延社群及拉科塔邻人关系密切，在普拉特河以北的草原活动，后来又进入更南方的丘陵地带。与其他夏延群体一样，他们为共同议事而聚集，也分散为较小营地进行狩猎和旅行。

english:
Hissar stands in the fertile valley of the Kafirnigan, beneath the mountains that bear its name. Its fortress guarded a district known in earlier medieval sources as Shuman. The town lay among the settlements of the upper Oxus basin, where cultivated valleys opened into high mountain country.

By the time of Timur the place was known as Hisar-i Shadman, the “fortress of Shadman”, or simply Hissar. Its rulers and the powers of Bukhara contested control of the surrounding lands in the centuries that followed. Across from the fortress gate stands an old madrasa dating from the sixteenth century; another madrasa was built in the eighteenth. Their presence beside the citadel reflects the town's place as a centre of learning as well as government.
simp_chinese:
吉萨尔坐落在肥沃的卡菲尔尼甘河谷中，背靠与它同名的山脉。城堡守卫着这片地区，中世纪早期的文献称此地为舒曼。城镇位于奥克苏斯河上游流域的诸聚落之间，耕作的河谷在这里通向高山地带。

到帖木儿时代，这里已称为希萨尔－沙德曼，即“沙德曼堡”，也简称吉萨尔。在此后的几个世纪里，当地统治者与布哈拉的势力争夺周围地区。堡门对面有一座建于十六世纪的古经学院，十八世纪又建了一座新经学院。它们与城堡相邻，显示这座城镇不仅是统治中心，也是求学之地。

english: South of Panjakent the Zarafshan and Hissar mountain country rises above the river valley. Steep slopes and narrow gorges divide the valleys, while juniper woodland grows on some of the lower heights. The Zarafshan valley separates these ridges from the Turkestan mountains to the north, and streams from the highlands descend to the river. Beyond the crests lie the valleys leading toward Kesh and the lands south of the range.
simp_chinese: 片治肯特以南，泽拉夫尚与吉萨尔山地高出河谷。陡坡和狭窄峡谷分割谷地，部分较低山坡生长着桧树林。泽拉夫尚河谷将这些山脊与北面的突厥斯坦山脉分开，高地溪流则下行汇入河中。越过山脊便是通往渴石和山脉南方诸地的河谷。

english: High ranges of the Pamir-Alay rise east of the Zarafshan valley, where steep ridges divide the tributaries flowing toward the great river. Snow and ice feed mountain streams, and narrow gorges connect the upland basins with more sheltered valleys below. These mountains stand between the Fergana and Zarafshan regions, forming part of the long chain of barriers and passes that shape movement through Central Asia's interior.
simp_chinese: 帕米尔—阿赖高山耸立在泽拉夫尚河谷以东，陡峭山脊分隔着流向大河的各条支流。冰雪补给山溪，狭窄峡谷将高地盆地与下方较为隐蔽的河谷连接起来。群山位于费尔干纳与泽拉夫尚地区之间，是塑造中亚内陆交通的一连串山障和隘口的一部分。

english: The Turkestan range rises north of the Zarafshan valley, separating it from the lands of Ustrushana and Fergana. Its steep southern slopes descend toward the river, while valleys on the northern side open toward the plains around Zomin and Jizzakh. Snow on the higher crests feeds streams that cut through the mountains. Passes across the range offer difficult routes between the cultivated oases on either side.
simp_chinese: 突厥斯坦山脉耸立在泽拉夫尚河谷以北，将其与乌什鲁萨纳和费尔干纳地区分开。陡峭南坡下降至河流，北侧河谷则通向佐明和吉扎克周围的平原。高峰积雪补给切穿群山的溪流。山口为两侧耕作绿洲之间提供艰难的通道。

english: Hisse'yoyi'yoe lies near the headwaters of the Niobrara River in eastern Wyoming. West of Lusk the young river begins among open plains, and its upper channel can be dry for long stretches. The North Fork, also called Duck Creek, comes from shallow swales north of Lusk before joining it farther east. The Niobrara grows into a longer river as it crosses Nebraska toward the Missouri.
simp_chinese: 希塞约伊约靠近怀俄明东部的奈厄布拉勒河源头。幼小的河流在卢斯克以西的开阔平原发源，上游河床有时长段干涸。北支又称鸭溪，从卢斯克以北的浅洼地流来，在更东面汇入干流。奈厄布拉勒河随后穿过内布拉斯加，逐渐汇成通向密苏里河的大河。

english: The upper Heart River crosses the rolling plains of western North Dakota before turning east toward the Missouri. Near this part of its course, beavers built dams in the channel, while spring floods could swell the stream far beyond its summer flow. The Heart's branching drainage lies between the Knife River to the north and the Cannonball to the south, cutting through beds of sandstone, siltstone and lignite.
simp_chinese: 哈特河上游流经北达科他西部起伏的平原，随后转向东流，奔向密苏里河。在这段河道附近，海狸在水中筑坝；春季洪水则能使河流远比夏季涨得更加汹涌。哈特河的支流呈树枝状分布，北面是奈夫河，南面是坎农鲍尔河；河水切过砂岩、粉砂岩和褐煤岩层。

english:
Hit stands beside the Euphrates at the edge of the western Iraqi desert, in a district famed for its bitumen springs. The dark substance was used from ancient times to waterproof boats and in building, and gave the town a valuable resource besides the produce of its riverbank. Palm groves and irrigated fields surround the settlement, while the river provides a passage between the upper Euphrates and the cultivated plains downstream.

In the fourteenth century the geographer Hamdallah Mustawfi described Hit as a small town with many villages dependent upon it. Its gardens produced dates, oranges, lemons and other fruit, though he remarked upon the smell of the bitumen springs. The contrast between cultivated riverbanks and the barren land beyond them was already a conspicuous feature of this stretch of the Euphrates.
simp_chinese:
希特坐落在幼发拉底河畔、伊拉克西部荒漠的边缘，以附近的沥青泉闻名。这种黑色物质自古用于建筑和船只防水，是当地除河岸农产之外的一项宝贵资源。棕榈园与灌溉田地环绕聚落，河道则通往幼发拉底河上游及下游的耕作平原。

十四世纪，地理学家哈姆达拉·穆斯陶菲称希特是一座统辖许多村庄的小城。当地园圃出产椰枣、橙、柠檬等水果，但他也提到沥青泉散发的气味。耕作的河岸与其外荒地之间的鲜明反差，早已成为这段幼发拉底河谷的特色。

english: Hita lies in a basin of western Bungo, where roads converge between the mountains of Kyushu. In 1601 an administrator built a castle on Tsukikuma hill and laid out a merchants' town across the Kagetsu River. Much of the district came under direct shogunal control in 1639, and Hita became a centre of administration and trade. The merchants of Mameda and Kuma maintained wide commercial connections, through which news and ideas also travelled.
simp_chinese: 日田位于丰后西部盆地，九州群山间的道路在此交会。1601年，代官在月隈山筑城，并在花月川对岸规划商人町。1639年，郡内大部转为幕府直辖，日田成为行政与商业中心。豆田、隈町的商人维持广泛的交易联系，消息和思想也随之流通。

english: Hitchauta lies east of the Chattahoochee River, near the falls that mark the head of navigation from the Gulf. Georgia established Columbus there as a trading town in 1827, and its streets and lots were surveyed the following year. In January 1828 the steamboat Fanny reached the falls from the Gulf of Mexico. Below the rapids, river traffic carried cotton toward the port of Apalachicola.
simp_chinese: 希乔塔位于查特胡奇河以东，靠近从墨西哥湾溯河航行的终点瀑布。佐治亚州于1827年决定在此建立贸易城镇哥伦布，次年丈量街道和地块。1828年1月，汽船“范妮”号从墨西哥湾抵达瀑布附近。急流下方的河运将棉花送往阿巴拉契科拉港。

english:
Hitchiti was a Native town whose people spoke a language shared with several neighbouring communities. Spanish records named it Ahachito among the towns of Apalachicola Province on the Chattahoochee River in 1675. Like other towns of the region, it maintained its own identity while taking part in a wider network of alliances, diplomacy and regional exchange.

Shortly after 1690, Hitchiti and other Chattahoochee towns moved east to the Ocmulgee River, known to English traders as Ochese Creek. There they formed part of a cluster of settlements trading with Carolina and its merchants. Following the Yamasee War in 1715, Hitchiti returned west to the Chattahoochee. Two of its leaders later joined other Lower Creek chiefs in meeting Georgia's founder James Oglethorpe at Savannah in 1733.
simp_chinese:
希奇蒂是一座原住民村镇，居民所说的语言也为数个邻近社群使用。1675年，西班牙记载以阿哈奇托之名将它列为查特胡奇河沿岸阿巴拉契科拉地区的村镇之一。与邻镇一样，它保有自身身份，同时参与更广泛的联盟与交换网络。

1690年后不久，希奇蒂和其他查特胡奇河村镇向东迁往奥克马尔吉河；英国商人称这条河为奥切斯溪。这里形成了与卡罗来纳商人贸易的聚落群。1715年亚马西战争后，希奇蒂返回西方的查特胡奇河。1733年，当地两位领袖随其他下克里克酋长前往萨凡纳，会见佐治亚的创建者詹姆斯·奥格尔索普。

english:
Hitu was a federation of villages on the northern peninsula of Ambon, a clove-growing island in the central Moluccas. Its leaders commanded a trading community whose connections reached the northern coast of Java and beyond, while the clove harvest drew merchants and rival powers to its shores. During the sixteenth century Hitu resisted Portuguese attempts to dominate Ambon.

In 1605 its leaders allied with the Dutch East India Company against the Portuguese and granted the Company the exclusive right to buy their cloves. The alliance deteriorated as Dutch demands and restrictions provoked resistance. Hituese strongholds around Wawani fell in 1643, but the mountain fortress of Kapahaha held out until July 1646. Its capture brought the long struggle on the peninsula to an end.
simp_chinese:
希图是安汶岛北部半岛上的村落联盟。安汶位于摩鹿加中部，以丁香种植闻名；希图首领领导着一个联系远及爪哇北岸及更远地区的贸易社群，丁香收获也吸引商人和争夺权势者来到这里。十六世纪，希图抵抗葡萄牙人控制安汶的企图。

1605年，希图首领与荷兰东印度公司结盟对抗葡萄牙人，并给予公司独家购买丁香的权利。此后荷兰人的要求与限制引发抵抗，联盟逐渐破裂。1643年，瓦瓦尼周围的希图据点陷落；山中堡垒卡帕哈哈则坚持到1646年7月才被攻克，半岛上的长期战争随之结束。

english:
Hiva Oa is the largest island of the southern Marquesas, a rugged volcanic island of towering steep ridges and deep valleys. Marquesan communities cultivated breadfruit and stored fermented fruit in pits against times of scarcity. Breadfruit was peeled, stored under leaves and earth, and later baked as part of the islanders’ food supply. The valleys held settlements and ceremonial places whose stone platforms and carvings testify to generations of island life.

In 1595 Álvaro de Mendaña’s Spanish expedition sighted Hiva Oa and visited nearby Tahuata. Almost two centuries later, James Cook’s Resolution called at Tahuata in 1774 and surveyed the southern islands. Encounters brought unfamiliar goods into the Marquesas, while island communities continued to govern their valleys through chiefs and established relationships.
simp_chinese:
希瓦奥阿是南马尔基萨斯群岛最大的岛屿，火山岛地形崎岖，山脊陡峭，山谷深邃。马尔基萨斯社群种植面包果，将发酵果实储藏在坑中，以备匮乏时使用。面包果去皮后置于树叶和泥土之下保存，日后烤熟食用。谷中有聚落和礼仪场所，石台与雕刻见证了世代岛民的生活。

1595年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的西班牙探险队望见希瓦奥阿，并到访附近的塔瓦塔。近两个世纪后，詹姆斯·库克的决心号于1774年停靠塔瓦塔，测绘南部岛屿。接触带来陌生物品，岛上社群则继续通过首领及既有关系治理山谷。

english: Hiw lies beside the Nile in Upper Egypt and is associated with ancient Diospolis Parva. Cemeteries in the surrounding district preserve evidence of communities that lived here before the unification of ancient Egypt. The narrow cultivated valley, bordered by desert, has sustained settlement along this stretch of the river for thousands of years.
simp_chinese: 希乌位于上埃及尼罗河畔，与古代的小底比斯城相联系。周边墓地保存着古埃及统一以前在此生活的社群的遗迹。沙漠环绕着狭长的耕作河谷，数千年来，这段河岸一直有人定居。

english: The Hiwassee River rises on the slopes of the southern Appalachians and follows a winding course north and west to the Tennessee. Along its upper waters, Cherokee tradition tells of Tlanusi-yi, the Leech Place, where a monstrous leech could command the river and sweep people to its depths. The name Hiwassee has appeared in many spellings and has been associated with a Cherokee word for a meadow or savanna.
simp_chinese: 希瓦西河发源于阿巴拉契亚山脉南部的山坡，曲折地向北、向西流去，最终汇入田纳西河。在上游河段，切罗基传说讲述了特拉努西伊，即“水蛭之地”：那里有一只巨大的水蛭，能够驱使河水将人卷入深渊吞食。希瓦西这个名字有许多拼写形式，也有人将其与切罗基语中草地或大草原一词联系起来。

english: Hiyama lies inland from the mouth of the Yoneshiro River in northern Dewa. Its mountain castle was the seat of the Hiyama Andō, a family that expanded its power along the northern coast and later adopted the name Akita. They ruled from Hiyama through much of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. Under the Satake lords who followed, the settlement remained an administrative centre for the Noshiro and Yamamoto country.
simp_chinese: 桧山位于出羽北部米代川河口的内陆。当地山城是桧山安东氏的本据，该家族沿北方海岸扩张势力，后来改称秋田氏。十五至十六世纪的大部分时间里，安东氏从桧山统治此地；其后的佐竹氏统治下，这处聚落仍是能代、山本地区的行政中心。

english: Hiyama lies on the Sea of Japan side of southern Ezo. At Kaminokuni, the hilltop fortress of Katsuyama overlooked the mouth of the Amanogawa and the maritime routes beyond. Built around 1473 by Takeda Nobuhiro, an ancestor of the Matsumae rulers, it served as a center of politics and northern trade. Graves nearby include both Buddhist burials and those following Ainu customs. The Hiyama guard post remained at Kaminokuni until its transfer to Esashi in 1678.
simp_chinese: 桧山位于虾夷地南部的日本海一侧。上之国的山城胜山馆俯瞰天之川河口和远处的海上航路，约于一四七三年由松前氏先祖武田信广建造，曾是政治和北方贸易的中心。附近墓地既有佛教式墓葬，也有遵循阿伊努习俗的墓葬。桧山番所原设于上之国，一六七八年迁往江差。

english: Hizan, known to Armenian scribes as Khizan, lies in the mountains south of Lake Van on routes crossing the Armenian highlands. From the late fourteenth century its monasteries supported several manuscript workshops, and in the fifteenth century their painters developed a distinctive style of illumination. The artist Mesrop of Khizan carried this tradition to Persia, where Armenian patrons commissioned richly decorated books in the early seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 希赞在亚美尼亚抄经员笔下称为希赞，位于凡湖以南群山之间，横越亚美尼亚高地的道路经过此地。自十四世纪末起，修道院维持着数个手稿工坊；十五世纪，画师们发展出独特的彩饰风格。希赞的梅斯罗普后来将这一传统带到波斯，十七世纪初亚美尼亚资助者在那里委托他制作精美的书籍。

english:
Lake Hjälmaren became more closely connected with Sweden's inland trade when the Hjälmare Canal opened in 1639. The waterway linked the lake with the Arboga River and Lake Mälaren, providing a route toward Stockholm. One of its principal purposes was to carry iron from the Bergslagen mining districts to the capital and onward to overseas markets.

The canal demanded repeated rebuilding. A major repair campaign in 1691–1699 involved Nicodemus Tessin the Younger and canal specialists from the Netherlands. Between 1819 and 1829 a new five-kilometre alignment was constructed on the initiative of Baltzar von Platen. These works altered the routes by which boats reached the lake and show how Hjälmaren's commercial connections depended on maintained locks and channels as well as on its natural waters.
simp_chinese:
1639年耶尔马运河通航后，耶尔马伦湖与瑞典内陆贸易的联系更加紧密。水道将湖泊与阿尔博加河、梅拉伦湖连接，提供通向斯德哥尔摩的路线。其主要用途之一，是把贝里斯拉根矿区的铁运往都城，再转销海外。

运河需要反复重修。1691—1699年的大规模修缮，由小尼科德穆斯·特辛及荷兰运河专家参与。1819—1829年，在巴尔察·冯普拉滕倡议下，又修建了五公里的新线。这些工程改变船只进入湖泊的路线，也显示耶尔马伦湖的商业联系，除了天然水域之外，还依靠持续维护的船闸与航道。

english:
Hjo developed beside the mouth of the Hjoån on Lake Vättern's western shore. Medieval crossings linked this landing place with religious houses and communities on the opposite bank. Its growth has been associated with the expansion of Vadstena Abbey in the later fourteenth century. Hjo first appears as a town in a written source in 1413, although the exact date of its original privileges is uncertain.

The earliest surviving town map, drawn in 1696, shows buildings concentrated south and east of the river and around the market square. Its irregular streets and long plots preserve a pattern believed to have medieval origins. Unlike many Swedish wooden towns, Hjo escaped repeated large conflagrations. A serious local fire in April 1794 nevertheless destroyed the medieval church beside the square and several nearby buildings; melted collection money was recovered among the remains. Lake traffic, the compact market centre and the rebuilding of its church shaped Hjo before the much later development of a constructed harbour and spa.
simp_chinese:
尤城形成于韦特恩湖西岸尤河口，湖上渡运将这处登陆点同对岸宗教机构及社群连接起来。其发展与十四世纪后期瓦德斯泰纳修道院的兴起相联系。1413年的文献首次以城市称呼尤城，最初特许权授予的准确日期仍不明确。

现存最早城图绘于1696年，显示建筑集中在河流南面、东面及市场广场周围。不规则街道与狭长地块，保留被认为源于中世纪的格局。尤城较少遭受其他瑞典木构城镇常见的大规模火灾，但1794年4月的一次火灾仍烧毁广场旁的中世纪教堂及数座邻屋，人们在残骸中找到熔结的奉献钱币。湖上交通、紧凑市镇中心与教堂重建，共同构成后来筑港和温泉疗养业发展以前的尤城面貌。

english:
Hjørring stands on a hill in Vendsyssel, at the northern end of Jutland. Coins were struck here in the mid-twelfth century, and the regional assembly met in the town throughout the Middle Ages. Its three early churches of St John, St Olaf and St Catherine stood around the hilltop settlement. King Eric IV granted its oldest known market-town charter in 1243.

The regional assembly ceased to meet in the 1520s. The Count's Feud brought heavy payments, and the Reformation ended the nearby monasteries of Børglum and Vrejlev, which had dealt with the town. Plague struck in 1602; imperial troops were quartered here in 1627–1629 and Swedish troops occupied it in 1644. Fire destroyed seventeen farms in 1647, and another occupation followed in 1657–1658. Much of Hjørring burned again in 1819.
simp_chinese:
约灵坐落在日德兰北端的文德叙瑟尔地区一座山丘上。十二世纪中叶，这里已铸造钱币；整个中世纪，地方议会都在城中集会。圣约翰、圣奥拉夫和圣凯瑟琳三座早期教堂分布在山顶聚落周围。埃里克四世于1243年颁发了现存最早的集镇特许状。

地方议会在1520年代停止集会。伯爵战争迫使居民支付沉重款项，宗教改革又使与城镇有经济联系的伯格勒姆和弗赖莱乌修道院消失。1602年瘟疫来袭，1627至1629年帝国军队驻扎于此，1644年瑞典军队占领城镇。1647年大火烧毁十七处农庄，1657至1658年又有敌军占领。1819年，约灵的大部分地区再次毁于火灾。

english: Hkamti Long is a highland country in the far north of Burma, centred on the valley around Putao. Its Tai Hkamti communities formed a group of small principalities amid mountains and forests near the headwaters of the Irrawaddy. From this northern homeland, Tai Hkamti settlers also moved towards Assam and south along the Chindwin. The mountains separate their valleys from neighbouring lands while the rivers provide passages through them.
simp_chinese: 坎底隆位于缅甸最北部高地，以葡萄附近的河谷为中心。泰坎底人聚居于伊洛瓦底江源头附近的山林之间，形成若干小邦。泰坎底人也从北方故地迁向阿萨姆，以及钦敦江沿岸的南方地区。高山将这些河谷与邻近土地分隔，河流则在群山中开辟通道。

english: Hlahlandlela was a settlement of Mzilikazi's followers in the country of the Fokeng, near the Magaliesberg. After leaving the Zulu kingdom, Mzilikazi built a following in the southern African interior and established several centres before moving farther north. The region was already home to Sotho-Tswana chiefdoms whose relationships with the newcomers were shaped by warfare and migration.
simp_chinese: 赫拉兰德拉是姆齐利卡齐追随者在马加利斯堡附近福肯人土地上建立的聚落。离开祖鲁王国后，姆齐利卡齐在南部非洲内陆聚集追随者并建立数处中心，后来继续向北迁移。当地原有索托－茨瓦纳酋邦，战争与人口迁徙影响了他们与新来者的关系。

english:
Hlohovec appears in the Second Zobor Document of 1113 as Galgocz. Its Slavic name refers to hawthorn, while the German Freistad an der Waag recalled a free town on the Váh. It received town privileges in 1362. During the seventeenth-century struggles between Habsburg and Ottoman forces, the town came under Ottoman control in 1663. The consulted English and Slovak encyclopedia accounts differ over when that occupation ended.

In 1720 the Erdődy family acquired the town and estate, and later rebuilding transformed the older castle into a noble residence. Its grounds include an eighteenth-century riding school and garden pavilion, as well as an Empire theatre from 1802. The Gothic church of Saint Michael and the Franciscan church and monastery preserve other layers of the town's history.
simp_chinese:
赫洛霍韦茨于1113年的第二佐博尔文书中以高尔戈茨之名见载。斯拉夫语名称指山楂，德语称呼则表达瓦赫河畔自由城之意。1362年，它获得城市特许。十七世纪哈布斯堡与奥斯曼军队争夺期间，城镇于1663年进入奥斯曼控制；查阅的英语与斯洛伐克语百科对占领何时结束说法不同。

1720年埃尔德迪家族取得城镇和领地，此后重建把旧城堡改为贵族宅邸。庄园内有十八世纪骑术学校与园林亭阁，以及1802年的帝政式剧院。哥特式圣米迦勒教堂和方济各会教堂、修道院则保存了城镇历史的其他层面。

english: Hlučín grew near the old boundary between Moravia and the Duchy of Opole. Probably founded by King Ottokar II in the thirteenth century, it is first recorded in 1303 as part of the Duchy of Opava. For many years the town belonged to the Landek estate, before the Piast dukes of Opole acquired it in 1521. Fires struck Hlučín repeatedly in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, and its inhabitants were freed from serfdom in 1694. The Treaty of Berlin transferred the town to Prussia after the First Silesian War in 1742.
simp_chinese: 赫卢钦兴起于摩拉维亚与奥波莱公国的旧边界附近。它可能由奥托卡二世国王于十三世纪创建，1303年首次见于记载时属于奥帕瓦公国。城镇长期归兰代克庄园所有，1521年被奥波莱的皮雅斯特公爵购得。十七至十八世纪，赫卢钦屡遭火灾；1694年，当地居民摆脱了农奴身份。1742年第一次西里西亚战争后，《柏林条约》将城镇划归普鲁士。

english:
Hlukhiv stands on the Esman, a tributary of the Seim, in the old Severian lands. First recorded in 1152, it became a princely seat after the Mongol invasion and later passed between Lithuania, Moscow and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Its greatest political importance came in the eighteenth century, when it served as the capital of the Cossack Hetmanate.

King Władysław IV granted Hlukhiv Magdeburg rights in 1644. The town entered the Hetmanate during the uprising of 1648, and its Cossack and Russian garrison withstood a Polish siege in 1664. In 1669 Demian Mnohohrishny was elected hetman here and agreed to terms with the tsar's representatives that limited Cossack autonomy. After Ivan Mazepa allied with Charles XII in 1708, Peter I ordered the destruction of Baturyn and the transfer of the hetman's seat to Hlukhiv. Ivan Skoropadsky was elected here, and the town remained the Hetmanate's capital until 1764. Its buildings were remodelled under the last hetmans; after the office was abolished, the Russian Little Russian Collegium governed from the town.
simp_chinese:
格卢希夫位于塞姆河支流埃斯曼河畔，属于古老的谢韦里亚地区。它首见于1152年的记载，蒙古入侵后成为诸侯驻地，后来先后归立陶宛、莫斯科和波兰立陶宛联邦。十八世纪，它作为哥萨克酋长国首都迎来政治上最重要的时期。

1644年，瓦迪斯瓦夫四世国王授予格卢希夫马格德堡法权。1648年起义期间，城镇归入酋长国；1664年，哥萨克与俄国守军抵御了波兰军围攻。1669年，杰米扬·姆诺霍赫里什内在此当选盖特曼，并与沙皇代表订立限制哥萨克自治的条款。1708年伊万·马泽帕与查理十二世结盟后，彼得一世下令摧毁巴图林，并将盖特曼驻地迁至格卢希夫。伊万·斯科罗帕德斯基在此当选，城镇直到1764年仍是酋长国首都。末代盖特曼们重建了城中的建筑；盖特曼职位废除后，俄国的小俄罗斯委员会从这里治理地区。

english:
Hlusk stood beside the Ptich River in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. A wooden castle established in the early sixteenth century occupied the elevated riverbank, with towers, gates and access towards the water. In 1525 the landowners received permission from Sigismund I to hold fairs, linking the defended settlement with recurring opportunities for exchange.

The castle changed substantially in the later seventeenth century. Under Aleksander Hilary Połubiński, reconstruction in the1670s gave it a bastioned form and included a church inside the enclosure. Archaeological finds of decorated tiles bearing dates 1670 and 1675 provide material traces of this building campaign. The fortified residence thus combined military works, household display and religious patronage. Hlusk's local centre developed through the relationship between river access, market privileges and the resources of aristocratic owners who reshaped its defences.
simp_chinese:
格卢斯克位于立陶宛大公国的普季奇河畔。十六世纪初修建的木堡占据较高河岸，设有塔楼、城门及通向河流的入口。1525年，领主获得西吉斯蒙德一世准许举办集市的特许，使设防聚落与定期交换活动相连。

十七世纪后期，城堡发生重大变化。亚历山大·希拉里·波武宾斯基于1670年代主持重建，形成棱堡式防御，并在围垣内建有教堂。考古发现带1670与1675年款的装饰瓷砖，为这轮营建留下物质痕迹。设防宅邸由此结合军事工程、家族展示与宗教资助。河流入口、集市特权和贵族领主能够动用的资源，共同塑造了格卢斯克的地方中心及其防御空间。

english: Hlybokaye lies among lakes on the road between Vilnius and Polotsk. Records from 1514 describe a manor belonging to the Zianowicz family; the settlement later became a private town in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. In the seventeenth century Józef Korsak founded a Catholic parish church and a church for the Discalced Carmelites. The friars ran a school and a dormitory for poor students, giving the town an educational as well as a religious role in the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 格卢博科耶位于维尔纽斯与波洛茨克之间的道路上，周围散布着湖泊。1514年的文书记载这里有一座属于齐亚诺维奇家族的庄园，聚落后来成为立陶宛大公国的一座私人城镇。十七世纪，约瑟夫·科尔萨克创建天主教堂区教堂，又为赤足加尔默罗会兴建教堂。修士们开办学校和贫困学生宿舍，使城镇成为周围地区的教育与宗教中心。

english: Hlynne lies in the wooded and marshy country of Polesia, south of the Pripet basin. Its earliest written mention dates to 1451. The village belonged to the estate of Davyd-Haradok, and its church was built in 1716. In the early nineteenth century the nearby estate of Yuzefin was associated with the Radziwiłł family, whose possessions extended across much of the region.
simp_chinese: 格林涅位于波利西亚的森林与沼泽地带，处在普里皮亚季河流域以南。其最早的文献记载可追溯至1451年。村庄曾属于达维德-戈罗多克领地，教堂建于1716年。十九世纪初，附近的尤泽芬庄园与拉齐维乌家族有关；这一家族在当地拥有广阔领地。

english: Hmawbi lies north of Dagon in the low country between the Irrawaddy delta and the Pegu Yoma. Traces of old town walls survive in the area, recalling settlement before the growth of nearby Yangon. Streams cross the plain towards the delta waterways, while forested hills rise to the north and east. The district lay within the wider lands of Hanthawaddy, whose rulers governed Lower Burma from the royal city of Pegu.
simp_chinese: 茂比位于大光以北，在伊洛瓦底江三角洲与勃固山脉之间的低地。当地留有古城墙的痕迹，显示附近仰光发展壮大之前已有聚落。溪流穿过平原流向三角洲水道，北面和东面则是森林覆盖的丘陵。这片地区属于汉达瓦底的广大领地，其统治者从勃固王都治理下缅甸。

english: Hñähñu is a name used by Otomi-speaking peoples of central Mexico. Their communities occupied a broad region stretching from the central highlands toward the drier northern frontier. After the Spanish conquest, some Otomi families moved into the Bajío, where their settlements lay among lands inhabited by Chichimeca peoples. Their language belongs to the Oto-Pamean branch of the Otomanguean family.
simp_chinese: 尼亚纽是墨西哥中部说奥托米语的民族所用的名称。其社区分布广阔，从中央高地延伸至较干旱的北部边疆。西班牙征服后，一些奥托米家庭迁往巴希奥，在奇奇梅克诸民族居住的土地间建立聚落。他们的语言属于奥托-帕梅语支，是奥托曼格语系的一部分。

english: Ho Bay lies beside the northern Indian River Lagoon, a sheltered stretch of water separated from the Atlantic by barrier islands. Indigenous communities lived on the resources of the lagoon and nearby St. Johns River. In 1605 the Spanish envoy Álvaro Mexía travelled through this coast on a diplomatic mission and mapped the Indian River. He stopped among the Surruque before continuing toward the Ais farther south.
simp_chinese: 霍湾位于印第安河潟湖北部。狭长屏障岛将这片较为平静的水域与大西洋隔开；原住民社群利用潟湖和附近圣约翰斯河的资源生活。1605年，西班牙使者阿尔瓦罗·梅希亚沿海执行外交使命，并绘制印第安河地图。他先在苏鲁克人地区停留，随后继续前往更南方的艾斯人地区。

english: Hoa is associated with the ǂʼAmkoe-speaking people of the Kalahari. Their language is one of the distinctive click languages of southern Africa, spoken in the dry country of Botswana. The area's grasslands and scrub have supported communities whose knowledge of wild plants and animals helped them live in an environment where surface water is often scarce.
simp_chinese: 霍阿与卡拉哈里地区说 ǂʼAmkoe 语的人群有关。这种语言是南部非洲独特的搭嘴音语言之一，使用于博茨瓦纳的干旱地区。当地草地和灌丛孕育了熟悉野生植物与动物的社群，他们凭借这些知识在地表水常常稀缺的环境中生活。

english: Hoachanas was a political centre of the Kai-khaun, or Red Nation, among the Nama-speaking communities of southern Namibia. Local tradition places the discovery of its spring by hunters around 1700, making water an important part of the settlement's remembered beginnings. Its leadership history also records divisions and changing alliances among neighbouring Nama groups. During the eighteenth century the Swartboois separated from the Red Nation and left Hoachanas. Hendrik Jacob Wikar's diary of travels in 1778-79 mentioned the Red Nation leader Gaob Hanamab. Missionaries entered this political world rather than creating it. In 1820 James Kitchingman, Shaw and Schmelen visited the chief Tsawab Gamab; their reception and subsequent difficulties show that conversion was negotiated and contested. The drought of 1829-30 and southward movements of Herero groups brought further disputes over livestock and territory. In the 1830s the Red Nation formed an alliance with Jonker Afrikaner's community, adding another relationship to Hoachanas's established regional politics.
simp_chinese: 霍查纳斯是纳米比亚南部纳马语社群中凯卡翁“红族”的政治中心。地方传统称，猎人约在1700年发现这里的泉水，水源因而成为聚落起源记忆的重要部分。首领传承也记下了纳马各群体之间的分裂与联盟变化。十八世纪，斯瓦特布伊人脱离红族，离开霍查纳斯。亨德里克·雅各布·维卡1778至1779年的旅行日记，提到了红族首领高布·哈纳马布。传教士后来进入的是一个已有自身政治关系的社会。1820年，詹姆斯·基钦曼、肖和施梅伦拜访察瓦布·加马布首领；接待过程及后来的困难表明，改宗需要交涉，也受到抵制。1829至1830年的干旱，以及赫雷罗群体南迁，又带来牲畜和领地争端。1830年代，红族与容克尔·阿非利卡纳的社群结盟，使霍查纳斯的地区关系增添了新的层次。

english:
Hoan Châu was an older name retained for the Nghệ An country of north-central Vietnam. Its historical landscape extended across river valleys, cultivated lowlands and approaches to the mountains. The name continued to carry a regional identity even after official administrative names changed. Local lineages preserved accounts of service and warfare through which their own history was connected to that of the kingdom.

In 1424, Lê Lợi's Lam Sơn forces moved into Nghệ An, taking the upland route and attacking Trà Lân. The campaign provided a new base from which the rebellion expanded southward in 1425 and advanced north in 1426. Later struggles to restore the Lê dynasty against the Mạc also involved families from this region. The Hoan Châu ký recounts successive generations of the Nguyễn Cảnh lineage and especially the service of Nguyễn Cảnh Hoan and Nguyễn Cảnh Quế. Composed as a historical narrative, it preserved the old regional name within a family's account of royalist allegiance and political achievement.
simp_chinese:
驩州是越南中北部乂安地区保留的旧称。其历史地域包括河谷、耕作低地和通向群山的道路；行政名称改变以后，驩州仍承载地方认同。当地家族将从军与仕宦经历写入叙事，使自身历史同王国变迁相连。

1424年，黎利的蓝山军进入乂安，沿山间道路进攻茶麟，建立新的活动基地；随后于1425年向南扩展，1426年再向北进军。后来反对莫氏、恢复黎朝的斗争，也有本区家族参与。《驩州记》叙述阮景家族数代历史，尤重阮景欢、阮景桂的功业。这部历史叙事将王朝效忠、军事服务与家族成就联系起来，也把驩州旧名保存在地方世系的历史记忆之中。

english:
Hoboksar lies in a basin north of the Dzungarian plain, among the pastures of the western Mongols or Oirats. Here Batur Khong Tayiji gathered power among the Oirat tribes in the seventeenth century, making the district an early centre of the Dzungar state. A castle southeast of Hoboksar, built between 1639 and 1643, gave his authority a fortified seat in the midst of pastoral country.

Qing armies conquered Dzungaria in the eighteenth century, and in 1758 Hoboksar came under the frontier administration of Tarbagatai. In 1771 Torghut Mongols who had left the Volga region returned east to Qing territory; some were settled around Hoboksar. Their arrival added another chapter to the history of Oirat communities whose migrations had linked the grasslands of Inner Asia across immense distances.
simp_chinese:
和布克赛尔位于准噶尔平原以北的盆地，是西蒙古卫拉特人的牧地。十七世纪，巴图尔珲台吉在此集聚力量，使这里成为准噶尔政权早期的中心。他于1639至1643年间在和布克赛尔东南修筑城堡，为牧业地区的统治建立了一处坚固据点。

十八世纪清军征服准噶尔，和布克赛尔于1758年纳入塔尔巴哈台的边疆行政体系。1771年，离开伏尔加河流域的土尔扈特蒙古人东归清朝疆域，一部分人在和布克赛尔附近安置。卫拉特诸部的迁徙曾将内亚相距遥远的草原联系起来，这次归来又为当地历史添上一页。

english: Hoburgen marks the southern tip of Gotland, where limestone cliffs and sea stacks rise above the Baltic. The headland consists of ancient fossil reefs, and its caves have sheltered people since the Stone Age, including hunters and fishermen who stayed there temporarily. Its reefs and currents were dangerous to ships rounding the island. When Carl Linnaeus visited in 1741 he remarked on the many vessels lost on these shores and urged that a light be provided for mariners.
simp_chinese: 霍堡根位于哥得兰岛南端，石灰岩峭壁与海蚀柱耸立在波罗的海上方。岬角由古老的化石礁构成，其洞穴自石器时代起便为人提供庇护，猎人和渔民曾在此暂住。岛角的礁石和水流对绕岛航行的船只颇为危险。卡尔·林奈1741年到访时提到许多船只在此失事，并建议为水手设置灯标。

sources.title: Planeringsunderlag för marina kulturmiljövärden i den nationella havsplaneringen - Nationell sammanställning av regleringsbrevsuppdrag RB2021:3B4.pdf

english: Hobyo lies on the Indian Ocean coast of central Somalia, where sandy ground and dry plains meet the sea. Its harbour offered an anchorage on a coast exposed to the seasonal winds of the monsoon. The surrounding interior is pastoral country, and the shore forms part of the long maritime corridor connecting the ports of southern Somalia with the Horn and the Arabian Sea.
simp_chinese: 霍比奥位于索马里中部印度洋海岸，沙地与干旱平原在这里与大海相接。港湾为船只提供锚地，而这段海岸受到季风的季节性影响。周围内陆是牧业地区，海岸则属于漫长的海上通道，将索马里南部港口与非洲之角及阿拉伯海连接起来。

english: Hóc Mó is a small inlet and rocky point on the coast of Quảng Ngãi in central Vietnam. The sea cuts into the shore beside a projecting reef, giving the place its distinctive form. Along this coast, sandy stretches alternate with headlands that stand out against the open South China Sea. The rocky shore and its neighbouring inlet offer a local landmark to boats travelling between the coastal settlements.
simp_chinese: 霍莫是越南中部广义海岸的一处小海湾和岩石岬角。海水深入岸边，旁侧一片岩礁向海突出，形成独特的轮廓。沿这段海岸，沙岸与面向开阔南海的岬角交替出现。岩岸和邻近的港湾，为往来沿海聚落的船只提供了地方性的地标。

english: Hocabail was a Maya lordship in northern Yucatán, centred on Hocabá and neighbouring Homún. Its communities occupied the limestone interior among other independent Maya territories. During the Spanish conquest the region came under colonial control, and by 1549 Hocabá was held in encomienda. The obligation to provide tribute and labour altered local government, although Maya communities continued to inhabit and cultivate their lands.
simp_chinese: 霍卡瓦伊尔是尤卡坦北部的玛雅领地，以霍卡瓦与邻近的奥蒙为中心。其社群生活在灰岩内陆，与其他独立玛雅辖地相邻。西班牙征服期间，该地区转入殖民控制，1549年霍卡瓦已被授予恩科米恩达。贡赋和劳动义务改变了地方治理，但玛雅社群继续居住并耕作自己的土地。

english:
Al Hoceima Bay opens from Morocco's Rif coast into the Alboran Sea. The small rocky island near its shore became a Spanish garrison in 1673. Occupation of this strongpoint placed a permanent military establishment within waters also used by local fishing boats and coastal craft. The fort's position gave it strategic value, but its inhabitants remained dependent on supplies brought from outside.

Fishing helped supplement those provisions during the eighteenth century. It also exposed small boats to capture in the contested waters around the garrison. In 1766 the commander of an Alhucemas xebec reported seizing a Moroccan boat whose crew was attempting to surprise a fishing launch. Reports from 1790 again described armed boats waiting to capture fishermen or other vessels approaching the Spanish positions. These incidents joined everyday food supply to the danger of captivity. The bay's history consequently involved more than possession of a fortified rock: maintaining the garrison depended on vulnerable movements across the same waters where fishing and coastal navigation continued.
simp_chinese:
胡塞马湾从摩洛哥里夫海岸通向阿尔沃兰海。近岸小岩岛于1673年成为西班牙驻军据点，使当地渔船和沿岸舟船使用的水域，多了一处长期军事设施。堡垒位置具有战略价值，岛上居民却仍依赖外来物资。

十八世纪，捕鱼补充驻地粮食，也使小船在争夺中的水域面临被俘危险。1766年，胡塞马一艘谢贝克帆船的指挥官报告，截获一条企图突袭渔艇的摩洛哥船。1790年的报告又记述，武装舟船等候捕捉渔民或驶近西班牙据点的船只。日常供食因此同被俘风险相连。海湾历史并不限于占据一块设防岩石：维持驻军依靠脆弱的海上运输，而捕鱼与沿岸航行仍在同一片水域继续。

english:
Hochelaga was a village of the St. Lawrence Iroquoians on the island below Mount Royal. Fields of maize, beans and squash surrounded its palisades, while families lived together in longhouses built of timber and bark. The people supplemented their crops by hunting, fishing and gathering, and the river connected them with other communities. Their village was one of several Iroquoian settlements in the St. Lawrence Valley.

In 1535 Jacques Cartier travelled upriver to Hochelaga, where its inhabitants welcomed him. He described a fortified settlement containing about fifty longhouses and climbed the nearby mountain, which he named Mount Royal. When Samuel de Champlain returned to the island in 1603, the village and the St. Lawrence Iroquoian community Cartier had encountered were no longer there. Their disappearance remains a subject of historical debate.
simp_chinese:
奥舍拉加是圣劳伦斯易洛魁人在皇家山下岛屿上的村庄。木栅栏外环绕着玉米、豆类和南瓜田，村民以木材和树皮建成长屋，多个家庭共同居住。除了耕作，他们还狩猎、捕鱼和采集，并沿河与其他社群往来。奥舍拉加是圣劳伦斯河谷数个易洛魁语族聚落之一。

1535年，雅克·卡蒂埃沿河而上来到奥舍拉加，受到当地居民欢迎。他记下这座设防村庄约有五十座长屋，又登上附近的山，将其命名为皇家山。1603年萨缪尔·德·尚普兰来到岛上时，村庄和卡蒂埃遇到的圣劳伦斯易洛魁人社群已不在原地；他们离去的原因至今仍有争论。

english: Hochob is a small Maya settlement on a hill above the red-earth savannas of the Chenes region. Terraces supported houses on its slopes, and underground cisterns collected rainwater. Its finest buildings were raised between the seventh and tenth centuries. One façade forms the enormous face of an earth monster, with the doorway set within its open jaws; masks and carved mat motifs gave the building both sacred and political significance.
simp_chinese: 霍乔布是切内斯地区红土草原上方山丘上的一处小型玛雅聚落。坡上的梯台支撑着住宅，地下水窖收集雨水。最精美的建筑建于七至十世纪，其中一座立面构成巨大的大地怪兽面孔，门口位于张开的巨口中；面具和编席纹饰赋予建筑宗教与政治意义。

english: The Hocking River flows southeast through the wooded hills of Ohio to join the Ohio River. Its older name, Hockhocking, refers to a bottle: near its headwaters the stream narrows above a waterfall and widens below it, giving the watercourse a distinctive shape. In 1774 Lord Dunmore's force reached the mouth of the Hocking before advancing toward Shawnee towns on the Scioto during the war that bears his name.
simp_chinese: 霍金河向东南流过俄亥俄林木覆盖的丘陵，汇入俄亥俄河。它的旧名霍克霍金意为“瓶子”：源头附近的溪流在瀑布上方狭窄，下方展宽，形状十分独特。1774年，在以他命名的战争期间，邓莫尔勋爵的部队抵达霍金河口，随后向赛欧托河畔的肖尼人城镇进军。

english: Hodod, known in Hungarian as Hadad, was a market town and castle in the hills of Szilágyság. Its history was long bound to the Jakcs noble family, whose estates included the castle and the town. In 1584 Prince Stephen Báthory granted Hodod, Jibou and other possessions to his treasurer Ferenc Wesselényi. The family made Hadad one of its centres, and in the eighteenth century its owners invited German settlers to the estate.
simp_chinese: 霍多德在匈牙利语中称为豪道德，是西拉吉沙格丘陵中的集镇和城堡。它的历史长期与雅克奇贵族家族相连，城堡和城镇均属于该家族的地产。1584年，斯特凡·巴托里亲王将霍多德、日博及其他领地赐予财政官韦谢莱尼·费伦茨。家族以豪道德为中心之一，18世纪的领主还邀请德意志移民来到庄园。

english:
Hodonín lies beside the Morava in the lowlands of southern Moravia. A castle was founded here in the eleventh century, and the first reliable written mention of the settlement dates from 1169. Hodonín became a town in 1228. Its position on the river placed it close to the frontier with Hungary, where rulers and armies crossed between the neighbouring lands.

In 1301 King Wenceslaus II received Hungarian nobles at Hodonín when they came to invite his son to take the Hungarian crown. The town changed hands during the Hussite Wars and suffered repeated devastation in the seventeenth century: Hungarian rebels burned it in 1605, and troops of Gabriel Bethlen plundered it in 1621. War reduced its population, but in the eighteenth century a tobacco factory established in the former castle helped draw people back.
simp_chinese:
霍多宁位于南摩拉维亚低地的摩拉瓦河畔。十一世纪，当地建立了一座城堡；聚落最早可靠的文字记载见于一一六九年，一二二八年取得城市地位。河畔位置使它靠近匈牙利边境，统治者和军队经常在邻近土地之间往来。

一三〇一年，温塞斯拉斯二世国王在霍多宁接见匈牙利贵族，他们前来邀请他的儿子继承匈牙利王冠。胡斯战争期间城镇易主，十七世纪又屡遭破坏：一六〇五年匈牙利起义者焚毁此地，一六二一年加博尔·贝特伦的军队洗劫了城镇。战争使人口减少，但十八世纪设在旧城堡内的烟草工厂帮助吸引居民回来。

english: The Hodul Mountains rise among the volcanic uplands of central Cappadocia, north of the old kingdom of Tuwana. Ancient eruptions helped form the soft rock of the surrounding plateau, later cut into valleys and curious pillars by wind and water. Settlements occupy the more sheltered ground between ridges, while the mountains mark the transition toward the plains and valleys around Kayseri.
simp_chinese: 霍杜尔山耸立在卡帕多西亚中部的火山高地，位于古代图瓦纳王国以北。远古火山活动形成周围高原的松软岩层，后来风水侵蚀将其切割成河谷与奇特石柱。聚落分布在山岭之间较为避风的地方，山地则标示着通往开塞利周边平原和河谷的过渡地带。

english:
Hoengcheon was the earlier name of Hoengseong, an inland county of Gangwon. In 1389, near the end of Goryeo rule, an appointed supervisor was established here. Joseon reorganised the district as a county under a magistrate in 1413. The following year its name became Hoengseong because Hoengcheon sounded too similar to neighbouring Hongcheon. Its history thus followed a local administrative centre with its own changing jurisdiction.

After the Japanese invasions, the county magistrate also held command of Gangwon's central military division. In 1627, Yi Ingeo and his followers seized the county office and its weapons before advancing toward Wonju, where government troops defeated them. The court punished Hoengseong by abolishing the county and incorporating it into Wonju; its separate status was restored in 1636. By the eighteenth century, administration again extended across a network of villages. The gazetteer Yeojidoseo, compiled in 1760, described eight townships and fifty-five villages, recording households and distances from the government office.
simp_chinese:
横川是横城的旧称，位于江原内陆。高丽末年，1389年此处设置监务；朝鲜王朝于1413年整顿地方制度，设县并置县监。次年因“横川”与邻近“洪川”读音相近，奉命改称横城。这里有自己的地方官署与辖境，名称和行政地位也随朝廷命令改变。

壬辰战争以后，横城县监兼任江原中营将。1627年，李仁居率众攻占县衙，夺取军械后向原州进发，遭官军击败。朝廷随后撤销横城县，将其并入原州，直到1636年才恢复。十八世纪，县级行政重新覆盖各村。1760年编纂的《舆地图书》列出八面五十五里，记载户口以及各地距官署的路程，呈现出这个内陆县的治理范围。

english: The Hoengeiqua were Khoekhoe herders of the eastern Cape, whose country lay near the Great Fish River. Their chief Toena received tribute from Xhosa settlers in the frontier country, where Khoekhoe and Xhosa chiefdoms formed alliances as well as rivalries. In the eighteenth century the expansion of the Cape colony brought new competition over land and cattle to this region.
simp_chinese: 洪格夸人是东开普地区的科伊科伊牧民，其土地靠近大菲什河。首领图纳曾接受在边疆地区定居的科萨人所缴贡赋；科伊科伊与科萨诸酋邦既结盟，也有竞争。十八世纪，开普殖民地扩张又使这片地区面临新的土地和牲畜争夺。

english:
Hoeyang guarded the approaches to Cheollyeong, a pass of strategic importance in the mountains of eastern Korea. It became a dohobu in Gangwon under the eight-province system in 1413. In 1457 Hoeyang was made the centre of a military district supervising six nearby county garrisons. Its magistrate therefore worked within a landscape organised for both civil administration and defence.

The pass continued to shape local institutions in the seventeenth century. A supporting commander was stationed here in 1610, and a defence commissioner was appointed when Cheollyeong was fortified in 1618. In 1695 another command was established at the pass to oversee policing and the pursuit of bandits across neighbouring districts. The repeated adjustment of these commands shows how closely Hoeyang's administrative importance was tied to control of mountain communications.
simp_chinese:
淮阳扼守朝鲜东部山地铁岭的通道，具有重要战略地位。1413年实行八道制时，这里成为江原道所属的都护府；1457年又以淮阳为军事中心，统辖附近六个郡县的军镇。地方官由此同时承担民政与防务方面的职责。

17世纪，铁岭继续影响地方机构的设置。1610年设助防将，1618年修筑铁岭城防时又设防御使。1695年，朝廷在岭上另设要冲，配置讨捕使，负责周边地区的治安与缉捕事务。军事指挥机构的屡次调整，显示淮阳的行政地位与控制山地交通之间的紧密关系。

english:
Hof lies on the Saale between the Franconian Forest and the Fichtel Mountains. The Via Imperii passed through this upland country, linking markets to the north with Nuremberg and routes towards Italy. The town became part of the lands of the margraves of Brandenburg-Bayreuth.

A fire destroyed many houses in 1625, and during the Thirty Years' War Heinrich Holk's cavalry repeatedly plundered Hof in 1633. The town later offered refuge to Protestants displaced from Austria and Bohemia. In 1683 it gained a regular postal link between Leipzig and Nuremberg, with services to Regensburg and Dresden added in the following decade. Hof passed to Prussia in 1791 and to Bavaria in 1810, after Napoleon's campaigns. Another great fire devastated the town in 1823, destroying nine out of ten buildings.
simp_chinese:
霍夫位于法兰克尼亚森林与菲希特尔山之间的萨勒河畔。帝国大道穿过这片高地，将北方市场与纽伦堡及通往意大利的道路连接起来。城镇后来成为勃兰登堡—拜罗伊特边境伯的领地。

1625年大火毁掉许多房屋；三十年战争期间，海因里希·霍尔克的骑兵于1633年多次洗劫霍夫。城镇后来收容了从奥地利和波希米亚流离失所的新教徒。1683年，莱比锡与纽伦堡之间的定期邮路经过此地，随后十年又增设通往雷根斯堡和德累斯顿的邮路。霍夫于1791年归普鲁士，拿破仑战争后于1810年转归巴伐利亚。1823年的另一场大火又重创城市，十分之九的建筑被毁。

english: Hofgeismar was a town of the archbishops of Mainz in northern Hesse, first mentioned in 1082. It served their interests in a region contested with the landgraves of Hesse. In 1462, during the Mainz ecclesiastical conflict, the archbishop pledged Hofgeismar and other places to the landgrave to raise money for war, and Hessian rule followed. In 1686 Hofgeismar became a place of refuge for Huguenots who had fled France after the revocation of religious toleration. Landgrave Charles invited them to settle in his lands, and communities grew in and around the town. Their churches and settlements added a new strand to the history of a place long shaped by the rivalry of Mainz and Hesse.
simp_chinese: 霍夫盖斯马尔是美因茨大主教在黑森北部的城镇，最早见于1082年的记载。它在大主教与黑森伯爵争夺的地区维护着美因茨的利益。1462年美因茨教会争端期间，大主教将霍夫盖斯马尔等地典押给黑森伯爵，以筹集战争费用，此后这里转入黑森统治。1686年，霍夫盖斯马尔成为胡格诺派难民的避难地；法国废除宗教宽容政策后，他们离开故乡。卡尔伯爵邀请难民在自己的领地定居，城内及周边逐渐形成新社区。教堂和聚落为这个长期受美因茨与黑森争斗影响的地方增添了新的历史篇章。

english: Hofsjökull, the “temple glacier,” spreads across the western part of Iceland's high interior. Its ice covers a great central volcano and lies north of the Kerlingarfjöll mountains, between the larger ice caps of Langjökull and Vatnajökull. Rivers descend from this elevated country: the Blanda flows north from the glacier's northwestern side to Húnaflói. The broad expanse of ice forms part of the remote highland landscape separating Iceland's settled coasts.
simp_chinese: 霍夫斯冰原的名字意为「神庙冰川」，广布于冰岛内陆高地西部。冰层覆盖着一座巨大的中央火山，位于凯尔灵山以北、朗格冰原和瓦特纳冰原之间。河流从这片高地流下：布兰达河从冰原西北侧向北流入胡纳湾。辽阔的冰雪是冰岛偏远内陆高地的一部分，将沿岸居住地分隔开来。

english:
Hogdal is a name for the valley around the Hoan River. In the historical province of Hälsingland, Ytterhogdal lies downstream from neighbouring Överhogdal. The older district name appears in a copy of a 1273 document; the two parish names later distinguished the lower and upper parts of the valley.

Ytterhogdal was a separate parish by 1402 and part of Ljusdal's pastorate until 1562. The old frontier ran between Ytterhogdal and Överhogdal: the latter lay in Härjedalen, which passed from Denmark-Norway to Sweden in the Treaty of Brömsebro in 1645.
simp_chinese:
霍格达尔是霍安河谷的旧称。位于历史上海尔辛兰地区的于特霍格达尔，处在邻近厄弗霍格达尔的下游。1273年文书的抄本中已有这一地区名称；后来两个堂区名称分别指河谷的下游与上游。

于特霍格达尔在1402年前后已是独立堂区，至1562年前属于尤斯达尔牧区。旧国界曾从于特霍格达尔与厄弗霍格达尔之间经过：后者位于海里耶达伦，1645年《布勒姆瑟布鲁和约》后由丹麦—挪威转归瑞典。

english: Hogehege was among the names used by early mapmakers for the Tennessee River and its upper waters. The river follows a great bend through northern Alabama before turning north toward the Ohio. Far upstream, the Holston, also known as Hogohegee, joins the French Broad to form the Tennessee. French maps and traders used several names for these waterways, including Cherokee River; by the late eighteenth century the name Tennessee had become established for the main river.
simp_chinese: 霍格赫格是早期制图者对田纳西河及其上游水道使用过的名称之一。田纳西河穿过阿拉巴马北部，形成一道大弯，再折向北方流往俄亥俄河。远在上游，亦称霍格赫格的霍尔斯顿河与弗伦奇布罗德河汇合，形成田纳西河。法国地图和商人曾使用多个名称，包括“切罗基河”；到十八世纪后期，“田纳西”成为干流的通用名称。

english: Hogohega is an old name associated with the Holston River, whose branches descend through the Appalachian valleys before joining the French Broad to form the Tennessee. Long Island in the Holston was a sacred Cherokee meeting place on the Great Indian Warrior Path. Travellers, traders and delegations followed the river country through the mountains, while the Cherokee defended their claim to the island against the spread of colonial settlement.
simp_chinese: 霍戈赫加是霍尔斯顿河的旧称之一。河流的支脉穿过阿巴拉契亚山谷而下，与弗伦奇布罗德河汇合，形成田纳西河。霍尔斯顿河中的长岛是切罗基人的神圣会盟地，位于大印第安勇士之路上。旅行者、商人和使团沿河谷穿行于群山之间，切罗基人也努力维护对长岛的权利，抵御殖民定居的扩展。

sources.title: Burial Mounds of the Northern Sections.pdf

english: Hoh Sai, or Kusai Lake, is a saline lake on the northern Tibetan Plateau. It lies in the high, cold Hoh Xil country, among isolated basins between the Kunlun and Tanggula Mountains. The surrounding plains support sparse alpine vegetation and animals adapted to the altitude, while exposed sediments around the lake can be lifted by wind into the dry plateau air.
simp_chinese: 可西湖又称库赛湖，是青藏高原北部的一座盐湖。它位于可可西里寒冷高地，坐落在昆仑山与唐古拉山之间的孤立盆地中。周围平原生长稀疏高山植被，也有适应高海拔的动物；湖边裸露的沉积物能够被风卷入干燥的高原空气。

english: Hoh Xil is a vast, cold region of the Tibetan Plateau between the Kunlun and Tanggula ranges. Its name means “blue ridge” in Mongolian. Much of the high country drains into isolated lakes, while the Chumar River carries water towards the Yangtze. Tibetan antelope, wild yak and wild ass inhabit the grasslands, and female antelope gather around Zhuonai Lake to give birth.
simp_chinese: 可可西里是昆仑山与唐古拉山之间辽阔寒冷的青藏高原地区，蒙古语名意为“青色山梁”。高地大部分水流汇入孤立湖泊，楚玛尔河则流向长江。藏羚羊、野牦牛和野驴生活在草原上，雌性藏羚羊还聚集于卓乃湖周围产仔。

english: Hoh Xil Lake is one of the isolated lakes scattered across the high plateau between the Kunlun and Tanggula mountains. In this cold country, many basins have no outlet to the sea, and water gathers in lakes surrounded by sparse alpine vegetation. The wider Hoh Xil grasslands support wild yak, wild ass and Tibetan antelope, animals adapted to the great elevation and severe winters.
simp_chinese: 可可西里湖是昆仑山与唐古拉山之间高原上众多孤立湖泊之一。这片寒冷土地上的许多盆地没有通向大海的出口，水流汇聚成湖，周围只有稀疏高山植被。广阔的可可西里草原上生活着野牦牛、野驴和藏羚羊，它们适应了高海拔与严寒冬季。

english: The Hoh Xil mountains rise across the northern Tibetan Plateau, among the high basins and lakes of the Changtang. The country is cold and dry, with broad valleys separating long mountain ranges. Despite the severity of the climate, the plateau supports wild animals adapted to life at great elevation, including the Tibetan antelope and wild yak. Snow and ice on the higher ground feed streams that run into the inland basins.
simp_chinese: 可可西里山脉横贯青藏高原北部，位于羌塘的高地盆地与湖泊之间。这里气候寒冷干燥，宽阔河谷将绵延的山岭分隔开来。尽管环境严酷，高原仍有适应高海拔生活的野生动物，包括藏羚羊和野牦牛。高处积雪和冰川融水汇成溪流，流向内陆盆地。

english: Hohenberg Castle stood on a height of the Swabian Jura near Schörzingen, a mountain occupied as early as Alemannic times. Built between 1050 and 1100, it became the seat of the counts of Hohenberg, a branch of the Zollern family. The castle passed to Austria with the county in 1381 and was held by successive feudal lords. In 1449, during a feud, soldiers from Rottweil besieged and captured it; the castle was destroyed and its defences demolished.
simp_chinese: 霍恩贝格城堡坐落在施瓦本山地绍尔青根附近的高峰上，早在阿勒曼尼时代便有人在山上居住。城堡建于1050年至1100年间，成为霍恩贝格伯爵的驻地，这个家族是霍亨索伦家族的一个支系。1381年，城堡随伯国一同转归奥地利，此后由不同的封臣持有。1449年，一场争斗中，罗特魏尔的士兵围攻并夺取城堡，将其摧毁，防御工事也被拆除。

english: Hoi lies in the plain of eastern Mikawa, near the lower Toyokawa River. The Buddhist temple Myōgonji, founded in 1441, became widely known as Toyokawa Inari for the deity enshrined there. Warriors including Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Tokugawa Ieyasu revered the temple. In the Edo period its reputation spread among common people seeking prosperity and safety for their households, drawing worshippers from many parts of Japan.
simp_chinese: 宝饭位于三河东部平原，靠近丰川下游。1441年创立的妙严寺因寺内供奉的神灵而广称丰川稻荷。织田信长、丰臣秀吉和德川家康等武将都曾信奉此寺。江户时代，祈求生意兴隆与家宅平安的庶民使其信仰传遍各地，香客从日本各处而来。

english: Hoifa was a Jurchen polity of the upper Songhua country, ruled by a branch of the Nara clan. Its fortified centre stood in the hills near the Hoifa River, and its leaders were among the powers competing for influence in the late Ming frontier. In 1593 its ruler Baindari joined a coalition against Nurhaci and escaped after the allies were defeated. Relations remained uncertain, and in 1607 Nurhaci besieged Hoifa's stronghold. Baindari and his son were killed, and his people were incorporated into Nurhaci's expanding state.
simp_chinese: 辉发是上松花江地区的女真政权，由纳喇氏一支统领。它的山城靠近辉发河，是明代晚期边疆诸势力争夺影响力的据点之一。1593年，首领拜音达里参加反对努尔哈赤的联军，联军战败后逃回辉发。双方关系始终不稳，1607年努尔哈赤围攻辉发城，拜音达里父子战死，其部众被纳入努尔哈赤不断扩张的政权。

english: Hoilkut, or Whilkut, was the Hupa name for people of the upper Redwood Creek country in northwestern California. They lived in the creek's valley and the neighboring Bald Hills, west of Hoopa Valley, with related communities along the Mad River. Their speech was a variety of Hupa, belonging to the Athabaskan family. Redwood forests and steep river valleys shaped their homeland, which lay between the Hupa on the Trinity River and peoples nearer the Pacific coast.
simp_chinese: 霍伊尔库特又称惠尔库特，是胡帕人对加利福尼亚西北部红木溪上游居民的称呼。他们住在胡帕谷地以西的溪谷和邻近的秃山地区，马德河沿岸也有相关社群。他们的语言是阿萨巴斯卡语族胡帕语的一种方言。红木森林与陡峭河谷构成了他们的故土，东面是三一河上的胡帕人，西面则是更靠近太平洋的民族。

english: Hokah is a Dakota name for the Root River, a tributary of the upper Mississippi. Its branches flow through southeastern Minnesota, cutting valleys between wooded bluffs and the surrounding prairie. The river joins the Mississippi near a place where a Dakota leader also bore the name Hokah. The Root valley formed part of a network of waterways linking communities of the upper Mississippi with the interior.
simp_chinese: 霍卡是鲁特河的达科他语名称。这条上密西西比河支流的各分支流经明尼苏达东南部，在森林峭壁与周围草原之间切出河谷。河流在一位同名达科他领袖的居所附近汇入密西西比河。鲁特河谷是连接上密西西比河社群与内陆的水道网络的一部分。

english:
Hōlanikū, also known as Kure, is a low coral atoll at the far northwestern end of the Hawaiian island chain, west-northwest of Midway. A ring of reef surrounds its lagoon, with Green Island its only permanent island. Its low profile made it difficult for mariners to see, while old charts located it unreliably.

Before 1827, about half a dozen ships had visited the atoll, giving it a fresh name on each occasion. These repeated names reflected the difficulties of recognising and charting a remote reef. Shipwrecks on its reefs are recorded from 1837, at the close of this period; the same reef that sheltered a lagoon also presented an almost submerged obstacle to passing vessels.
simp_chinese:
Hōlanikū又称库雷环礁，位于夏威夷群岛最西北端，在中途岛西北偏西。礁环围绕潟湖，绿岛是其中唯一的永久岛屿。环礁低平，航海者难以辨认，旧海图对其位置的标示也不可靠。

1827年以前，约有六艘船到访这里，每次都留下一个新名称。名称的反复变化，反映出辨认和测绘这座偏远礁环的困难。自1837年，即这一时期的末尾起，已有船只在礁上失事的记录；围护潟湖的礁环，也构成过往船只几乎看不见的水下障碍。

english: Hōlanikū lies at the far northwestern end of the Hawaiian chain. This low coral atoll surrounds a lagoon and is separated from the main islands by a vast stretch of ocean. Several ships visited the atoll before 1827, each leaving it with a different name.
simp_chinese: 霍拉尼库位于夏威夷群岛最西北端。这座低矮珊瑚环礁环绕着潟湖，广阔海洋将它与主岛群隔开。1827年以前，数艘船只曾到访这座环礁，并各自给它留下不同的名称。

english: Hólar lies in Hjaltadalur in northern Iceland, a small settlement that was for centuries one of the island's chief religious and educational centers. Founded as a bishop's seat in 1106 under Jón Ögmundsson, it served the north while Skálholt served the south. Its bishops took part in the island's political struggles as well as its spiritual life. During the Reformation Hólar became the last stronghold of Catholic resistance in Iceland. Its bishop Jón Arason was captured and executed with his two sons at Skálholt in 1550. Lutheran bishops subsequently held the see, among them Guðbrandur Þorláksson. The church at Hólar was rebuilt in the eighteenth century, its stone walls completed in 1763.
simp_chinese: 侯拉尔位于冰岛北部的希亚尔塔谷，是一座小聚落，却曾在数百年间成为岛上主要的宗教与教育中心。1106年，约恩·厄格蒙松在此建立主教座，负责北方；斯卡尔霍尔特则管辖南方。主教们既参与宗教生活，也卷入岛上的政治争斗。宗教改革期间，侯拉尔成为冰岛天主教抵抗的最后据点。主教约恩·阿拉松被俘，1550年与两个儿子一同在斯卡尔霍尔特被处决。此后路德宗主教掌管教区，其中包括古德布兰杜尔·索尔拉克松。侯拉尔教堂于十八世纪重建，石墙在1763年完工。

english: Holbox lies off the northern Yucatán coast, where shallow lagoons and channels separate the island from the mainland and link the Gulf of Mexico with the waters to the east. Maya coastal communities used these waters for fishing and salt collection, and canoes carried salt, food, cotton and other goods between settlements. Coastal navigation tied the island's shores to the peninsula's wider exchange networks. After the Spanish conquest, Maya communities continued to live across the peninsula, and seafaring routes kept passing the island's shallow reefs and channels.
simp_chinese: 霍尔博克斯岛位于尤卡坦北岸外，浅水潟湖与水道把岛屿同大陆隔开，并连接墨西哥湾与东面的海域。玛雅沿海社群在这些水域捕鱼、采盐，独木舟在聚落之间运送盐、食物、棉花和其他产品。沿海航行把岛屿海岸接入半岛的交换网络。征服之后，玛雅社群仍然遍布半岛，航船也继续经过岛屿周围的浅滩与水道。

english: Holeylan is a valley in the central Zagros, crossed by the Seymareh River. Archaeological sites on the plain and in surrounding caves show a long history of human presence, reaching back to the Palaeolithic. The river runs between mountain ridges, while the valley floor offers a contrast to the steep country on either side. Its water and the stone carried in its bed formed part of the landscape used by early inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 霍雷兰是扎格罗斯中部的一处河谷，塞伊马雷河流经其中。平原与周围洞穴中的考古遗址显示，人类在这里活动的历史可追溯至旧石器时代。河流穿过山岭之间，谷底与两侧陡峭地形形成对比；河水和河床中的石料，都是早期居民所利用的环境的一部分。

sources.title: 321075685 The Paleolithic Survey of Holeylan Central Zagros Iran

english: Holíč lies near the Morava River, close to the old boundary between Hungary and Moravia. Its castle began as a medieval stronghold on this frontier, where rival rulers and powerful noble families contested control of the surrounding lands. In 1315 King John of Bohemia led an expedition against it in retaliation for raids into Moravia. Centuries later the old fortress acquired a very different character: between 1749 and 1754 it was rebuilt in the Baroque style, turning a defensive seat into a grand residence.
simp_chinese: 霍利奇靠近摩拉瓦河，位于匈牙利与摩拉维亚的古老边界附近。当地城堡原是中世纪边疆要塞，竞争的君主和强大的贵族家族争夺着周围土地。1315年，波希米亚国王约翰率军攻打此地，以报复从这里发起的侵扰摩拉维亚的行动。几个世纪后，古堡的面貌大为改变：1749至1754年间，它被改建为巴洛克式建筑，由防御据点变成华丽的居所。

english:
Hollabrunn lies on the Göllersbach in the Weinviertel of Lower Austria. A charter of 1135 records vineyards here, and the lords of Sonnberg established its parish in the thirteenth century. They had granted it market rights by 1377. The town was known as Oberhollabrunn to distinguish it from Niederhollabrunn.

From about 1530 Hollabrunn was a post station on the road between Vienna and Prague. Its market privilege was renewed in 1574 under Georg von Gilleis. Swedish troops under Lennart Torstensson devastated it in 1645, during the Thirty Years' War. The Dietrichstein family took over the lordship in 1662 and promoted the Counter-Reformation. In 1683 King John Sobieski of Poland passed through with his troops on the way to relieve Vienna. The French wars brought fighting to Hollabrunn and nearby Schöngrabern in 1805 and again in 1809.
simp_chinese:
霍拉布伦位于下奥地利葡萄酒区的格勒斯巴赫河畔。一一三五年的文书记载了当地葡萄园；松贝格领主在十三世纪设立教区，并在一三七七年以前授予集市权。为了与下霍拉布伦区分，此地曾被称为上霍拉布伦。

约一五三〇年起，霍拉布伦成为维也纳至布拉格道路上的驿站。格奥尔格·冯·吉莱斯于一五七四年更新了它的集市特权。三十年战争期间，伦纳特·托斯滕松率领的瑞典军队于一六四五年破坏了城镇。一六六二年，迪特里希施泰因家族取得领地并推动反宗教改革。一六八三年，波兰国王扬·索别斯基率军经过此地，前往解救维也纳。法国战争期间，霍拉布伦和附近的申格拉本于一八〇五年和一八〇九年两度发生战斗。

english: Holland's North Sea coast is a low shore of beaches and dunes, backed by lands crossed by rivers and waterways. The dunes form a natural barrier against the sea, while river mouths open routes toward the towns of the Rhine and Maas delta. Behind the shore, drainage and embankment allowed people to cultivate low-lying ground, though subsiding soil and storm floods made protection a continuing task. The waterways linking the coast with Dordrecht, Rotterdam and other towns carried the commerce on which their prosperity depended.
simp_chinese: 荷兰的北海海岸低平，沙滩和沙丘之后是河流与水道纵横的土地。沙丘构成抵御海水的天然屏障，河口则为船只通往莱茵河与马斯河三角洲的城镇提供航路。海岸后方的低地经过排水和筑堤而得以耕作，但地面沉降与风暴洪水使防护成为长期任务。连接海岸、多德雷赫特、鹿特丹等城镇的水道承载着支撑它们繁荣的贸易。

english: Cape Hollmann lies on the coast of New Britain, where the island's mountainous interior meets the sea. This shore belongs to the maritime world of the Bismarck Archipelago, with channels linking New Britain to New Ireland and the smaller islands around them.
simp_chinese: 霍尔曼角位于新不列颠岛海岸，多山内陆在这里与大海相接。这段海岸属于俾斯麦群岛的海洋世界，水道将新不列颠与新爱尔兰及周围较小岛屿连接起来。

english: Hollola lies near Lake Vesijärvi in southern Finland. Its parish once covered a wide area of Tavastia, with a priest recorded as early as 1328. The great stone church of Saint Mary was built between about 1495 and 1510, replacing earlier wooden churches. Its decorated gable, star vaults and carved wooden figures made it a distinguished centre of worship for the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 霍洛拉位于芬兰南部韦西耶尔维湖附近。其教区曾覆盖塔瓦斯蒂亚的广大地区，1328年已有牧师的记载。圣玛丽亚大石教堂约建于1495年至1510年间，取代了早期木教堂。装饰山墙、星形拱顶和木雕像使它成为周围乡村重要的礼拜中心。

english: Hólmur lies in the Hornafjörður district of southeastern Iceland, between the Atlantic coast and the great ice cap of Vatnajökull. Farms in this country occupy a narrow inhabited belt beneath mountains and glaciers, with rivers flowing from the ice toward the sea. The nearby inlet of Hornafjörður gives its name to the district. Glacial ice and the changing rivers descending from it form a striking backdrop to the scattered settlements of this part of Iceland.
simp_chinese: 霍尔穆尔位于冰岛东南部的霍尔纳菲厄泽地区，介于大西洋海岸与瓦特纳冰原之间。这片土地上的农场分布在山岭和冰川下方狭窄的居住地带，河流从冰原流向大海。附近的霍尔纳峡湾赋予这一地区以名字。冰川及其流出的多变河流，构成冰岛这一角落零散聚落的鲜明背景。

english: Holoikauaua, also called Pearl and Hermes Atoll, is a vast reef in the northwestern Hawaiian chain. Only a handful of low sandy islets rise above the lagoon and reef. In 1822 the British whalers Pearl and Hermes were wrecked on the reef during the same storm, leaving their names attached to the atoll.
simp_chinese: 霍洛伊考阿瓦瓦又称珍珠与赫耳墨斯环礁，是夏威夷岛链西北部的巨大礁盘。只有少数低矮沙岛高出潟湖与礁面。1822年，英国捕鲸船珍珠号和赫耳墨斯号在同一场风暴中于此触礁失事，环礁由此获得它们的名字。

english: Holoikauaua is a broad coral atoll in the northwestern Hawaiian Islands. Much of its reef lies beneath the sea, with a few small islets rising above it. In 1822 the British whalers Pearl and Hermes wrecked here on the same night; their crews took refuge on an islet and built a schooner from salvaged timber.
simp_chinese: 霍洛伊考阿瓦阿是夏威夷西北列岛的一座宽阔珊瑚环礁。大部分礁体位于水下，只有几座小岛露出海面。1822年，英国捕鲸船“珍珠”号和“赫耳墨斯”号在同一夜于此失事；船员在小岛避难，并用回收木材建造纵帆船。

english:
Holstebro arose beside a ford on the Storå in western Jutland, where a bridge later crossed the river. It is first mentioned in a letter of 1274 from Thyge, bishop of Ribe. Fire destroyed many of its older buildings in 1552. Farther south, the royal castle of Lundenæs guarded a crossing of the Skjern river, controlling both the road and the waterway.

At Lundenæs in 1340, Niels Ebbesen defeated forces of the Holstein counts during the Danish rising. Queen Margaret I redeemed the mortgaged castle in 1407. It was burned during the Count's Feud in 1534 and again in 1621; a replacement was built on the edge of the river valley. The crown sold Lundenæs in 1661, ending its long association with royal administration in the district.
simp_chinese:
霍尔斯特布罗兴起于西日德兰斯托罗河的一处渡口，后来河上建起桥梁。里伯主教蒂厄1274年的一封信首次提及此地。1552年的大火烧毁了许多旧建筑。更南面的王家城堡伦讷内斯扼守斯凯恩河渡口，控制陆路和水路。

1340年丹麦人起义期间，尼尔斯·埃贝森在伦讷内斯击败荷尔斯泰因伯爵的军队。1407年，玛格丽特女王赎回了被抵押的城堡。伯爵战争期间的1534年，城堡被焚毁；1621年再次遭火灾后，人们在河谷边缘建起新宅。王室于1661年出售伦讷内斯，结束了它与当地王室行政的长期联系。

english:
Holtålen lies in upper Gauldalen in Trøndelag, where farming communities occupied a valley leading toward Trondheim. Its medieval parish life is represented by the stave church at Haltdalen, probably built in the 1170s. The timber building remained a parish church through the later Middle Ages and the Reformation. Traces of painted decoration dated 1604 record an early modern alteration to the interior, linking the medieval structure with the changing religious life of the valley.

Copper production gave Holtålen a particularly concrete place in the mining economy around Røros. The first local smelter, Tamlaget below Svølgja, was built in 1659. Copper ore was discovered at Killingdal in 1674, and additional mines followed. Dragås smelter opened in 1727, followed by Eidet in 1834. These works brought ore processing into the valley itself, alongside the agriculture on which households continued to depend. The succession of furnaces and mines shows how Holtålen developed from a dispersed parish landscape into a district where farming, woodland resources and metal production were closely joined.
simp_chinese:
霍尔托伦位于特伦德拉格的高尔河谷上游，农业社群沿通往特隆赫姆的谷地分布。哈尔特达伦的木板教堂体现了当地中世纪堂区生活，这座建筑大约始建于1170年代，在中世纪后期和宗教改革以后继续作为堂区教堂使用。室内残存的1604年彩绘痕迹，记录了一次近世改造，也将中世纪木构与河谷宗教生活的变化联系起来。

铜业使霍尔托伦具体参与勒罗斯周边的矿业经济。1659年，当地第一座冶炼厂塔姆拉格特建于斯沃尔亚下方；1674年，基灵达尔发现铜矿，此后又出现更多矿山。德拉戈斯冶炼厂于1727年开设，埃德特冶炼厂则于1834年接续兴建。这些设施把矿石加工带入河谷，居民同时继续依靠农业。矿山与熔炉的先后发展，展现了一个分散的堂区社会如何把农作、林地资源和金属生产逐渐紧密结合。

english: The waters around Cape Holthusen lie off the islands north of New Guinea in the Bismarck Archipelago. Island coasts and open channels connect this part of the Pacific with New Ireland and the mainland. Dutch navigators Schouten and Le Maire passed through the wider archipelago in 1616 on their westward voyage.
simp_chinese: 霍尔特胡森角周围水域位于新几内亚以北俾斯麦群岛诸岛外。岛岸与开阔水道将这片太平洋与新爱尔兰和大陆连接起来。1616年荷兰航海者斯豪滕与勒梅尔向西航行时经过更广阔的群岛地区。

english: Holzminden grew beside the Weser, where the counts of Everstein built a castle around 1200 and established a town in its shelter. Count Otto confirmed its rights in a charter of 1245. The river linked the settlement to other communities along the Weser, while the nearby Solling woods lay to the east. In 1640, during the Thirty Years' War, imperial troops destroyed and burned Holzminden. Recovery was slow, and for a long time afterwards it remained a small provincial town of farmers and householders.
simp_chinese: 霍尔茨明登兴起于威悉河畔。约1200年，埃弗施泰因伯爵在此建造城堡，并在其庇护下建立城镇；1245年，奥托伯爵以宪章确认了城市权利。河流将聚落与威悉河沿岸其他社区连接起来，东边则是附近的佐林森林。三十年战争期间，帝国军队于1640年摧毁并焚烧霍尔茨明登。此后恢复缓慢，长期以来它仍是一座由小农和住户组成的省镇。

english: Qhom lies among the ranges on the edge of the Tankwa Karoo, near the Roosterberg. Southward, the Doring River passes through the gap at Karoopoort, an entrance to the dry basin. Farther north, routes crossed the mountains towards the Roggeveld plateau. Travellers and stock-keepers used these passages between the Cape and the interior, where scattered springs and watercourses were especially valuable in the arid country.
simp_chinese: 霍姆位于坦夸卡鲁边缘的群山之间，靠近罗斯特山。向南，多林河穿过卡鲁波特隘口，进入干旱盆地；向北的道路则翻越山岭，通往罗赫费尔德高原。旅人与牧民利用这些山道往来于开普与内陆之间，在干旱地区，散布的泉水和河道尤为珍贵。

english: The Xwémalhkwu, or Homalco, belong to Bute Inlet, a long arm of the sea reaching deep between the Coast Mountains. Their country includes the Homathko and Southgate rivers at its head and the sheltered waters around its mouth. Winter villages stood at Aupe and on Sonora Island, while other settlements lay near Orford Bay and the rivers farther inland. Salmon returned to the streams of the inlet, and canoes carried people among the villages and islands of this rugged coast.
simp_chinese: 霍马尔科人自称克韦马尔克乌，故土位于布特湾。这条狭长海湾深入海岸山脉之间，湾底有霍马特科河和南盖特河，湾口周围则是受庇护的水域。奥佩和索诺拉岛上有冬季村落，奥福德湾及内陆河流附近也有其他聚落。鲑鱼洄游至海湾溪流，人们乘独木舟往来于这片崎岖海岸的村落和岛屿之间。

english: Hombori lies at the foot of a dramatic sandstone massif rising above the Sahelian plains south of the Niger bend. The flat-topped heights of Hombori Tondo overlook villages and pasture, while their cliffs shelter traces of much earlier occupation. Songhai-speaking communities settled in the region after the fall of the Songhai empire at the end of the sixteenth century. Their traditions preserve memories of the empire in a landscape shared with pastoralists and other neighbouring peoples.
simp_chinese: 洪博里位于一座壮观的砂岩山地脚下，山体高出尼日尔河大弯以南的萨赫勒平原。平顶的洪博里通多俯瞰村庄与牧场，崖壁间保留着更早居民的痕迹。十六世纪末桑海帝国衰落后，讲桑海语的社群在这一地区定居。他们的传统保存着对帝国的记忆，也与牧民及其他邻近族群共同生活于此。

english: The Hometwoli were a Yokuts people of the southern San Joaquin Valley, whose villages stood around Kern Lake. Their language was a variety of Buena Vista Yokuts, spoken in the southern part of the Tulare Basin. One village, Halau, lay near the channel connecting Kern Lake with Buena Vista Lake. The Kern River fed a network of channels and wetlands here, giving the lakeside communities a homeland shaped by the shifting waters of the valley floor.
simp_chinese: 霍梅特沃利人是圣华金谷地南部的一支约库茨人，村庄分布在克恩湖周围。他们使用布埃纳维斯塔约库茨语的一种方言，这种语言通行于图莱里盆地南部。哈劳村靠近连接克恩湖与布埃纳维斯塔湖的水道。克恩河在这里注入纵横交错的水道与湿地，谷底不断变化的水域塑造了湖畔社群的家园。

english: The Hominka River descends from the Hart Ranges to join the Parsnip, crossing a broad lower valley of marshes and winding channels. Its upper waters support fish including Arctic grayling, while mountain goats inhabit the high country. The river lies in the wider homeland of the Tse’khene, whose families travelled through the Parsnip and upper Peace watersheds, hunting and fishing across the forests and mountain valleys.
simp_chinese: 霍明卡河从哈特山脉流入帕斯尼普河，下游穿过宽阔河谷，河道蜿蜒，湿地密布。上游水域有北极茴鱼等鱼类，高地则有山羊栖息。这条河位于采克内人的广阔家园内；他们的家庭穿行于帕斯尼普河和皮斯河上游流域，在森林和山谷中狩猎捕鱼。

english:
Homs, ancient Emesa, stands near the Orontes where routes from the Syrian interior pass through the gap between the coastal mountains and Lebanon. Its position linked the Mediterranean with the steppe and the road to Damascus. The city was known in antiquity for the sanctuary of the sun god Elagabal, and later became an important centre of Islamic Syria, with markets drawing on the produce of the surrounding plains.

The Ottomans incorporated Homs in 1516. Although it lost some political importance, the town continued to process agricultural and pastoral goods from its district. In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries tribal unrest at times reached the city, and its markets were plundered more than once. In 1832, during the war between the Ottoman Empire and Egypt, Ibrahim Pasha's army fought an Ottoman force near Homs and secured its advance into northern Syria. The city remained a meeting point between settled farmland, the routes to the coast and the desert country to the east.
simp_chinese:
霍姆斯即古代的埃梅萨，位于奥龙特河附近，叙利亚内陆道路在此穿过海岸山脉与黎巴嫩山之间的缺口。它将地中海与东部草原、通往大马士革的道路连接起来。古代此城以太阳神埃拉伽巴勒的圣所闻名，后来成为伊斯兰叙利亚的重要中心，市场汇集周围平原的出产。

奥斯曼人于一五一六年将霍姆斯纳入帝国。虽然政治地位有所下降，城镇仍加工来自辖区的农牧产品。十七至十八世纪，部族动荡有时波及城市，市场不止一次遭到洗劫。一八三二年奥斯曼与埃及交战期间，易卜拉欣帕夏的军队在霍姆斯附近击败奥斯曼军，确保其向叙利亚北部推进。城市依旧处在农田、海岸道路与东部荒漠的交汇处。

english: Hòn La lies near the coast of Quảng Bình, among small islands and headlands on the western side of the Gulf of Tonkin. These islands help shelter the neighbouring bay from the open sea. Southwest of Hòn La, Vũng Chùa offers protection along a coast exposed to the northeast monsoon. The islands and the mountains behind them make distinctive landmarks for vessels following the coast of central Vietnam.
simp_chinese: 昏罗岛位于广平海岸附近，是北部湾西侧小岛与岬角中的一座。这些岛屿帮助邻近海湾遮挡外海风浪。昏罗岛西南的拥朱湾在受东北季风影响的海岸上提供避风处。岛屿及其后方的山地，为沿越南中部海岸航行的船只提供了鲜明地标。

english: Hòn Mê lies off the coast of Thanh Hóa in the Gulf of Tonkin, the largest of a group of small islands near the shore. Wooded slopes rise above the sea, while rocky islets dot the waters around it. The island stands offshore from the narrow coastal plain of northern Vietnam, where rivers descend from inland hills to meet the gulf. Its surrounding waters form part of the route along the Vietnamese coast.
simp_chinese: 昏梅岛位于清化海岸外的北部湾，是近岸一组小岛中最大的一座。有林山坡高出海面，周围海域散布着岩石小岛。岛屿面向越南北部狭长的海岸平原，河流从内陆山地流下，在此注入海湾。周围海域属于沿越南海岸延伸的航路，海岛与海岸相望，是湾内醒目的地理标志。

english:
Honaz lies beneath Mount Cadmus near the upper Lycus valley, southeast of the ancient city of Colossae. In Byzantine times it was known as Chonae and celebrated for a sanctuary of the Archangel Michael. A story told that the archangel saved the church by opening a cleft in the rock to divert a torrent, a miracle represented in Christian art.

Chonae stood on a route linking the Aegean with the Anatolian interior and suffered during the wars of the twelfth century. In 1148 troops of the Second Crusade were attacked in the mountains nearby. Later raids damaged the town and its famous church, which was plundered in 1192. The story of Michael's intervention survived the destruction, keeping Chonae in the memory of pilgrims and icon painters.
simp_chinese:
霍纳兹位于卡德摩斯山下的吕科斯河上游谷地，古城歌罗西在其西北。拜占庭时代这里称为科奈，以大天使米迦勒圣所闻名。传说天使在岩石中打开裂口，引开洪流，拯救了教堂；这一神迹常见于基督教艺术。

科奈位于连接爱琴海与安纳托利亚内陆的道路上，十二世纪战争期间遭受损失。1148年，第二次十字军部队在附近山中受到袭击。后来的劫掠破坏了城镇及其著名教堂，后者于1192年遭到洗劫。米迦勒干预的故事在破坏后继续流传，使科奈留在朝圣者和圣像画家的记忆中。
