The defences were faced with brick and stone in 1468, while further repairs followed floods and periods of conflict. Maintaining the walls drew upon both military labour and contributions from households.

Outside the town, irrigation joined official initiatives with the work of village families. The Yongzheng provincial gazetteer lists numerous weirs and ponds serving Huaiji's fields. It records that the Chen and Kong families built Gandong weir, and that a magistrate promoted Tongjia weir during the Jiajing reign; after a breach near the end of Wanli, another magistrate rebuilt it. Education likewise required repeated rebuilding. In 1801 magistrate Jiang Huan repaired the Confucian temple, moved the Minglun Hall forward and added an academy behind it. Huaiji's institutions thus grew through a succession of practical works on defences, water and schooling.
simp_chinese:
怀集处于广东与广西之间的丘陵县域，明清行政却隶属广西梧州府。县城集中县署、学宫与驻军。1397年设守御千户所并修筑土城；1468年城墙包砌砖石，此后又因洪水与战乱屡次修葺。维护城防既动用军队劳力，也要求居民提供资助。

城外灌溉则结合官府倡导与村民家族的建设。《雍正广西通志》列出许多供怀集田亩用水的陂塘，记载甘洞陂由陈、孔两姓修筑，僮家陂由嘉靖年间知县倡建；万历末年决口后，又由后任知县重筑。学校同样经历反复营建。1801年，知县蒋焕重修文庙，将明伦堂移至前方，并在堂后增建书院，配备讲堂、学舍与斋厨。县域的治理与教化由此落实为一道道具体工程：城防需要军民合作，田地依赖水利维持，学宫与书院则为地方士子提供读书和礼仪活动的场所。

english:
Huailai's importance on the approaches to the Ming capital is visible at Jimingyi, the walled relay station below Jiming Mountain on the north bank of the Yang River. Built in 1420 and repeatedly repaired under the Ming and Qing, it formed an important station serving the Xuanfu frontier command. Official couriers needed fresh horses at intervals, making such installations essential to communication across long distances.

The surviving enclosure combines brick facing with a rammed-earth core. Gates on the east and west carried towers, while corner platforms and projecting wall defenses supported observation and protection. These features gave the relay station the character of a small fortified settlement. Its position brought together the road through the mountains toward Beijing and routes toward the northern frontier. The history of Huailai therefore includes the maintained infrastructure behind imperial communications: walls, gates, horses and a settlement organized to keep travelers and official dispatches moving.
simp_chinese:
怀来在明代京师外围交通中的地位，可以从鸡鸣驿看出。这座驿城位于洋河北岸、鸡鸣山下，建于1420年，明清两代不断续修，是服务宣府边镇的重要驿站。官府文书跨越长距离传递，需要沿途更换马匹，驿站因此成为维持通信的必要设施。

保存下来的城垣外包砖石，内部为夯土，东西两门均设城楼，角台与突出的马面兼顾瞭望和防御。这些设施使驿站具备小型设防聚落的形态。它所处道路连接通向北京的山间通道与北方边地路线，将传递公文、接待过往人员和军事交通集中在同一处空间。怀来的历史因此也包括支撑帝国往来的具体基础设施：城墙、城门、驿马，以及围绕持续传递任务组织起来的聚落。

english:
Huáiníng was the seat county of Ānqìng, the port on the north bank of the Yangtze whose name forms the first half of Ānhuī. The prefecture took the name Ānqìng in 1147, and in 1260 the Yangtze defense commissioner Mǎ Guāngzǔ rebuilt the city walls against the Mongols; from then on prefecture and county shared one city, and the whole urban area lay in Huáiníng until the end of the Qīng. A Yuán route in 1276, it was held against the Red Turbans in 1353, and in 1361 Zhū Yuánzhāng renamed it Níngjiāng before restoring the name Ānqìng the next year.

In 1637, as rebel bands approached, the Míng created a governor for the four prefectures of Ānqìng, Lúzhōu, Chízhōu and Tàipíng, and placed him in Ānqìng, the city's first. The Qīng kept the post, and from 1662 a governor was based here for good. In 1667 Ānhuī became a province with offices still at Jiāngníng, and in 1760 its treasurer's office moved to Ānqìng, making the Huáiníng city a provincial capital.
simp_chinese:
怀宁是安庆府的附郭县，安庆是长江北岸的港口，其名后来成为安徽省名中的“安”字。绍兴十七年（1147年）以“安庆”为府名；景定元年（1260年），沿江制置大使马光祖为防蒙古军复筑安庆城，此后府、县同城而治，城区全部属怀宁，一直延续到清末。元至元十三年（1276年）安庆升为路，至正十三年（1353年）元军倚城抵御红巾军，至正二十一年（1361年）朱元璋改称宁江府，次年复名安庆。

崇祯十年（1637年）七月，因起义军逼近，明廷设安庐巡抚，辖安庆、庐州、池州、太平四府，驻节安庆，这是安庆第一次设巡抚。清沿明制，康熙元年（1662年）起专设巡抚驻安庆。康熙六年（1667年）安徽建省，官署仍寄治江宁，乾隆二十五年（1760年）安徽布政使司移治安庆，怀宁境内的安庆城从此成为省会。

english:
Huairen stood south of Datong on the northern Shanxi plateau. Under the Yuan it belonged to Datong Circuit; in 1369 the Ming placed it under Datong Prefecture, an affiliation retained by the Qing. Its county town formed one of the defended settlements behind the northern frontier, and its local history records repeated investments in walls, gates and military posts.

In 1383 the commander Sang Gui enlarged the old enclosure. Yu Zhong repaired it in 1411, and further works followed in 1465 and 1555. When frontier troops threatened the town in 1570, the magistrate Liu Bangyan and the garrison officer Ye Jiwen heightened the walls and gave the parapets brickwork. A larger brick-and-stone facing project began in 1573 and continued the following year under Yang Shoujie and Di Ran. The county also contained fortified villages and relay facilities, including Xi'an Fort, first established as a post in 1464 and later rebuilt. Huairen's farming hinterland thus supported a landscape of transport and defence, where civil magistrates and military officers repeatedly worked on the same fortifications.
simp_chinese:
怀仁位于大同以南的晋北高原。元代属大同路，1369年明朝将其置于大同府下，清朝继续沿用。县城是北方边境后方的设防聚落之一，地方史反复记载对城墙、城门和军事据点的修建。

1383年，指挥桑桂在旧城基础上增筑；1411年于忠重修，1465年和1555年又有工程。1570年边兵逼城时，知县刘邦彦与守备叶继文增高城墙，并将女墙用砖砌筑。1573年开始规模更大的砖石包城工程，次年由杨守介、邸然继续主持。县境还有村堡和驿传设施，包括1464年作为驿地创建、后来重修的西安堡。怀仁的农业腹地因此支撑着交通与防御交织的景观，文官和武官反复参与同一套城防工程。县城的安全既依靠城垣，也联系周围聚落、驿路与驻军的组织。

english:
Huairou guarded the mountain approaches northeast of Beijing, where routes crossed the ridges of the northern frontier. The Ming re-established the county in 1368, built its earthen county wall in 1381 and founded a county school the following year. From 1403 it belonged to Shuntian Prefecture, the administration surrounding the imperial capital.

The county's military role extended well beyond its town. The passes at Mutianyu, Zhuangdaokou and Nanyekou were completed in 1404; local households were ordered to maintain horses, and quarries supplied stone for the construction of Beijing's palaces. These obligations tied village labour to the capital's defence and building works. Warfare nevertheless reached the district. Huairou suffered during the crisis of 1449, and its walls were rebuilt in brick and stone in 1467. In 1502 officials reduced the oversized circuit to a more defensible eastern section. Religious life also drew patronage: Princess Shunde restored Hongluo Temple in 1437, and the Kangxi emperor visited it in the Qing period. Fortifications, schools and monasteries together made Huairou part of the capital's inhabited and cultivated mountain hinterland.
simp_chinese:
怀柔守着北京东北的山间门户，道路从这里越过北方边地的重岭。明代于1368年重设怀柔县，1381年筑土城，次年建县学；1403年起隶属拱卫京师的顺天府。

地方军事职责远超县城本身。1404年，慕田峪、撞道口和南冶口等关口建成，居民又奉命养马，县内采石场为北京宫室营造供应石材。村落劳动因此同时服务于京城防务和建设。战争也直接波及当地，1449年危机中怀柔遭受兵灾，1467年县城重筑为砖石城。1502年，官员因城大民少，裁去西半部，仅保留较易防守的东部。宗教生活同样受到权贵支持：1437年顺德长公主重修红螺寺，清代康熙帝又曾来访。城防、县学与寺院共同构成怀柔的地方面貌，使山间居民的田地、生计和劳役始终同京师紧密相连。

english:
Huáiyuǎn occupies a meeting of rivers in northern Ānhuī: the Guō joins the Huái here, and Jīng and Tú mountains face each other across the water. Tradition places Yu the Great's gathering of the lords on Tú Mountain. The name dates from 1257, when the Southern Sòng set up Huáiyuǎn Military Prefecture over Jǐngshān County on both banks; the garrison surrendered to the Mongols in February 1276. In January 1291 the Yuán merged it with Jǐngshān into Huáiyuǎn County, under Háozhōu in Ānfēng Circuit.

The county name survived the dynastic change. The early Míng first attached Huáiyuǎn to Yìngtiān Prefecture, then gave it to Fèngyáng; the Qīng kept it there, first in Jiāngnán Province and then in Ānhuī. In 1286 the Yellow River broke out at fifteen places and seized the beds of the Yǐng, Sì, Guō and Huái, so that floods from the north now reached this river crossing.
simp_chinese:
怀远位于安徽北部的重要河流交会处：涡河在此汇入淮河，荆、涂两山隔淮相望。相传大禹曾在涂山会合诸侯。“怀远”之名始于南宋宝祐五年（1257年），朝廷在这里设怀远军，统辖地跨淮河两岸的荆山县；德祐二年（1276年）二月，怀远军向蒙古军队投降。元至元二十八年（1291年）正月，怀远军与荆山县合并为怀远县，隶属安丰路濠州。

县名经朝代更迭保留下来。明初怀远先属应天府，后归凤阳府；清代仍属凤阳府，省级归属先在江南省，后属安徽省。至元二十三年（1286年）黄河在十五处决口，夺颍、泗、涡、淮四河河道入海，北方的洪水从此也冲向这个淮河渡口。

english: Huaiyuan stands above the Lu River in the frontier hills southwest of Yulin. The Ming built Huaiyuan Fort in 1458 as part of the Yulin Garrison's central line, joining other posts that guarded the boundary between the settled valleys and the northern steppe. Its walls occupied a hilltop above the surrounding ground. In 1731 the Qing combined Huaiyuan with four neighbouring forts to create Huaiyuan County, preserving the old military name as the centre of a civil district.
simp_chinese: 怀远位于榆林西南的边地丘陵，俯临芦河。明朝于1458年筑怀远堡，作为榆林卫中路防御的一部分，与其他堡寨共同守卫河谷和北方草原之间的边界。城墙占据高于周围地面的山顶。清雍正九年（1731），朝廷合并怀远及附近四堡设置怀远县，将旧军堡名延续为县名。

english: Huaiyuan lies in the mountains north of Liuzhou, where the Xun and Rong rivers meet. Its county seat moved several times as officials sought to govern a country of scattered communities and difficult terrain. The Ming abolished the county in 1377 and established a patrol office, then restored the county in 1381 under Liuzhou Prefecture. In 1591 the seat moved again, to Danyang on an island in the Rong River.
simp_chinese: 怀远位于柳州以北的山区，浔江与融江在此汇合。群山之间聚落分散，县治也曾多次迁移。1377年，明朝撤怀远县，设三江镇巡检司；1381年复置县，属柳州府。1591年，县治再次迁往融江江岛上的丹阳。

english:
Huajuapan occupied an important place in the Mixtec valley before Spanish rule. Its earlier settlements lay on surrounding slopes, while the area functioned as an economic, cultural and ceremonial centre. Spanish control followed the conquest of Mexico, but surviving colonial records for the district begin only in 1542. The older Indigenous landscape therefore preceded the administrative town that the newcomers later established.

In 1561 viceregal authorities ordered a new town on the valley floor and required inhabitants of Huajuapan and nearby San Andrés Acatima to settle there. During Mexico's independence struggle, royalist forces besieged Huajuapan in 1812. The defenders, led by Valerio Trujano, held out until José María Morelos arrived and helped break the siege on 23 July.
simp_chinese:
西班牙统治以前，瓦胡阿潘已在米斯特克河谷中占据重要位置。较早聚落位于周围山坡，地区具有经济、文化与仪式中心功能。墨西哥征服后，西班牙控制进入当地，但现存殖民记录到1542年才开始。因此，原住民生活格局早于后来建立的行政城镇。

1561年，总督当局下令在谷底建立新镇，要求瓦胡阿潘和附近圣安德烈斯·阿卡蒂马的居民迁入。墨西哥独立战争期间，保王派军队于1812年围攻瓦胡阿潘。巴莱里奥·特鲁哈诺率领守军坚持抵抗，直到何塞·马里亚·莫雷洛斯抵达，协助他们在7月23日解除围困。

english: The valley of Huajuco lies southeast of Monterrey, between the Sierra Madre and the Sierra de la Silla. Its name recalls Guajuco, an Indigenous Guachichil leader whose people lived in the region when Spanish settlers advanced into Nuevo León. Around 1624 Guajuco and his followers attacked the small settlement of Monterrey, killing settlers and taking livestock. In later years Spanish ranches and settlements spread into the valley, which was also known by the Indigenous name Cayucuapa.
simp_chinese: 瓦胡科谷地位于蒙特雷东南方，夹在马德雷山脉与拉西利亚山脉之间。谷地之名使人想起原住民瓜奇奇尔首领瓜胡科；西班牙移民进入新莱昂时，他的族人生活在这一地区。约1624年，瓜胡科率众袭击小镇蒙特雷，杀死部分殖民者并带走牲畜。此后，西班牙牧场和聚落逐渐进入这片谷地；谷地也有卡尤夸帕这一原住民名称。

english:
Hualahuises took its name from the Gualagüises, an Indigenous people of the northeastern Mexican frontier. The colonial settlement developed as the mission of San Cristóbal de los Gualagüises in the middle of the seventeenth century under Governor Martín de Zavala. Mission life brought together Gualagüises, Borrados and Tlaxcalteca settlers, making the community more complex than a simple Spanish foundation narrative suggests.

The municipal account records the mission's destruction in 1693 and a period of abandonment. Subsequent rebuilding restored a religious centre whose eighteenth-century wooden image of Saint Christopher survives as part of its heritage. At the beginning of independent Mexico, San Cristóbal became the municipality of Hualahuises in 1824. Research on its Indigenous community records the transformation of its traditional council into a republican council and the dissolution of communal landholding in 1825–1826. These changes connect its mission past with the reorganisation of government and property during the early republic.
simp_chinese:
瓦拉维塞斯得名于墨西哥东北边疆的原住民瓜拉圭塞斯人。17世纪中叶，在总督马丁·德·萨瓦拉任内，殖民聚落以圣克里斯托瓦尔·德洛斯瓜拉圭塞斯传教站的形式发展。传教站生活汇集了瓜拉圭塞斯、博拉多斯及特拉斯卡拉居民，社群构成远比单纯的西班牙建镇叙述复杂。

市政府记载，传教站于1693年被毁，随后一度荒废。后来的重建恢复了宗教中心，至今留存的18世纪圣克里斯托瓦尔木像也是其历史遗产的一部分。墨西哥独立初期，圣克里斯托瓦尔于1824年成为瓦拉维塞斯自治市。有关原住民社群的研究记载，传统议事机构转为共和国议会，1825至1826年间共同土地所有制被解体。这些变化将传教站时代与共和国初年的政府及财产制度重组连接起来。

english: Off the dry coast of Huarmey, the Pacific receives the waters of valleys descending from the Andes. The Huarmey and Culebras valleys supported settlements long before the Inca conquest; at El Castillo de Huarmey, the Wari built a centre whose tombs contained textiles and precious objects. Later Chimú influence reached this coast, followed by Inca rule. Inland, the Culebras River waters a narrow valley between the surrounding desert slopes.
simp_chinese: 瓦尔梅干旱海岸外，太平洋接纳从安第斯山流下的河谷水流。瓦尔梅与库莱布拉斯河谷在印加征服以前很久便有聚落；瓦里人在瓦尔梅古堡建立中心，墓葬中留下织物和贵重器物。后来奇穆人的影响抵达这片海岸，随后这里又归印加统治。内陆的库莱布拉斯河滋养着荒漠山坡之间狭长的河谷。

english: Huallumarca is a pre-Inca burial site in the mountain country of Pataz, east of the northern Peruvian highlands. Its cemetery is among the traces of communities that inhabited these steep Andean slopes before the expansion of Inca rule. The surrounding valleys descend towards the Marañón, while high ridges separate them from the settlements of Huamachuco and Cajamarca to the west.
simp_chinese: 瓦尤马尔卡是秘鲁北部高地以东帕塔斯山区的一处印加以前的墓地。它是印加扩张之前居住在安第斯陡坡上的社群留下的遗迹之一。周围河谷向马拉尼翁河下降，高耸山脊则将其与西方瓦马丘科及卡哈马卡的聚落分隔开来。

english: Huaman Karpa is associated with the Chanka people of the Andahuaylas region in the southern Peruvian Andes. Chanka communities occupied high valleys and hills west of Cuzco before their incorporation into the Inca realm. Later accounts remembered conflicts between the Chanka and the rising power of Cuzco. Nearby Sóndor, overlooking Lake Pacucha, preserves remains of occupation from Chanka and Inca times and shows the long history of settlement in this mountain country.
simp_chinese: 瓦曼卡尔帕与秘鲁南部安第斯安达韦拉斯地区的昌卡人有关。并入印加领地之前，昌卡社群居住在库斯科以西的高山河谷和丘陵中。后来的记载保存了昌卡人与日益强大的库斯科之间冲突的故事。附近俯瞰帕库查湖的松多尔保存了昌卡和印加时期的遗迹，展现这片山地悠久的定居历史。

english: Huamanpata is a high basin in the forested mountains east of the Utcubamba Valley. Its lake changes markedly with the seasons, expanding over the flat basin when water is abundant and retreating in drier periods. The surrounding country belongs to the eastern Andean slopes, where mountain valleys and wet forests descend towards the rivers of the Amazon basin.
simp_chinese: 万潘帕塔是乌特库班巴河谷以东森林山地中的高山盆地。湖泊随季节显著变化：水量充足时扩展至平坦盆地，干燥时期则退缩。周围属于安第斯东坡，山间河谷和湿润森林向亚马孙流域的河流下降。

english:
Huambo's earlier history belongs to the Ovimbundu kingdom of Wambu on Angola's central plateau. Royal traditions remembered a line of rulers before the kingdom's better-defined emergence around the seventeenth century. The warrior Wambu Kalunga took control without a battle, but his rule did not establish an unbroken new dynasty. Kesonga, a local military leader, killed him and restored the vaNganda royal line.

These traditions give the plateau's past a political centre of its own, with royal succession contested between an incoming warrior and established local leaders. The chronology remains approximate: the kingdom is conventionally placed around 1640, while accounts of earlier kings and queens reach farther back without secure dates.
simp_chinese:
万博较早的历史属于安哥拉中央高原上的翁本杜人王国万布。王室传统记得一系列更早的统治者，但王国较为清晰的形成过程，大致在十七世纪。武士万布·卡伦加未经战斗便掌握王权，却没有建立持续不断的新王朝：当地军事首领凯松加杀死了他，恢复了瓦恩甘达王系。

这些传统呈现了高原自身的政治中心，以及外来武士和既有地方领袖围绕王位展开的争夺。年代仍只能近似判断：王国通常被置于约1640年，而关于更早国王和女王的记忆尚缺可靠日期。

english:
Huambos lay in the northern Peruvian highlands, within a wider Indigenous province that colonial authorities also called Guambos. Its history was reshaped by Spanish religious and administrative expansion during the sixteenth century. Augustinian friars entered the region, and a local history attributes the foundation of San Juan Bautista de Huambos on 24 June 1560 to Fray Juan Ramírez de Taboada, citing the chronicler Antonio de la Calancha.

The colonial province covered a much larger area than the town, including districts later associated with Chota, Santa Cruz and Cutervo. It became subordinate to the corregimiento of Cajamarca, organised in 1565–1566. Indigenous curacas continued to appear in the records as local intermediaries under the new government. The names of town, people and province therefore need to be distinguished: Huambos was both a particular settlement and the centre of a broader historical territory, whose communities encountered missionary work, tribute demands and the division of authority among colonial officials and encomenderos.
simp_chinese:
万博斯位于秘鲁北部高地，属于殖民当局也称作瓜姆博斯的原住民区域。十六世纪，西班牙宗教与行政扩张重塑当地秩序。奥古斯丁会传教士进入此地；地方史援引编年史家安东尼奥·德拉卡兰查，将1560年6月24日建立“圣胡安包蒂斯塔·德万博斯”的行动归于胡安·拉米雷斯·德塔博阿达修士。

殖民时期的万博斯省远大于城镇本身，涵盖后来与乔塔、圣克鲁斯和库特尔沃相关的地区，并受1565至1566年组建的卡哈马尔卡司法辖区管辖。记录中的原住民库拉卡继续作为地方中介出现。因此，万博斯的族群、区域和城镇含义需要区分：它既是具体聚落，也是广阔历史地域的中心，周边社群共同面对传教、贡赋，以及官员和委托监护主之间的权力分配。

english: Huamelula lies near the Pacific coast of Oaxaca, where rivers descend from the mountains towards the sea. It was one of the Chontal lordships of the coastal region, alongside Astata and Mazatlán. Chontal communities occupied both the coast and the mountain valleys to the north. Archaeological remains along the Huamelula River testify to a long history of settlement before Spanish colonial rule.
simp_chinese: 瓦梅卢拉位于瓦哈卡太平洋海岸附近，河流从群山流向大海。它是沿海琼塔尔领地之一，与阿斯塔塔和马萨特兰并列。琼塔尔社群居住在海岸及北方山谷，瓦梅卢拉河沿岸的考古遗存见证了西班牙殖民统治之前悠久的居民历史。

english:
The Huamelula coast belongs to the Pacific shore of Oaxaca, where fishing settlements stood between the sea and the mountains of southern Mexico. Coastal communities used marine produce while cultivating suitable land near streams and valleys. Canoes and shore paths connected neighbouring settlements, and inland routes carried goods toward larger markets.

Salt, fish and other coastal products could be exchanged for materials produced at higher elevations, joining distinct environments within a regional economy. Before Spanish conquest, Oaxaca contained a diverse political world of local rulers and communities with different languages. Coastal peoples maintained their own identities while interacting with powerful neighbours and broader Mesoamerican trading networks. Spanish colonial government introduced tribute demands, Christian institutions and new forms of landholding.

Indigenous communities nevertheless continued to organise local life, defend communal interests and adapt religious practices. The Pacific coast also formed part of the larger maritime setting connecting New Spain with overseas commerce, although most everyday exchange remained local or regional. Along Huamelula's wider shores, farming, fishing and community relationships remained closely linked to the seasonal patterns of rain and sea.
simp_chinese:
瓦梅卢拉海岸属于墨西哥南部瓦哈卡的太平洋岸，渔业聚落分布在海洋与山地之间。居民利用海产，也在溪流和河谷附近适宜土地上耕作。独木舟与沿岸小径连接邻近聚落，内陆道路把货物送往较大市场。

盐、鱼和其他沿海产品可以换取较高地区出产的材料，使不同环境成为相互补充的区域经济。西班牙征服以前，瓦哈卡由地方统治者和使用不同语言的社群构成多样政治世界。沿海族群保持自身身份，同时同强邻及美索美洲贸易网络互动。

西班牙殖民政府引入贡赋要求、基督教机构和新的土地安排，原住民社群仍继续组织地方生活、维护共同利益，并调整宗教习俗。太平洋岸也处于连接新西班牙与海外商业的广阔海洋环境中，不过日常交换大多发生在本地或区域范围。瓦梅卢拉周边海岸的耕作、捕鱼和社群关系，始终同雨季及海洋的季节节律紧密相连。

english:
Huamual, also called Hoamoal, is the western peninsula of Seram, across the water from Ambon. Its clove gardens and Muslim coastal communities made it an important part of the spice trade. Local leaders maintained ties with Ternate, whose noble Tomagola family held authority in this part of the central Moluccas.

In the seventeenth century the Dutch East India Company sought to monopolize cloves and exclude other buyers from the clove-growing districts of the Moluccas. The restrictions and demands for labor provoked prolonged resistance in Huamual and neighboring Hitu. Dutch campaigns eventually broke the power of the peninsula's leaders, and by 1656 the Tomagola base there had been lost. The struggle transformed a region whose prosperity had rested on its connections with many merchants.
simp_chinese:
华慕阿尔又称霍阿莫阿尔，是塞兰岛西部的半岛，与安汶隔海相望。丁香园和穆斯林沿海社群使这里成为香料贸易的重要地区。地方首领与特尔纳特保持联系，其贵族托马戈拉家族曾在摩鹿加中部这一带掌握权力。

十七世纪，荷兰东印度公司试图垄断丁香并将其他买家排除在摩鹿加的丁香产区之外。贸易限制和劳役要求引发华慕阿尔与邻近希图的长期抵抗。荷兰的军事行动最终打破半岛首领的力量，到1656年托马戈拉家族已失去这里的据点。这场斗争改变了一个繁荣曾依靠众多商人往来的地区。

english: The lagoons of Guanacache formed a chain of lakes and marshes in the dry country east of the Andes. Fed by the Mendoza and San Juan rivers, they sustained Huarpe communities along their shores. People fished the waters and travelled among the lagoons in craft made from bundled reeds. Floods also watered the surrounding land, where soils could be cultivated as the waters receded. The wetlands offered a rich contrast to the arid plains around them.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳卡切湖群位于安第斯山脉以东干旱地带，由相连的湖泊和沼泽构成。门多萨河与圣胡安河为湖群供水，养育了沿岸的瓦尔佩社群。居民在水中捕鱼，乘坐芦苇扎成的舟筏穿行湖间。洪水还浇灌周围土地，水退后土壤可供耕作。这片湿地与周围干旱的平原形成鲜明对照。

english: On the eastern slopes of the Andes, Huancachaca lies near the cloud forests above the Utcubamba valley. The Yumbilla waterfall descends in four great stages through the forest near Cuispes; farther south, Gocta falls from another steep mountainside. Across the valley at Karajía, Chachapoya people placed tall human-shaped sarcophagi on a cliff ledge, high above the settlements and fields below.
simp_chinese: 万卡查卡位于安第斯东坡，靠近乌特库班巴河谷上方的云雾森林。昆比利亚瀑布在库伊斯佩斯附近的林中分四级倾泻，更南方另一处陡峭山坡上则有戈克塔瀑布。河谷对岸的卡拉希亚，查查波亚人将高大的人形石棺安放在悬崖岩架上，俯瞰下方的聚落和田地。

english:
Huancapampa lay in the highlands of northern Peru, in the country later known as Huancabamba. Together with Caxas and Ayabaca, it belonged to the lands of the Guayacundos before Inca expansion. The Inca organized the region into administrative divisions and established centres along the mountain roads. Caxas, to the north, combined local occupation with an Inca provincial centre, showing the integration of these high valleys into a wider empire.

In 1532, as Francisco Pizarro advanced toward Cajamarca, he heard that Atahualpa had taken Huancapampa and Caxas from the forces of Huáscar. The news came amid the struggle between the two Inca rulers, on the eve of the Spanish encounter with Atahualpa. The valleys of Huancabamba thus lay within both the northern Inca road system and the theatre of the empire's final civil war.
simp_chinese:
万卡潘帕位于秘鲁北部高地，即后来称为万卡班巴的地区。印加扩张之前，它与卡哈斯、阿亚瓦卡同属瓜亚昆多人土地。印加人将这一地区划为多个行政单位，并沿山路建立中心。北面的卡哈斯既有当地聚落，也成为印加行省中心，显示这些高山谷地已被纳入更广阔的帝国。

1532年弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗向卡哈马卡进军时，听闻阿塔瓦尔帕已从瓦斯卡尔势力手中夺取万卡潘帕和卡哈斯。消息传来之时，两位印加统治者正争夺帝国，西班牙人与阿塔瓦尔帕的相遇也迫在眉睫。万卡班巴河谷因此既处于印加北方道路网络之内，也位于帝国最后一场内战的舞台上。

english:
The Huancavilca Gulf opens onto the Pacific around the approaches to Guayaquil, where sea routes meet the Guayas river system. Before Spanish conquest, coastal societies carried goods on sailing balsa rafts, linking the gulf, neighbouring shores and river settlements. These craft remained useful after Europeans arrived, preserving an Indigenous maritime technology within the changing colonial economy.

Guayaquil developed upstream as a major Spanish Pacific shipbuilding centre. Its river access joined the gulf to timber supplies and the markets of the interior, while seagoing vessels carried commerce along the coast. The same entrances exposed the port to raiders: English and French buccaneers looted Guayaquil in 1687, and English privateers returned in 1709. Enslaved and free workers laboured together in the shipyards during the later colonial period. In 1820 Guayaquil declared independence from Spain; its port and the gulf's shipping routes then passed into the struggles surrounding the creation of the new South American republics.
simp_chinese:
万卡比尔卡湾向太平洋敞开，瓜亚基尔的进港航路在这里同瓜亚斯河水系相接。西班牙征服以前，沿海社会使用装帆的轻木筏运货，连接海湾、邻近海岸与河流聚落。欧洲人到来后，这类船筏仍继续使用，使原住民航海技术在变化中的殖民经济内延续。

上游的瓜亚基尔发展为西班牙在太平洋的重要造船中心。河道把海湾同木材产地、内陆市场相连，海船则承担沿岸贸易。这些入口同样为袭击者提供通道：英法海盗于1687年劫掠瓜亚基尔，英国私掠船又在1709年到来。殖民时期后期，船厂内有被奴役者和自由劳工共同工作。1820年，瓜亚基尔宣布脱离西班牙独立，港口及海湾航路随后卷入南美新共和国建立过程中的斗争。

english: Huandacareo lies near the western shore of Lake Cuitzeo in the highlands of Michoacán. Its name in Purépecha is associated with speaking, judgement and the place of a tribunal. The nearby site of La Nopalera was an important public centre within the Purépecha realm. Its buildings served administration and ritual, and leaders were buried there; it was not simply a large residential town.
simp_chinese: 万达卡雷奥位于米却肯高地奎采奥湖西岸附近。其普雷佩查语名称与演说、审判及法庭有关。附近的拉诺帕莱拉遗址是普雷佩查领土内的重要公共中心，建筑用于行政和仪式，也埋葬着领袖；它并非仅仅是一处大型居住聚落。

english:
Huang'an was created in 1563 from parts of Macheng, Huanggang and Huangpi, after more than twenty years of petitions to establish a new county at Jiangjiafan. Supporters argued that the district lay too far from existing magistrates and suffered from robbery, unpaid taxes and unresolved lawsuits. Opponents questioned the cost of new walls, offices and official salaries, as well as the disruption of established jurisdictions.

Local gentry played a central role. Geng Dingxiang pursued the proposal through relationships with provincial and central officials, while other residents promised money and labour. Governor Zhang Yu submitted the successful request in 1562, and imperial approval followed the next spring. Establishing the county did not settle every dispute. Its boundaries required another joint survey in 1569. Huang'an's formation thus joined the court's wish for closer administration to local efforts to gain security and influence, with land, revenue and family interests contested throughout the process.
simp_chinese:
黄安于1563年析麻城、黄冈、黄陂三县部分土地设立，此前在姜家畈建县的呈请已持续二十余年。支持者称当地远离旧县官署，盗患、欠税与积讼难治；反对者担忧城墙、官署、俸禄开支，以及重划辖区造成的扰动。

地方士绅发挥关键作用。耿定向借助省级及中央官员关系推动方案，其他居民承诺出资出力。巡抚张雨于1562年上疏，翌春获准。建县仍未解决全部争议，1569年又须联合勘定辖界。因此，黄安的形成将朝廷加强治理的愿望，与地方谋求安全和影响力的行动结合起来，土地、赋税及宗族利益贯穿其间。

english:
Huangcaoba was the settlement around which the later county town of Xingyi developed in southwestern Guizhou. It lay within the southern country of Pu'an, where indigenous chiefly jurisdictions, military posts and regular officials overlapped. Xu Xiake passed through in 1638 and recorded the surrounding limestone landscape, leaving a description distinct from later accounts of the modern city.

Qing administration progressively strengthened its presence. A Pu'an departmental official was stationed at Huangcaoba, and a stone enclosure was built in the 1740s. The settlement became an important point in the border country linking Guizhou with Yunnan and Guangxi. Following the disturbances of the 1790s, Xingyi County was established at Huangcaoba in 1798. Its county seat was distinct from the seat of the larger Xingyi Prefecture.
simp_chinese:
黄草坝是贵州西南部后来兴义县城发展起来的聚落。它位于普安南部地区，地方土目辖地、军营与常规官员的管辖曾交错并存。徐霞客于1638年经过这里，记述周围石灰岩景观，留下有别于后来现代城市介绍的观察。

清代行政机构逐步加强地方存在。普安州判驻黄草坝，18世纪40年代又修筑石城。聚落成为连接贵州、云南与广西边地的重要地点。经历18世纪90年代动乱后，1798年在黄草坝设立兴义县。这里是县治，与较大的兴义府府治并非同一地点。

english: Huanggang was the county seat shared with Huangzhou’s prefectural administration, rather than the full extent of the much larger prefecture. In 1364, Huangzhou was reorganized from a Yuan circuit into a prefecture under Zhu Yuanzhang’s government. Huanggang remained its seat through the Ming and Qing periods. Early Ming boundary changes brought Qizhou and its associated counties into the wider jurisdiction; in 1729, Huangpi was transferred to Hanyang, reducing the prefecture’s territory without moving its headquarters. County boundaries also changed. The creation of Huang’an in 1563 drew territory from Huanggang, Huangpi and Macheng after repeated discussions about the difficulty of administering their distant borderlands. These adjustments show a regional centre whose responsibilities reached well beyond its own county. Huanggang’s local history therefore includes both the continuity of an administrative seat and the repeated reshaping of the rural districts governed around it.
simp_chinese: 黄冈县治与黄州府治同城，不能将本县直接等同于范围更大的整个黄州府。1364年，朱元璋政权将元代黄州路改为黄州府，黄冈在明清时期持续作为府治所在地。明初的区划调整将蕲州及相关县份纳入这一较大的管辖范围；1729年，黄陂改隶汉阳，黄州府辖境缩小，但府治没有迁动。县界本身也曾变化。1563年设置黄安县，从黄冈、黄陂、麻城划出土地；此前，官员曾反复讨论三县边远交界地带难以治理的问题。这些调整说明，黄冈作为区域行政中心，承担着超出本县范围的职责。其地方历史既包含府县治所的延续，也包含周边乡村行政地域的不断重组。

english: Huánglóng lies beside the Dǔ River in the mountains of northwestern Húběi. A town grew here in the late Míng and early Qīng, where riverboats could travel upstream toward Zhúshān and Zhúxī or downstream toward the Hàn. Its streets and landings served a mountain country whose valleys were joined by the river.
simp_chinese: 黄龙位于湖北西北山地的堵河畔。明末清初，这里逐渐形成集镇；船只可溯河而上至竹山、竹溪，也可顺流通向汉江。街巷和码头服务于河流串联的山谷地区。

english: Huángméi lies north of the Yangtze near the eastern edge of Húběi. Its East Mountain became a centre of Chan Buddhism under the Táng: the fifth patriarch Hóngrěn established a monastery there in 654 and taught disciples including Huìnéng. The temple and the traditions surrounding its teachers made Huángméi an enduring place of pilgrimage.
simp_chinese: 黄梅位于长江以北、湖北东部。唐代，东山成为禅宗中心：五祖弘忍于654年建寺，在此传法，慧能等弟子也在此受学。寺院和祖师故事使黄梅成为长久以来的佛教圣地。

english:
Huangpi was a county north of the Yangtze, with its seat at Qianchuan beside the She River. In the Ming it belonged to Huangzhou Prefecture. That affiliation survived the dynasty's fall, but in 1729 the Qing transferred Huangpi to Hanyang Prefecture, bringing its administration into a different relationship with the river cities to the south.

The county also maintained a distinctive memory of the Cheng brothers, Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi, whose childhood was associated with Huangpi. Later generations commemorated these formative figures of Neo-Confucian learning through shrines and the Shuangfeng Pavilion at Lutai Hill. The pavilion's name drew on the story of two phoenixes appearing in their mother's dream. Built in the Ming and rebuilt in the Qing, the monument gave scholarly ancestry a visible place in the county landscape, joining local identity to an intellectual tradition honoured throughout imperial China.
simp_chinese:
黄陂是长江以北的县份，县治前川位于滠水河畔。明代隶属黄州府，这一归属延续至清初；1729年，清朝将黄陂划入汉阳府，使县级行政与南方江河城市的关系发生改变。

黄陂也保存着与程颢、程颐兄弟相关的独特记忆，二人的童年与这里相连。后世以祠堂和鲁台山双凤亭纪念这两位理学先驱。亭名取自其母梦见双凤的传说，地方人通过碑刻和建筑，将学术人物的身世留在可见的山水中。明代兴建、清代重建的亭子，使乡土认同与受到帝国普遍尊崇的思想传统相接，也为日常县城景观增添了纪念先贤的空间。

english:
Huangping belonged to the mountain country on Bozhou's southeastern approaches. Under the Yuan it was organised as a prefecture; the early Ming replaced that institution with a pacification office subordinate to Bozhou. Huangping consequently formed part of a political landscape in which hereditary local authorities held recognised positions within an imperial framework.

The decisive change came with the Ming campaign against Bozhou in 1600. In 1601 the court abolished the Bozhou administration and divided its territory between the new prefectures of Zunyi and Pingyue. The former Huangping pacification office became Huangping Zhou under Pingyue, now attached to Guizhou. These changes replaced the older hierarchy with a system of appointed officials. They also show why present provincial boundaries should not be projected unchanged into earlier centuries: Huangping had previously belonged to a Bozhou establishment associated with Sichuan. Its history includes a specific transfer of jurisdiction and administrative authority alongside the continuity of communities living among the hills and river valleys.
simp_chinese:
黄平位于播州东南方向的山地。元代设府，明初改设隶属播州的安抚司。因此，黄平属于世袭地方权威在帝国框架内拥有正式地位的政治环境。

决定性的变化来自1600年的平播之战。1601年，朝廷撤除播州建置，将其地域分为遵义、平越两府。原黄平安抚司改为平越府下的黄平州，转隶贵州。这些调整以朝廷任命官员的治理体系取代旧有层级，也说明不能将今天的省界原样推到更早时代：黄平此前属于同四川相联系的播州建置。其历史因而既包括山地与河谷社群的长期延续，也包括一次具体的管辖关系和行政权力转移。

english:
Huangqihai lies in the transition between the northern Chinese farming country and the grasslands of Inner Mongolia. Its basin offered water and grazing within a landscape whose rainfall could vary greatly between seasons and years. Lakeside produce mattered to people moving animals as well as those cultivating suitable ground.

Routes across this country connected the approaches to Datong with the steppe, making environmental knowledge important to merchants, soldiers, and pastoral communities. During the later medieval and early later centuries, the wider frontier experienced the changing relationship between Chinese dynasties and Mongol powers. Under the Ming, defensive lines, garrisons, and regulated markets sought to manage both conflict and exchange.

Horses and livestock could move toward agricultural districts, while grain and manufactured goods traveled in return. The Qing incorporation of Mongolia created a different political framework, using banner institutions and administrative distinctions to organize populations and land. Huangqihai's regional history therefore links a modest inland lake with the larger frontier economy, where water, pasture, cultivation, and the terms of cross-border contact repeatedly shaped political decisions.
simp_chinese:
黄旗海位于中国北方农耕地区与内蒙古草原之间的过渡地带。湖盆在降雨随季节和年份显著变化的环境中，提供水源与放牧条件。湖边资源既对赶牲畜迁移的人群重要，也支持利用适宜土地耕种的居民。

穿越这里的道路把大同外围同草原连接起来，因此环境知识对商人、军队和牧民都有价值。水源分布始终影响移动与停留的位置。中世纪后期至近代早期，更广阔的边疆经历中原王朝与蒙古势力之间不断变化的关系。明代通过防线、驻军和受管理的市场，试图同时应对冲突与交换。

马匹及牲畜流向农业地区，粮食和制成品则反向进入草原。清朝将蒙古纳入帝国之后，以旗制及行政区分组织人口与土地，建立另一种政治框架。黄旗海的地区历史因此把一片内陆湖泊同更大规模的边疆经济联系起来，水、牧草、耕作以及跨边界接触的条件，反复影响政治安排和地方生活。

english:
Huangxian belonged to Dengzhou prefecture from 1376, when Dengzhou was raised to prefectural rank. In the county town, the rise of the Ding family gives a more intimate view of the local economy. The family moved here from Zhucheng in the early Ming and accumulated wealth through pawnbroking, banking and landholding.

Its prosperity increased markedly during the Qianlong reign. Business wealth was reinforced by descendants who studied for the examinations and entered official service. The family became known as Ding Baiwan, and its courtyard residences made this success visible in the centre of old Huangxian. The surviving buildings belong to a longer process of family construction and expansion, joining commercial capital, landed property and scholarly ambition in the same urban setting.
simp_chinese:
1376年登州升府后，黄县隶属登州府。县城丁氏家族的兴起，则为地方经济提供了更具体的侧面。丁氏于明初从诸城迁来，凭借当铺、钱庄与土地经营积累财富。

乾隆年间，家业显著壮大；子孙又通过科举入仕，使商业财富得到官宦身份的加强。家族由此以“丁百万”著称，旧黄县中心的四合院宅居，也把这种成就呈现于城市空间之中。留存建筑属于家族长期营建扩展的成果，将商业资本、田产与读书仕进的抱负联系在同一处地方社会里。

english:
Huangyan belonged to the Taizhou country of coastal Zhejiang. Raised from a county to a zhou in 1295 under the Yuan, it returned to county status in 1369 under the Ming and remained associated with Taizhou. Its cultivated landscape included the citrus-growing country around Duanjiang and the Yongning River.

Citrus production brought both recognition and burdens. Yuan tribute requirements amounted to more than twenty thousand fruits annually, while official abuses and taxation placed pressure on orchard households. The industry recovered toward the end of the dynasty. During the Wanli reign, a local account described extensive citrus gardens outside the town's southwestern walls, with several hundred households depending on them for food and clothing. Markets for Huangyan's fruit developed during the Yuan and Ming periods. Orchards, court demands and commercial exchange thus connected the county's farmers with institutions and consumers well beyond the river plain.
simp_chinese:
黄岩属于浙江沿海台州地区，元代1295年由县升州，明代1369年恢复县制，隶属台州府。断江及永宁江一带的柑橘园，是地方耕作景观的重要组成部分。

柑橘生产既带来声名，也承受贡赋压力。元代每年贡柑二万余颗，官吏舞弊与赋税又加重园户负担，直到元末橘业逐渐恢复。万历年间，地方记述称县城西南墙外遍布柑橘园，有数百家依靠橘业维持衣食。元明以后，黄岩果品市场也渐具规模。果园、宫廷需求与商品交换，因而把河流平原上的种植户同更远的机构和消费者连接起来，形成地方经济延续的一条线索。

english:
Huantajaya was a silver-mining district in the desert hills above the Pacific coast of Tarapacá. Its rich veins lay near Iquique, in a landscape where fresh water and fuel were scarce. Ore from the mines was carried inland for processing, linking the coastal desert with settlements and labor networks in the Andean valleys.

Mining was already recorded in the early Spanish period, but the workings gained renewed importance in the eighteenth century. Their revival increased demand for labor, including workers recruited through the colonial mita. Silver production made Huantajaya a major part of Tarapacá’s economy, while the movement of ore, supplies and workers connected the mines to the wider colonial administration. By the early nineteenth century miners were also reworking material left from earlier operations.
simp_chinese:
万塔哈亚是塔拉帕卡太平洋海岸上方沙漠丘陵中的银矿区。丰富的矿脉位于伊基克附近，所在地区淡水和燃料都很稀少。矿石被运往内陆加工，将沿海沙漠与安第斯谷地的聚落和劳工网络连接起来。

西班牙统治初期已有这里采矿的记载，但矿场在十八世纪重新兴盛。复苏增加了劳动力需求，其中包括通过殖民米塔制度征调的工人。银矿生产使万塔哈亚成为塔拉帕卡经济的重要组成部分，矿石、物资和工人的流动则将矿场与更广泛的殖民行政网络连接起来。到十九世纪初，矿工也重新处理早期作业留下的废石。

english: Off Pisco, the Chincha and Ballestas islands rise from the cool waters of the Humboldt Current. Peruvian boobies, guanay cormorants and other seabirds feed in this productive sea and nest on the dry islands. Their accumulated guano was valued as fertiliser by the people of the Chincha valleys before the Inca conquest. Boats carried this resource from the islands to fields on the arid mainland.
simp_chinese: 皮斯科外海，钦查群岛与巴列斯塔斯群岛从洪堡洋流的冷水中升起。秘鲁鲣鸟、冠鸬鹚等海鸟在富饶海域觅食，在干燥岛屿上筑巢。印加征服以前，钦查河谷的居民已珍视岛上堆积的鸟粪，用它为田地施肥。船只将这种资源从岛屿运往干旱大陆的农田。

english: Huanzhou stood on the grasslands west of the Yuan summer capital, Shangdu. The prefecture originated under the Jin and was restored under the Yuan in 1265. When Kublai ordered a new city built on the Jinlianchuan plain, his adviser Liu Bingzhong selected a site east of the old Huanzhou town; the new city became Shangdu. Huanzhou also lay along the network of postal stations connecting the Yuan capitals.
simp_chinese: 桓州位于元代夏都上都以西的草原上，始置于金代，1265年在元朝恢复建置。忽必烈下令在金莲川营建新城时，刘秉忠选中了桓州旧城以东的地点，新城后来成为上都。桓州也是连接元朝两都的驿站之一。

english: Huánzhōu lies on the Huán River in the dry uplands north of Qìngyáng, where the river winds south through loess hills and narrow valleys before joining waters that form the Mǎlián. During the Song this district faced the Western Xia frontier and gave its name, with Qìngzhōu, to the Huánqìng circuit, which Fàn Zhòngyān commanded in the 1040s; a chain of forts, such as Sweet Water Fort, guarded the approaches. Under the Ming the old Zhou became Huán County, governed from Qingyang. Its position between the cultivated valleys and the northern frontier ensured that roads and fortified posts remained important to the district.
simp_chinese: 环州位于庆阳以北干燥高地上的环河流域。河水蜿蜒南流，穿过黄土丘陵和狭窄谷地，最后与其他水流汇成马莲河。宋代这里面对西夏边界，与庆州一起成为环庆路得名之处，范仲淹在1040年代曾统领此路；甜水堡一类的寨堡守卫着通道。明代旧环州改为环县，隶属庆阳府；它处在耕作河谷与北方边地之间，道路和城堡对地方始终重要。

english:
Huarco occupied the lower Cañete Valley on Peru's arid central coast, where irrigated fields met a rich Pacific fishing ground. Cerro Azul was one of its principal coastal settlements. Noble households organized the drying and storage of fish for inland exchange, receiving crops and dried camelid meat in return. The economy joined specialist fishing communities with farming villages rather than requiring every household to produce all its own food.

In the fifteenth century Inca expansion threatened this valley society. Defensive works protected several important places: Ungará guarded the intake of Huarco's main irrigation canal, while Cerro Azul built a wall on its landward side. The Incas first secured the neighbouring upper-valley polity of Lunahuaná, establishing a military and storage centre at Inkawasi. From there they attacked the lower valley through repeated campaigns. Once Huarco was subdued, new Inca buildings and the coastal road connected it more closely with imperial administration. The sea, canals and storehouses that had supported local authority now also supplied the demands of a wider state. Earlier residences and production areas nevertheless preserved the material traces of a distinctive coastal society.
simp_chinese:
瓦尔科位于秘鲁干旱中部海岸的卡涅特河下游，灌溉田地与丰饶的太平洋渔场相接。塞罗阿苏尔是其重要沿海聚落，贵族家族组织鱼货晒干、储存并运往内陆，换回农产与干制驼科兽肉。专门捕鱼的社区因此与农业村落互相供给。

十五世纪印加扩张威胁河谷社会，多处要地修筑防御。温加拉保护主要灌渠的取水口，塞罗阿苏尔也在面向陆地的一侧建墙。印加先占邻近上游的卢纳瓦纳，在印卡瓦西设立军事与仓储中心，随后以此为基地反复进攻下游。瓦尔科被征服后，新建的印加建筑和沿海大道使它更紧密地接入帝国行政。原先支撑地方权力的海域、灌渠与仓库，也开始服务于更大国家的需要。旧居址和生产区则留下了这一独特沿海社会的物质痕迹，显示当地经济在征服之前已经具有明确的分工与交换关系。

sources.title: Proyecto Qhapaq Ñan - Rutas ancestrales del Qhapaq Ñan.pdf

english: Off the central Peruvian coast lies the Cañete valley, home of the Huarco polity and the fishing settlement of Cerro Azul. Its people drew food from the Pacific and cultivated fields watered by canals from the Cañete River. In the fifteenth century the Inca advanced down the valley under Topa Inca Yupanqui. Huarco communities fortified Cerro Azul and the canal head at Ungará; their resistance continued for several years before the Inca conquest.
simp_chinese: 秘鲁中部海岸的卡涅特河谷，是瓦尔科政权与塞罗阿苏尔渔村的所在地。居民从太平洋获取食物，也利用卡涅特河引来的渠水耕种田地。十五世纪，印加人在托帕·印加·尤潘基率领下沿河谷推进。瓦尔科人在塞罗阿苏尔和灌渠入口翁加拉筑防，抵抗持续数年，最终仍被印加征服。

english: The Huari people inhabited the central Conchucos region, east of the Cordillera Blanca in northern Peru. Their communities occupied valleys and mountain slopes around places such as Huari and Huántar. Local traditions distinguished groups associated with the valley from highland herders known as Llakwash. In the fifteenth century the Inca incorporated the region into their empire, adding imperial roads and administrative arrangements to an older landscape of settlements and sacred places.
simp_chinese: 瓦里人居住在秘鲁北部科迪勒拉布兰卡山脉以东的孔丘科斯中部。他们的社群分布在瓦里、万塔尔等地周围的河谷与山坡。地方传统区分了与河谷有关的群体和称为利亚夸什的高地牧人。十五世纪，印加人将这一地区纳入帝国，在古老聚落与圣地构成的土地上增添帝国道路和行政制度。

english:
Huarmey lies in an irrigated valley on Peru's dry Pacific coast, where river water sustains fields between the desert and the sea. Fishing complemented cultivation, and the lower valley had supported substantial communities long before the Inca and Spanish conquests. The Castillo de Huarmey, east of the town, preserves an earlier Wari imperial burial centre, showing the depth of elite power established in this coastal landscape.

Under Spanish rule Huarmey belonged to the corregimiento of Santa. Local municipal history records its assignment as an encomienda to Nuño de Ávila in 1576 and Muñoz de Ávila in 1578. Archbishop Toribio de Mogrovejo visited on 20 August 1593 and counted one hundred tribute-paying Indigenous people, ten exempt people and about five hundred inhabitants of all ages, with three cattle estates attached to the settlement. These figures reveal both a parish community and the fiscal categories through which colonial authorities viewed it. Fields, fisheries and livestock establishments gave the valley several sources of subsistence while tribute and ecclesiastical supervision connected it with the institutions of colonial Peru.
simp_chinese:
瓦尔梅位于秘鲁干燥太平洋海岸的一处灌溉河谷，河水在沙漠与大海之间维系田地，捕鱼则补充农业生产。早在印加及西班牙征服之前，河谷下游已经存在规模可观的社群。城东的瓦尔梅堡保存着更早瓦里帝国的精英墓葬中心，显示这一海岸地带长期以来拥有集中的上层权力。

西班牙统治时期，瓦尔梅属于圣塔督辖区。地方政府历史材料记载，1576年此地授予努尼奥·德·阿维拉为委托监护地，1578年又归穆尼奥斯·德·阿维拉。1593年8月20日，总主教托里维奥·德·莫格罗韦霍巡访时，记录了一百名纳贡原住民、十名豁免者以及老少合计约五百人，另有三处附属牧牛庄园。这些数字既呈现堂区社群，也体现殖民官员按贡赋身份区分居民的方式。耕地、渔业与畜牧庄园共同维持河谷生计，贡赋及教会监督则将其接入殖民地制度。

english:
Huarochirí lay in the highlands east of Lima, where local communities maintained religious practices and narratives through the transformations of Inca and Spanish rule. Around 1608 anonymous Indigenous narrators and a Quechua-literate compiler recorded an extensive account of the region's sacred beings, rituals and community histories. The resulting manuscript brought different voices together in thirty-one chapters and additional material.

The text was connected with Francisco de Ávila, a priest who investigated Indigenous religious practices and became involved in campaigns to suppress them. Its preservation therefore reflects both local efforts to describe inherited knowledge and the coercive interests of colonial Christianity. Spanish paraphrases and comments accompanied the Quechua narratives, giving the collection more than one perspective. Huarochirí's early colonial history was thus recorded through an encounter over ritual authority, in which writing preserved accounts of traditions that ecclesiastical investigators sought to eliminate.
simp_chinese:
瓦罗奇里位于利马以东高地，当地社群在印加和西班牙统治变动中延续宗教实践与叙事。约1608年，匿名原住民讲述者与通晓克丘亚文的编写者，记录了区域神圣存在、仪式和社群历史，形成由三十一章及补充材料组成的手稿，汇集不同声音。

文本与教士弗朗西斯科·德·阿维拉相关；他调查原住民宗教，并参与压制这些实践的行动。手稿得以保存，因此同时反映地方居民对传承知识的描述，以及殖民基督教的强制意图。克丘亚语叙事旁还有西班牙语转述与评论，使整部文献包含不止一种视角。当地殖民早期历史由此通过围绕仪式权威的相遇进入文字，保存下教会调查者试图消除的传统记述。

english:
Huarong stands on the Huarong River north of Lake Dongting, in a low country of waterways and fields. Its county town, also called Rongcheng, grew across the river. Along the lake margin, people enclosed silted land with embankments, creating fields in a landscape where the boundaries between water and cultivation could change.

By the time the county gazetteer was revised in 1612, six embanked tracts had been formed around Huangpeng and neighbouring lands. Around 1602 the playwright Tang Xianzu visited a friend in Huarong and, accompanied by the magistrate, went to see the work at Gongcheng Lake. Enclosure continued under the Qing as lakeside counties expanded their protected fields.
simp_chinese:
华容位于洞庭湖北面的低地，县城横跨华容河，又称容城。湖滨水道纵横，人们围筑堤垸，将淤积的土地辟为田地，耕地与水面的界限也随之变化。

到1612年县志修订时，黄蓬及附近已有六处围垸。约在1602年前后，戏曲家汤显祖到华容访友，在知县陪同下察看了宫城湖边的筑垸工程。清代，沿湖各县继续修堤围田，湖区耕地不断扩展。

english:
The Huasco valley descends from the Andes through the dry north of Chile towards the Pacific. Its river and tributaries support cultivated land amid a landscape of mountains and desert. Indigenous communities occupied the valley before the Spanish arrival, and the upper basin remained a distinct centre of indigenous life throughout the colonial period.

In the eighteenth century the inhabitants of Huasco Alto defended their lands against attempts to survey and delimit them as a colonial Indian town. They cultivated small vineyards and used pastures in the mountains. The upper valley of the Tránsito River was known as the valley of the natives, while the neighbouring El Carmen valley came to be associated with Spanish settlement. Farther downstream, the Spanish founded the villa of San Ambrosio de Ballenary in 1789, choosing an inland position less exposed to attack from the sea.
simp_chinese:
瓦斯科河谷从安第斯山脉向太平洋延伸，穿过智利北部干旱地区。河流及其支流滋养着山地和沙漠之间的耕地。西班牙人到来之前，原住民社群便居住在河谷中；整个殖民时期，上游流域依然是原住民生活的重要区域。

十八世纪，瓦斯科上游的居民捍卫自己的土地，抵制殖民当局为设立印第安人城镇而进行的测量和划界。他们经营小片葡萄园，并利用山中的牧场。特兰西托河上游被称为原住民河谷，而相邻的埃尔卡门河谷则与西班牙人的定居联系在一起。河流下游的西班牙人则于1789年建立圣安布罗西奥德巴列纳里，选择内陆地点以减少来自海上的袭击。

english:
Huatabampo lies on the coastal plain near the lower Mayo River, within the homeland of the Yoreme, or Mayo people. The river crosses a dry region before reaching the Gulf of California, and its valley supports communities whose name and traditions reflect a long relationship with its waters.

Jesuit missionaries established missions in the Mayo valley in 1614, bringing the Yoreme into a system of mission villages. Tensions over labour, local authority and land grew during the eighteenth century. In 1740 Mayo communities joined the Yaqui in a revolt against the colonial order; the movement spread across several river valleys of the northwest. Yoreme people continued to maintain their communities and traditions along the river despite these conflicts. The revolt drew support from communities along the Fuerte and Sinaloa rivers.
simp_chinese:
瓦塔班波位于马约河下游附近的沿海平原，是约雷梅人，也称马约人的故土。河流穿过干旱地区，注入加利福尼亚湾；河谷中的社区长期与水域保持密切联系。

1614年，耶稣会士在马约河谷建立传教区，将约雷梅人纳入传教村体系。十八世纪，围绕劳动、地方权力和土地的紧张局势日益加剧。1740年，马约社区与亚基人一同反抗殖民秩序，运动扩展到西北部多个河谷。尽管经历这些冲突，约雷梅人仍沿河维系自己的社区和传统。 富埃尔特河与锡那罗亚河沿岸的社区也支持起义。

english:
Huátíng, the county seat of Sōngjiāng, lay in the water country of Jiāngnán. The Yuán raised it to Huátíng Prefecture in 1277 and renamed it Sōngjiāng in 1278; in 1292 the district's eastern townships became Shànghǎi County, and the Huátíng seat remained at Sōngjiāng. For a time Zhāng Shìchéng held the area, then Zhū Yuánzhāng took it.

Cotton made Sōngjiāng rich. Huáng Dàopó, born in 1245 at Wūnìjīng, learned weaving on Hainan, returned in the Yuánzhēn years of 1295–1296 and taught local women the tools and patterns for cotton cloth; in 1362 a shrine for her was moved onto a new site. Sōngjiāng cloth became famous across the Míng empire. Qīngpǔ County was cut from the prefecture in 1542; the Qīng added Lóu County in 1656 and, in 1724, Fèngxián, Jīnshān and Nánhuì counties, and in 1805 Chuānshā.
simp_chinese:
华亭是松江府的附郭县，位于江南水乡。元至元十四年（1277年）升为华亭府，次年改称松江府；至元二十九年（1292年）华亭东部若干乡分出，设上海县，华亭县治仍在松江。元末张士诚一度占据此地，后被朱元璋夺取。

棉花使松江富庶起来。黄道婆生于1245年，乌泥泾人，早年流落海南，在元贞年间（1295—1296年）返乡，教当地妇女制作纺织工具、织造花纹，使乌泥泾棉布名扬天下；至正二十二年（1362年）她的祠堂迁到新址。松江棉布在明代全国闻名。嘉靖二十一年（1542年）从府中划出青浦县；清顺治十三年（1656年）新设娄县，雍正二年（1724年）新设奉贤、金山、南汇三县，嘉庆十年（1805年）又设川沙厅。

english:
Huating lay within the Pingliang administrative region on the northwestern approaches to China. In 1328 the Yuan incorporated neighbouring Huaping County into its territory. When Ming forces reached Huating in 1369, Xu Da appointed Yang Sidao to manage local affairs and encourage displaced inhabitants to return. The reconstruction of local government therefore accompanied the recovery of households and cultivation after war.

The county also contained the ceramic centre of Ankou, where clay and coal supported a distinctive craft economy. Ming kilns produced glazed bowls, jars and dishes, while a temple to the pottery deity was completed in 1539 and rebuilt and enlarged in 1560. Zhao Shichun composed an inscription explaining the temple's construction and the place of pottery in everyday life. Warfare at the Ming-Qing transition dispersed craftsmen and slowed production; artisans later gathered again as the kilns recovered. Huating's history thus includes a manufacturing community whose work and religious institutions depended on the same local resources that supplied its furnaces.
simp_chinese:
华亭位于中国西北通道上的平凉地区。1328年，元朝将邻近化平县并入华亭。1369年明军抵达后，徐达委任杨思道署理地方，安抚百姓并招回流散人口。战后的行政恢复，因此也伴随着家户与耕作的重建。

县境内的安口还是陶瓷生产中心，当地陶土与煤炭支撑了独特的手工业。明代窑场烧制带釉的碗、罐、碟等器物；陶神庙于1539年建成，1560年重修扩建，并请赵时春撰写碑文，说明建庙经过及陶器与日常生活的关系。明清之际战乱导致工匠流失，生产趋于衰落，后来匠人重新聚集，窑业逐渐恢复。华亭的地方史因而也包含这一制造业社群：炉火、工艺与祭祀机构，都同安口周围的物产和劳动密切相连。

english:
Huatulco's sheltered bays belonged to the Pacific trading coast of Oaxaca, connecting Indigenous communities and inland routes with shipping along New Spain's western shore. Huatulco and nearby Tehuantepec were important ports before and after Spanish conquest. Under colonial rule, their region became involved in the movement of goods and people between New Spain, South America and the wider Pacific.

That commerce also attracted raiders. In 1579 Francis Drake entered Huatulco during his circumnavigation. Letters from Viceroy Martín Enríquez and the Audiencia reported his arrival, thefts and misconduct in the church to the Spanish crown. Subsequent expeditions repeatedly visited or attacked the coast, including those of Thomas Cavendish and other English, Dutch and French commanders between the late sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. The bays consequently offered both access to supplies and exposure to foreign ships. Their history joined local coastal society to the opportunities and violence of expanding Pacific maritime networks.
simp_chinese:
瓦图尔科的避风海湾属于瓦哈卡太平洋贸易海岸，将原住民社群、内陆通道与新西班牙西岸航运相连。瓦图尔科及邻近特万特佩克，在西班牙征服前后均为重要港口；殖民时期，所在地域参与新西班牙、南美洲及更广阔太平洋之间的人货流动。

商业也招来袭掠。1579年，弗朗西斯·德雷克在环球航行中进入瓦图尔科。总督马丁·恩里克斯与审问院致王室信函，报告其到来、劫掠及在教堂内的不敬行为。此后到十七世纪，卡文迪许等英国、荷兰、法国远征者反复到访或袭击这片海岸。海湾因此既便于取得补给，也暴露于外来舰船；地方社会与太平洋航运扩张的机会及暴力相互交织。

english: Huaxcama, also written Guaxcamá, lies in the inland country of San Luis Potosí. The surrounding rocks contain deposits of gypsum, anhydrite and sulphur, giving the place a distinctive mineral wealth. It stands among the dry uplands between the Mexican plateau and the lands that descend toward the Gulf coast. The village and the former estate of Guaxcamá gave their name to the geological formation beneath this part of the region.
simp_chinese: 瓦斯卡马又写作瓜斯卡马，位于圣路易斯波托西内陆。周围岩层含有石膏、硬石膏和硫磺矿床，赋予当地独特的矿产资源。这里处在干燥高地之间，位于墨西哥高原与向墨西哥湾海岸下降的土地之间。瓜斯卡马村和旧庄园也为这一带地下的地层命名。

english:
Huaxtepec, later called Oaxtepec, lies in the warm valleys south of the Basin of Mexico. It was renowned for a splendid garden associated with the Mexica ruler Moctezuma Ilhuicamina. Water flowed through grounds filled with trees, fragrant flowers and useful plants, bringing together species from different parts of the realm. The gardens made the town a celebrated place of pleasure and healing.

Hernán Cortés described the extensive garden in a letter to the Spanish king in 1522, admiring its water, fruit trees and fresh shaded places. Later in the sixteenth century Bernardino Álvarez founded the Hospital of Santa Cruz at Oaxtepec. The surviving garden supplied medicinal plants to the hospital, continuing a local tradition of knowledge about herbs even as the site acquired a new purpose under colonial rule.
simp_chinese:
瓦什特佩克后来称为瓦斯特佩克，位于墨西哥盆地以南温暖的谷地。这里以一座与墨西加统治者蒙特祖马·伊尔维卡米纳有关的壮丽花园闻名。流水穿过园地，树木、芳香的花朵和有用植物汇聚了王国各地的物种，使这里成为著名的游憩与疗养之地。

1522年，埃尔南·科尔特斯在致西班牙国王的信中描述了这座广阔的花园，赞叹其中的流水、果树和清凉的园地。十六世纪后期，贝尔纳迪诺·阿尔瓦雷斯在瓦斯特佩克建立圣十字医院。残存的花园为医院提供药用植物；这一地点在殖民统治下获得新用途的同时，也延续了当地的草药知识。

english: Huaxtla lies in the mountainous country of the Sierra Madre, in the eastern Nayarit region. The steep valleys and wooded ridges belong to a wider homeland of the Wixárika, also known as Huichol, whose communities extend into neighboring Jalisco and Zacatecas. Spanish missions reached parts of this rugged region in the seventeenth century, including Huajimic in 1610 and Camotlán in 1642. The mountains continued to link communities across a landscape cut by deep river valleys.
simp_chinese: 瓦斯特拉位于纳亚里特东部的马德雷山脉地区。陡峭谷地和林木覆盖的山脊属于维沙里卡人的广大故土；他们又称维乔尔人，社群也分布在邻近的哈利斯科与萨卡特卡斯。十七世纪，西班牙传教站进入这片崎岖地区的一部分，包括1610年的瓦希米克和1642年的卡莫特兰。深切河谷之间的山地仍将各社群联系起来。

english: The Huayabamba and its tributary the Abiseo descend through the cloud forests of the eastern Andes towards the Huallaga. Above the wooded valleys stand the stone buildings of Gran Pajatén, decorated with figures and geometric designs. The Chachapoya built settlements in these humid mountains, where ridges separate streams that ultimately join the Amazon system. Sites in the Abiseo country show human occupation continuing into the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 瓦亚班巴河及其支流阿比塞奥河穿过安第斯东坡的云雾森林，流向瓦亚加河。林谷上方矗立着大帕哈滕的石砌建筑，以人物和几何图案装饰。查查波亚人在湿润山地中建立聚落，山脊分隔的溪流最终汇入亚马孙水系。阿比塞奥地区的遗址显示，人类在此居住一直延续到十六世纪。

english:
The Huayabamba mountain country belongs to the wider northern Peruvian highlands, where Marcahuamachuco provides traces of political and ceremonial life before Inca domination. Its monumental construction began around AD 400 and continued for several centuries, creating major compounds on an isolated mesa overlooking three valleys. Curved stone walls, inner galleries, rooms and plazas suggest both defensive and administrative purposes.

Later burials within the walls added to the site's ceremonial functions. Researchers interpret Marcahuamachuco as an oracle centre drawing people from northern Peru and lands then in southern Ecuador, with cults associated with Ataujo and Catequil. These interpretations remain archaeological reconstructions rather than a complete written history. Inca conquest brought the centre into a different political order, and the site was probably abandoned in the fifteenth century.

Bishop Martínez Compañón's eighteenth-century documentation later included an early sketch map, showing renewed interest in the ruins long after their occupation ended. This is the history of a regional highland centre, does not imply that every mountain in Huayabamba contained the same institutions. It frames the surrounding terrain through valley connections, monumental authority, ritual gathering and the memory of a pre-Inca past.
simp_chinese:
瓦亚班巴山地属于秘鲁北部高原，马尔卡瓦马丘科提供印加统治以前政治与仪式生活的区域遗存。大型建设约公元400年开始，持续数世纪，在俯瞰三条谷地的孤立台地形成建筑群。

弯曲石墙、内部回廊、房间和广场显示防御与行政用途，较晚墙内埋葬又增加仪式功能。研究者将其解释为吸引秘鲁北部和今厄瓜多尔南部居民的神谕中心，祭祀可能联系阿陶霍与卡特基尔；这些仍是考古重建，并非完整文字史。印加征服使中心进入另一政治秩序，遗址大概在十五世纪被放弃。

十八世纪马丁内斯·孔帕尼翁主教文献后来包含早期草图，显示居民离去很久之后，古迹重新受到关注。这是区域高地中心历史，无法据此断定瓦亚班巴每座山都有同样制度，却通过谷地联系、纪念性权威、仪式聚集和前印加记忆，为周围地形提供人类历史背景。

english:
Huayacocotla was a mountain district in the Huasteca, where high, cold uplands give way to warmer valleys. Its communities included Nahua, Otomí and Tepehua inhabitants. The district centre stood on a plateau in the mountains, governing numerous smaller outlying settlements.

By 1569 Huayacocotla had passed to the Spanish Crown, with thirty-four dependent settlements. In the centre lived a vicar, local officials and representatives of the outlying communities. Its tribute included woven clothing and agricultural produce, reflecting the work of households in different parts of the district. In the early seventeenth century Huayacocotla became the seat of a corregimiento that also included Chicontepec, Zontecomatlán and Ilamatlán. Local landholding remained a concern as colonial authorities sought to define and regulate Indigenous communities' lands.
simp_chinese:
瓦亚科科特拉是瓦斯特卡地区的山区辖地，寒冷高地向下过渡为较温暖的河谷。当地社群包括纳瓦人、奥托米人和特佩瓦人。辖区中心坐落在山中高原，管理着众多较小的外围聚落。

到1569年，瓦亚科科特拉已归西班牙王室直辖，辖有三十四处附属聚落。中心住有副主祭、地方官员和外围社群的代表。贡品包括织物和农产品，体现辖区各地家庭的劳动。十七世纪初，此地成为一处行政辖区的中心，范围还包括奇孔特佩克、松特科马特兰和伊拉马特兰。殖民当局试图界定并管理原住民社群土地时，地方土地占有仍是重要问题。

english:
Huayin lies at the northern foot of Mount Hua, whose precipitous peaks form one of China's Five Sacred Mountains. The Temple of the Western Peak, north of the mountain, was a place where successive dynasties honoured its deity. Its halls and courtyards stood on the plain beneath the cliffs, with stone inscriptions recording imperial rites and the work of earlier visitors.

The great earthquake of 1556 devastated Huayin and the neighbouring Wei valley. Mountain temples and other buildings were damaged, but worship continued and the Temple of the Western Peak was rebuilt. Ming inscriptions commemorated repairs and recorded the mountain's appearance, while later Qing patrons also left their mark on the sanctuary. The sacred mountain remained both a landmark above the eastern approaches to Guanzhong and a focus of pilgrimage.
simp_chinese:
华阴位于华山北麓。华山山峰险峻，为中国五岳之一的西岳。山北的西岳庙是历代祭祀华山神的场所，殿宇院落坐落在绝壁下的平原上，碑刻记载着帝王祭礼和前人来访的事迹。

1556年的大地震重创华阴及附近渭河流域，山中宫观和其他建筑遭到破坏，但祭祀并未中断，西岳庙随后重修。明代碑刻记载修葺与山川形胜，清代也有题额留下。华山既是关中东部入口上方的地标，也是人们朝礼的圣山。

english:
Huaying's mountain country in eastern Sichuan contained a substantial Buddhist pilgrimage landscape. The Baoding temple group, reached from Xikou on the western slopes, had origins traced to the Tang period. By 1761 it comprised thirty-eight temples, making the ascent a journey through a succession of religious establishments rather than a visit to a single summit shrine.

Two approaches from Xikou connected the temples. One passed Donglin Temple, Fuhu Temple, Bao'en Temple and Huanglong Temple on the way upward; another climbed the Three Hundred Steps and passed Chongfu Temple before joining the higher route. Hermitages, pavilions and named resting places marked these paths. The religious character of Huaying therefore extended across the mountainside: the approach, the intermediate temples and the summit together formed the setting of pilgrimage.
simp_chinese:
四川东部的华蓥山区拥有规模可观的佛教朝山景观。宝鼎寺庙群从西麓溪口登山可达，其历史上溯唐代。到1761年，寺庙已有三十八座，登顶过程因而是穿行于连续的宗教场所之间，而非只到一座山顶寺院。

从溪口出发有两条登山路线。一条经过东林寺、伏虎寺、报恩寺、黄龙寺等处逐渐向上；另一条攀登三百梯，经过崇福寺后与高处道路相接。庵堂、亭子及有名称的歇脚处散布沿途。因此，华蓥的宗教生活覆盖整个山坡：登山道路、中途寺院与山顶共同构成朝山的场所。

english: Huayuan lies in the uplands north of the Wei River plain, in the country later known as Yaozhou. It was the home of the Tang physician Sun Simiao, celebrated as the Medicine King. His medical works collected prescriptions and earlier knowledge as well as his own experience. The Song court honoured him as a Daoist perfected master and supported the enlargement of shrines associated with him. A Qing stele erected in 1671 commemorated his old home, keeping his reputation alive in the district.
simp_chinese: 华原位于渭河平原北方的高地，后来称为耀州。唐代医家孙思邈出自此地，后世尊其为药王。他的医书汇集前代方药和自身行医经验。宋朝封他为真人，并资助扩建相关祠庙。清代于1671年立碑纪念其故宅，使药王的名声继续在乡里流传。

english: Huayuantou was a fortified pass in the mountains northwest of Xixia, in the Nanyang region of Henan, guarding a passage through the ridges. The Qing Veritable Gazetteer of the Empire (Da Qing Yitong Zhi) counted it among the passes of Nanyang prefecture, and the Huayuanguan stream flowed through the valley below.
simp_chinese: 花园头是河南南阳地区西峡西北山地中的一处关隘，扼守穿越山岭的通道。清代《大清一统志》把它列为南阳府的关隘之一，花园关河从下方的山谷间流过。

english: Huazhou lies south of the Wei River beneath the slopes of Lesser Mount Hua. Streams descending from the Qinling cross the plain here before joining the Wei. The prefecture had its seat at Hua County, an old centre in the eastern Guanzhong region, between the mountains and the river. On the night of 23 January 1556, a great earthquake struck the Wei valley with its centre in the Hua County region. Contemporary accounts describe immense destruction across Huazhou, Huayin, Weinan and other neighbouring districts. Mountains collapsed, the ground split and many buildings fell; the disaster was remembered throughout the Ming realm as one of the most devastating earthquakes in its history.
simp_chinese: 华州位于渭河南岸、少华山北麓，秦岭诸谷的溪水穿过平原，在此附近汇入渭河。州治设于华县，是关中东部山河之间的古老中心。1556年1月23日夜，渭河流域发生大地震，震中位于华县一带。时人记载，华州、华阴、渭南等地灾情极重，山崩地裂，建筑倒塌。这场灾难给明代留下深刻记忆，是中国历史上最具破坏性的地震之一。

english: Hubek lies in the foothills west of Capas, where the mountains of the Zambales range descend towards the plain of central Luzon. Aeta communities lived in the forested highlands, while settlers established clearings nearer the rivers. Capas became a Spanish pueblo in the early eighteenth century, in a region long connected to Pampanga.
simp_chinese: 苏庇位于卡帕斯以西的山麓，三描礼士山脉从这里向吕宋中部平原下降。阿埃塔社群居住在森林覆盖的高地，其他居民则在靠近河流的地方开垦。18世纪初，长期与邦板牙相连的卡帕斯成为西班牙殖民城镇。

english:
Hubli grew into an important inland market on the western Deccan plateau. Under the rulers of Vijayanagara its merchants traded in cotton, saltpetre and iron. The town’s connections with Karwar on the coast later attracted the English East India Company, which maintained a trading house here. English merchants described Hubli as the inland market where much of the business of their Karwar factory was carried out.

In May 1673 a Maratha force under Pratap Rao raided the town during a campaign against Bijapur. The Company’s house was among the first places entered; its cloth was carried off and its merchants reported substantial losses. A Bijapur commander arrived with cavalry before the raiders could destroy the whole town. The attack illustrates both the value of Hubli’s commerce and the vulnerability of its merchants when armies crossed the plateau.
simp_chinese:
胡布利在德干高原西部发展为重要的内陆市场。毗奢耶那伽罗统治时期，当地商人买卖棉花、硝石和铁。城镇与海岸上的卡尔瓦尔有贸易联系，后来吸引英国东印度公司在此设立商馆。英国商人称胡布利是卡尔瓦尔商馆处理大量买卖的内陆市场。

1673年5月，普拉塔普·拉奥率领的马拉塔军队在进攻比贾布尔的行动中袭击胡布利。公司的商馆最先遭到闯入，布匹被掠走，商人报告损失惨重。一位比贾布尔指挥官率骑兵赶到，使袭击者未能彻底毁坏城镇。此次劫掠既反映了胡布利商业的价值，也显现出军队穿行高原时商人的脆弱处境。

english: The Hućha Hudän, or “people of the flat country,” are Northern Tutchone people of the lower Pelly and Yukon rivers. The meeting of the two rivers was a summer fishing and gathering place, where they traded with Coastal Tlingit visitors. Families moved between seasonal camps, fishing in summer and hunting as autumn approached. The confluence later became known as Fort Selkirk, after a Hudson’s Bay Company post was established there.
simp_chinese: 胡查胡丹意为“平地之民”，是佩利河下游与育空河沿岸的北塔琼人。两河汇合处是夏季捕鱼和聚集之地，人们在此与来访的海岸特林吉特人交换物品。各家庭往返于季节性营地，夏季捕鱼，秋季临近时转向狩猎。哈德逊湾公司后来在河口建立贸易站，这里便以塞尔柯克堡之名为人所知。

english:
Al-Hudaydah lies on Yemen's Tihama coast, facing the Red Sea and the island of Kamaran. Its name was recorded for the coast in 1393, and by the middle of the fifteenth century it appeared as a settlement under the Tahirid rulers. The navigator Ahmad ibn Majid counted it among Yemen's important ports in a work completed around 1490.

In 1515 Mamluk forces landed and took the town, which suffered heavy damage and lost trade to Mocha farther south. Ottoman forces subsequently brought the Red Sea ports under their authority. When the Zaydi imam al-Mu'ayyad Muhammad advanced on Hudaydah in 1625, the Ottoman garrison withdrew to Kamaran. Mocha's coffee trade later overshadowed the town, but in the late seventeenth century attacks on shipping near Bab al-Mandab encouraged merchants to favour Hudaydah's position farther up the Red Sea. Its coffee commerce revived, and the port enjoyed a period of prosperity during the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese:
荷台达位于也门提哈马海岸，面向红海与卡马兰岛。1393年的记载已用此名指称这片海岸，到十五世纪中叶，荷台达作为塔希尔王朝统治下的聚落出现。航海家艾哈迈德·伊本·马吉德在约1490年完成的著作中，将它列为也门重要港口之一。

1515年，马穆鲁克军队登陆并占领城镇；荷台达受到严重破坏，贸易转向更南方的穆哈。奥斯曼军队随后将红海港口纳入其权威之下。1625年，宰德派伊玛目穆罕默德·穆阿亚德向荷台达进军，奥斯曼驻军退往卡马兰岛。穆哈的咖啡贸易后来盖过了荷台达，但十七世纪末曼德海峡附近船只遭袭，使商人更加青睐位于红海更北处的荷台达。咖啡贸易重新兴盛，港口在十八世纪经历了一段繁荣时期。

english:
Hudiksvall is a harbour town on the coast of Hälsingland, founded by King John III in 1582. Land uplift soon made its first harbour less suitable, and the settlement moved towards deeper water in the early seventeenth century. Merchants exported iron and sawn timber from the surrounding country, while the wooden town grew around its port on the Bothnian Sea.

Fire repeatedly threatened Hudiksvall. Saint James's Church burned after a lightning strike in 1691 and was reconsecrated in 1715. Only six years later Russian forces raided the coast and burned almost the entire town, leaving the church and a single small house standing. The inhabitants rebuilt during the 1720s, but another great fire in 1792 brought a new street plan to the damaged eastern district.
simp_chinese:
胡迪克斯瓦尔是海尔辛兰海岸的港城，由国王约翰三世于1582年创建。陆地抬升使最初的港口逐渐不再适用，17世纪初聚落向较深水域迁移。商人出口周围地区的铁和锯材，木造城镇则围绕波的尼亚海的港口发展。

火灾屡次威胁胡迪克斯瓦尔。圣雅各教堂于1691年遭雷击焚毁，1715年重新祝圣。仅六年后，俄军袭击海岸，几乎烧毁整个城镇，只留下教堂和一座小屋。居民在1720年代重建家园，但1792年另一场大火之后，受损的东部地区又采用了新的街道规划。

english: The western waters of Hudson Bay wash the low coast of the Kivalliq, where rivers descend from the inland tundra. Inuit families travelled between this coast and the interior, hunting caribou and fish along the rivers and seeking seals and other marine animals by the bay. The Paallirmiut also carried furs and ivory obtained farther north to trade with Hudson's Bay Company ships. In the eighteenth century the company sent small trading vessels north from Churchill to meet Inuit along the western shore.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾西部水域濒临基瓦利克低平的海岸，河流从内陆苔原流向大海。因纽特家庭往返于海岸与内陆，在河流沿岸猎取北美驯鹿、捕鱼，又到海湾捕猎海豹等海兽。帕利尔米乌特人还将更北方所得的毛皮和象牙带到海岸，与哈得孙湾公司的船只交易。十八世纪，公司从丘吉尔派出小型商船沿西岸北上，与因纽特人接触。

english: Hudson Bay is a vast inland sea whose eastern shore is indented by river mouths and fringed by islands. Each summer beluga whales enter its waters and gather in estuaries along the coast. Cree hunters pursued them in the southeastern bay, taking advantage of the whales' seasonal arrival. During the eighteenth century the Hudson's Bay Company also sought to exploit the white whale fishery, whose products could supply oil and provisions for the trading posts.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾是一片辽阔的内海，东岸河口众多，近海散布着岛屿。每年夏季，白鲸进入海湾，聚集在沿岸河口。东南岸的克里猎人利用鲸群季节性到来的时机猎捕白鲸。十八世纪，哈得孙湾公司也试图经营白鲸捕猎，将鲸油和食物用作贸易站的补给。

english: In southeastern Hudson Bay, the low Belcher Islands rise from a sea covered by ice through much of the year. Even in winter, openings in the ice provide feeding places for the eider ducks that remain around the islands. Inuit families have gathered eider down for generations and made warm clothing from the birds' skins. Dorset people and later Thule Inuit lived in the archipelago; in 1610 Henry Hudson sighted the islands during his voyage into the bay.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾东南部，低矮的贝尔彻群岛从海面升起，周围水域一年中大部分时间覆盖着海冰。即使到了冬季，冰层间的开阔水面仍为留在群岛附近的绒鸭提供觅食场所。因纽特家庭世代采集绒鸭的羽绒，并以鸟皮缝制御寒衣物。多尔塞特人和后来的图勒因纽特人曾在群岛生活；1610年，亨利·哈得孙驶入海湾时望见了这些岛屿。

english:
The open waters of Hudson Bay connected a vast northern drainage basin with Atlantic shipping through Hudson Strait. Henry Hudson explored the bay in 1610 aboard Discovery, seeking a route towards Asia. The ship wintered in James Bay, but in June 1611 mutineers set Hudson and several companions adrift; their fate remains unknown.

Commercial ventures later gave these waters a different purpose. Nonsuch reached the bay in 1668 and traded for beaver pelts, helping lead to the formation of the Hudson's Bay Company. Its royal charter of 1670 granted a trading monopoly across the watershed known as Rupert's Land.

River-mouth posts became meeting places where Indigenous trappers exchanged furs for imported goods, and ships carried the pelts to Europe. France challenged the English claim through military expeditions before abandoning its claim under the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713. Across the wider bay, navigation was therefore tied to seasonal ice, inland river trade and the competition of empires over access to northern produce.
simp_chinese:
哈德孙湾远海通过哈德孙海峡，把广阔北方汇水盆地同大西洋航运连接。亨利·哈德孙于1610年乘“发现号”探察海湾，寻找通向亚洲的路线。船队在詹姆斯湾过冬，1611年6月却发生叛乱，哈德孙及数名同伴被置于小艇漂流，命运至今不明。

后来的商业活动赋予水域另一目的。1668年“无双号”到湾内交易河狸皮，推动哈德孙湾公司形成；1670年王室特许状又授予公司在称为鲁珀特地的整个汇水区内贸易垄断权。

河口据点成为原住民捕猎者以毛皮换取输入商品的会面地点，船只再把皮张运往欧洲。法国曾以军事远征挑战英国主张，直到1713年《乌得勒支条约》才放弃要求。在整个海湾，航行因此同季节性冰况、内陆河流贸易，以及帝国争夺北方资源通道的竞争相互结合。

english: The open waters of western Hudson Bay lead towards the mouths of the Hayes and Nelson rivers, where rival traders built forts to control the fur trade. In 1697 Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville crossed the bay with a French squadron to attack the English post at York Factory. His flagship Pélican became separated from the other French ships and fought three English vessels near the fort, sinking the Hampshire. York Factory fell to the French shortly afterwards and remained in their hands until 1713.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾西部的开阔水域通向海斯河与纳尔逊河口，竞争的商人在那里建堡，争夺毛皮贸易。1697年，皮埃尔·勒穆瓦纳·迪贝维尔率领法国舰队横渡海湾，进攻英国的约克贸易站。他的旗舰“鹈鹕号”与其他法国船只失散，在堡垒附近独自迎战三艘英国船，并击沉“汉普郡号”。不久，约克贸易站落入法国人手中，直到1713年才归还英国。

sources.title: le moyne d iberville et d ardillieres pierre 2E.html

english: Hudson Bay spreads across a vast, shallow basin between the Canadian mainland and the islands of the Arctic. Ice covers much of its surface through the long winter. Beluga whales spend that season in Hudson Strait and enter the bay in summer, following routes along its shores that Inuit hunters have long known. On the western coast, Inuit also met the small Hudson's Bay Company vessels sent north from Churchill to exchange goods and furs during the open-water season.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾在大陆与北极岛屿之间铺展开来，是一片辽阔而水浅的海域。漫长的冬季里，大部分海面被冰覆盖。白鲸在哈得孙海峡过冬，夏季进入海湾，沿着因纽特猎人熟知的沿岸路线迁徙。海湾西岸的因纽特人也与哈得孙湾公司的小船相遇；这些船只在无冰季节从丘吉尔北上，交换货物与毛皮。

english: The northern waters of Hudson Bay stretch south of Southampton Island, where a great inland sea opens towards the Arctic. In 1612 Thomas Button sailed west through Hudson Strait in search of a passage and spent the winter at the mouth of the Nelson River. When the ice permitted him to sail again in 1613, he followed the western coast north towards Southampton Island and entered the channel later known as Roes Welcome Sound. His voyage carried him across waters long familiar to Inuit hunters.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾北部水域在南安普顿岛以南铺展，这片辽阔内海在此通向北极方向。1612年，托马斯·巴顿为寻找航道，向西穿过哈得孙海峡，在纳尔逊河口过冬。1613年冰情允许船只再次出航后，他沿西岸北上，驶向南安普顿岛，并进入后来称为罗伊斯韦尔科姆海峡的水道。他的航程穿过了因纽特猎人早已熟悉的水域。

english: The open waters of Hudson Bay lie between the islands of the eastern bay and the river mouths of the western coast. In 1619 the Danish navigator Jens Munk crossed the bay in search of a northwest passage. His two ships reached the Churchill River as winter approached, and the expedition remained there through the icebound months. Hunger and scurvy devastated the crew; Munk and only two companions survived to sail back across the bay in the smaller vessel.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾开阔的水域横亘在东部岛群和西岸河口之间。1619年，丹麦航海家延斯·蒙克为寻找西北航道横渡海湾。冬季将近时，他的两艘船驶抵丘吉尔河，探险队便在河口度过了冰封的数月。饥饿与坏血病夺走了大部分船员的生命，只有蒙克和两名同伴幸存，乘较小的船再次横渡海湾返航。

english: Hudson Bay's open waters formed a seasonal sea road between the Atlantic and the trading posts on its shores. Hudson's Bay Company ships sailed from London with trade goods, passed through the ice of Hudson Strait and continued to the bay's river-mouth posts. In the eighteenth century their captains also traded with Inuit along the strait. At York Factory, Indigenous traders brought furs to exchange for guns, kettles, knives and blankets. An early freeze could prevent a ship from leaving the bay and force its crew to spend the winter there.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾的开阔水域是一条季节性海路，连接大西洋与沿岸商站。哈得孙湾公司的船只从伦敦装载贸易货物出发，穿过哈得孙海峡的浮冰，再驶向海湾河口的据点。十八世纪，船长们也在海峡沿途与因纽特人交易。在约克贸易站，原住民商人带来毛皮，换取枪支、锅具、刀和毯子。若海面过早封冻，船只便可能无法离开海湾，船员只得留下过冬。

english: Southern Hudson Bay is a shallow expanse of cold water, fed by rivers draining the surrounding lowlands. Wind and river runoff help drive a broad counterclockwise circulation around the bay, whose waters ultimately leave through Hudson Strait. For much of the year the surface is covered with ice. Ships serving the fur-trading posts depended on the short season of open water; if ice blocked their return through the strait, their crews could be forced to winter on the bay.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙湾南部是一片寒冷的浅水区，周围低地的河流不断注入水中。风与河流径流共同推动海湾形成广阔的逆时针环流，湾水最终经哈得孙海峡流出。一年中大部分时间，海面覆盖着冰。往来毛皮商站的船只依靠短暂的无冰季节航行；如果海冰堵住返航的海峡，船员便可能被迫留在湾中过冬。

english: The Hudson Bay lowlands are a broad expanse of wetlands, rivers and low forest bordering the southern shore of the bay. The Winisk and Severn cross this flat country, their waters opening onto marshes and shallow coastal shoals. Cree families travelled between inland and coastal camps to hunt, trap and fish. Along the Shagamu River, raised beach ridges, ponds and marshes form a coastal landscape used by caribou and waterbirds.
simp_chinese: 哈德逊湾低地是南岸一片广阔的湿地、河流与低矮森林。温尼斯科河和塞文河穿越平坦地区，流入湿地与浅海滩地。克里家庭往返内陆与海岸营地，狩猎、捕兽和捕鱼。沙加穆河沿岸的隆起海滩脊、池塘与沼泽构成海岸景观，为驯鹿和水鸟所利用。

english: Hudur lies in the Bakool country between the Shabelle and Juba rivers. Farming here depends on seasonal rain rather than the waters of either river. Most rain falls during the Gu, from April to June; sorghum fields share the land with grazing for camels, cattle, sheep and goats.
simp_chinese: 胡杜尔位于谢贝利河与朱巴河之间的巴库勒地区。这里的农耕依靠季节性降雨，而非两条河流的河水。大部分雨水落在四月至六月的古雨季；高粱田与牧地相间，人们放养骆驼、牛、绵羊和山羊。

english: The Tsebekinéndé, or Carrizaleños, were a local group of the southern Chiricahua Apache. Their country lay in northwestern Chihuahua between Janos and Carrizal, reaching south toward Casas Grandes and the mountains along the Santa María and Carmen rivers. The name Tsebekinéndé has been rendered as “stone house people.” They belonged to the Nednhi, whose communities ranged through the Sierra Madre and the deserts of Chihuahua and Sonora.
simp_chinese: 采贝基嫩德人又称卡里萨莱尼奥人，是南部奇里卡瓦阿帕奇人的一个地方群体。他们的土地位于奇瓦瓦西北部哈诺斯与卡里萨尔之间，向南延伸至卡萨斯格兰德斯及圣玛丽亚河、卡门河沿岸山地。采贝基嫩德之名被译为“石屋人”。他们属于内德尼人，后者的社群活动于马德雷山脉以及奇瓦瓦和索诺拉的沙漠中。

english:
Huechulafquen Lake belongs to the Andean country of Pehuenmapu, where lakes, forests and mountain passes connected communities on both sides of the range. Its waters and surrounding valleys provided fish, game and routes through a landscape whose produce varied sharply with elevation and season. The gathering of araucaria seeds was important in the wider Pehuenche world, alongside hunting and exchange with neighbouring peoples.

During the early later centuries, Mapuche-speaking networks extended across the Andes through trade, migration and alliance. Horses and cattle introduced after Spanish arrival transformed mobility and wealth, but Indigenous communities retained substantial political autonomy across much of this eastern mountain country. Passes linked the plains with Chilean markets and settlements, allowing animals and goods to move beyond colonial frontiers.

Lakes such as Huechulafquen belonged within those relationships rather than forming an isolated wilderness. Local leaders negotiated alliances and access to produce through personal and community ties. The lake's historical setting therefore combines a productive mountain environment with the movement of people, livestock and cultural practices across borders that colonial authorities claimed more readily than they controlled.
simp_chinese:
韦丘拉夫肯湖属于佩文马普安第斯地区，湖泊、森林及山口把山脉两侧社群连接起来。湖水与周围河谷提供鱼、猎物及通行路线，资源随海拔和季节显著变化。广大佩文切世界重视采集南洋杉种子，同时狩猎并与邻近民族交换，生活并不依靠单一土地或物产。

近世几个世纪，马普切语网络通过贸易、迁徙与联盟跨越安第斯。西班牙到来后引入的马和牛改变交通及财富，但东方许多山地社群仍保持显著政治自主。山口连接平原、智利市场与聚落，使动物及商品越过殖民边疆。

这样的湖泊处在关系网络之内，并非隔绝荒野。地方领袖通过个人和社群联系协商联盟与资源使用。因此，湖区背景把生产性山地环境，同人口、牲畜及文化实践跨界移动结合起来；殖民当局提出边界声索，往往比真正控制土地更容易。

english:
Huedin, west of Cluj in Transylvania, stands in the upper Crișul Repede basin. A papal register records the settlement in 1332 under the form Villa Hunad. By 1437 it was described as an oppidum, or market town, with carpenters, blacksmiths, furriers, tailors and leatherworkers. Its importance therefore rested on a particular community of producers and exchange, rather than merely on its position along regional roads.

The church preserves another part of this history. Its medieval fabric replaced an earlier Catholic building, and in 1483 the Bánffy family enlarged it with an eastern wing displaying Gothic features. Rebuilding followed in the sixteenth century, while eighteenth-century renovation added a painted coffered ceiling with an astrological calendar. The building became the Reformed church, carrying evidence of both medieval patronage and later religious change. Together the town's early records and its church show the growth of a local market centre within the changing institutions of Transylvania.
simp_chinese:
胡埃丁位于特兰西瓦尼亚克卢日以西、克里舒尔雷佩德河上游盆地。1332年的教皇记录以“维拉胡纳德”之名提到聚落；1437年它已称作集镇，拥有木匠、铁匠、皮毛匠、裁缝和制革工。其重要性因而落实于生产与交换的具体社群，而不仅是区域道路上的位置。

教堂保存了另一部分地方历史。中世纪建筑承接较早的天主教堂，1483年班菲家族扩建东翼，带有哥特式特征。十六世纪又曾重建，十八世纪修缮时增添绘有星象历法的彩绘方格木天花。建筑后来成为归正宗教堂，同时承载中世纪赞助与后来的宗教变迁。城镇早期记录和教堂遗存，共同展现一个地方市场中心如何在特兰西瓦尼亚制度更替中发展。

english:
Huehuetán served as the capital of Soconusco from 1540 until 1700, when provincial authorities moved to Escuintla following the town's economic decline. Its standing as an administrative centre placed it within the Spanish colonial organisation of the Pacific coastal country. The church of San Pedro, dated locally to 1550, belonged to this sixteenth-century townscape.

The authorities returned temporarily in 1792 after a destructive storm at Escuintla. Huehuetán then served as headquarters of the Soconusco subdelegation within the intendancy of Chiapas, until the office moved to Tapachula in May 1794. In 1800 a major rise of the Huehuetán River devastated much of the settlement. Repeated moves of provincial government and the damage caused by flooding shaped the town's late colonial history, changing its position among the neighbouring administrative centres.
simp_chinese:
韦韦坦自1540年至1700年担任索科努斯科省首府，此后因当地经济衰退，省级当局迁往埃斯昆特拉。行政中心地位使它成为西班牙殖民统治在太平洋沿岸组织地方事务的一环。地方历史将圣佩德罗教堂的建造时间记为1550年，它也是十六世纪城镇景观的一部分。

1792年，埃斯昆特拉遭受严重风灾后，当局暂时返回韦韦坦。这里遂成为恰帕斯督辖区所属索科努斯科分区的驻地，直到1794年5月迁往塔帕丘拉。1800年，韦韦坦河大幅涨水，又破坏了聚落的大部分地区。省级政府的反复迁移与洪水灾害共同影响殖民后期的城镇命运，使它在周边行政中心之间的地位屡次变化。

english: Huelva stands among the marshes and low hills where the Tinto and Odiel approach the Atlantic. Salt pans along the estuary supplied a trade that linked the town with neighbouring ports. In 1755 the earthquake centred near Lisbon shook the western coast of Andalusia; a great movement of the sea followed, driving the inhabitants of Huelva towards the higher ground in fear of flooding.
simp_chinese: 韦尔瓦位于廷托河与奥迭尔河流向大西洋的沼泽和低丘之间。河口的盐田供应贸易，将城镇与附近港口联系起来。1755年，里斯本附近发生的地震震动了安达卢西亚西部海岸；此后海水剧烈涌动，韦尔瓦居民担心遭到淹没，纷纷向高地逃去。

sources.title: La red de salinas y el comercio de la sa.pdf

english: The central Andes rise steeply above the valleys of Chile, their ridges and snowfields forming a great barrier to the lands east of the mountains. Volcanoes such as Tinguiririca stand among the peaks of this section of the cordillera. Streams from the high country descend through narrow valleys towards the cultivated lowlands. Snow, exposed rock and the great height of the passes make these mountains a striking contrast to the country below.
simp_chinese: 安第斯山脉中段在智利河谷上方陡然升起，山脊与雪原构成通向山脉以东地区的巨大屏障。廷吉里里卡等火山坐落在这一段山脉的群峰之间。高地溪流穿过狭窄河谷，向下流入耕作的低地。积雪、裸露的岩石和高耸的山口使这里与下方土地形成鲜明对照。

english: Forests cloak the Andean slopes around the Nevados de Chillán, where the high volcanic mountains rise above the valleys of central Chile. Native trees such as coihue, roble and raulí grow on the slopes, and streams flow down towards the lowlands. The huemul, a mountain deer once found across much of the southern Andes, inhabits this wooded mountain country. Snowfields and exposed ridges stand above the forests.
simp_chinese: 奇廉雪山周围的安第斯山坡覆盖着森林，高耸的火山群俯瞰智利中部河谷。科伊韦、罗夫莱和劳利等本地树木生长在山坡上，溪流向下流入低地。南安第斯鹿生活在这片林木茂盛的山区，这种鹿过去曾广泛分布于南安第斯。森林上方则是雪原和裸露的山脊。

english:
Huesca lies on the plain below the Pyrenees, the Muslim Wasqa that the kings of Aragon took in 1096 and made one of their principal cities.
