Montearagón, the castle-abbey Sancho Ramírez raised above the town, and the royal pantheon of the Romanesque monastery of San Pedro el Viejo recall its royal past. The present cathedral was begun in 1273, when the town reached about eight thousand people, its medieval peak.

The Black Death of 1348 cut the population to about four thousand in the fifteenth century, and building on the cathedral stopped. In 1349 the city ordered that Romance, the Aragonese of the time, be used in the market rather than Hebrew, Arabic or Basque. Peter IV founded a university here in 1354, and during the War of the Two Peters, in 1357–59, the walls were strengthened against a Castilian attack. The council moved into its new Casas de la Ciudad in 1461. Huesca had the third largest Jewish community in Aragon, and the Inquisition tried and burned several judaizers in 1489–90. French troops held the city from 1809 to 1813. Huesca became a provincial capital in 1833.
simp_chinese:
韦斯卡位于比利牛斯山脚下的平原上，是穆斯林的瓦斯卡，阿拉贡诸王于1096年夺取后将它作为主要城市之一。桑乔·拉米雷斯在城镇上方建起的蒙特阿拉贡城堡修道院，以及罗马式的老圣佩德罗修道院中的王家陵寝，都是它王城往事的见证。现存的主教座堂始建于1273年，当时城中人口约八千，是中世纪的人口高峰。

1348年的黑死病使人口降到十五世纪的约四千，大教堂工程也随之停顿。1349年，城市下令集市上使用当时的罗曼语即阿拉贡语，而不是希伯来语、阿拉伯语或巴斯克语。佩德罗四世于1354年在此创办大学；1357至1359年的两佩德罗战争中，城墙为防备卡斯蒂利亚的进攻而得到加强。市议会于1461年迁入新的城市大厦。韦斯卡的犹太社区是阿拉贡第三大社区，1489至1490年宗教裁判所审判并烧死了几名犹太化者。法军在1809至1813年控制该城。1833年韦斯卡成为省会。

english: Huéscar lies on a high plain in the northern lands of Granada, between the mountains and the frontier towards Murcia. Its medieval town passed from the Nasrid kingdom to Castilian rule at the end of the fifteenth century. The collegiate church of Santa María la Mayor, begun in the sixteenth century, combines Gothic and Renaissance forms and reflects the ambitions of the town under its new lords.
simp_chinese: 韦斯卡尔位于格拉纳达北部高原，处在山地与通往穆尔西亚的边境之间。15世纪末，这座中世纪城镇从纳斯里德王国转入卡斯蒂利亚统治。圣玛丽亚拉马约尔协同教堂始建于16世纪，融合哥特式与文艺复兴形式，体现了城镇在新领主治下的雄心。

english:
Huete, west of Cuenca, was a Castilian town whose relationship with royal power became especially visible in the fifteenth century. On 26 July 1428 John II granted it the title of city, following the intervention of his falconer Pedro Carrillo de Huete. The privilege gave formal expression to the town's standing within the monarchy. In 1476 the Catholic Monarchs' troops took Huete and restored direct royal authority; the following year they honoured it as Noble and Loyal.

Huete also participated in the early spread of printing. Álvaro de Castro printed Alonso Díaz de Montalvo's compilation of Castilian royal ordinances there in 1484, bringing a major work of law into print outside the kingdom's largest cities. Royal allegiance did not prevent later political division. Juan de Sandoval led the local Comunero movement, whose supporters negotiated for pardon after the defeat at Villalar. The town's late medieval prominence thus encompassed royal privilege, legal scholarship and resistance to royal government.
simp_chinese:
韦特位于昆卡以西，其与卡斯蒂利亚王权的关系在十五世纪格外鲜明。1428年7月26日，经王室鹰猎官佩德罗·卡里略·德韦特斡旋，胡安二世授予这里城市称号，以特许状确认它在王国内的地位。1476年，天主教双王的军队攻入韦特，恢复王室直接管辖；次年又赐予“高贵而忠诚”的荣称。

韦特也参与了印刷术早期的传播。1484年，阿尔瓦罗·德卡斯特罗在此印行阿隆索·迪亚斯·德蒙塔尔沃汇编的卡斯蒂利亚王室法令，使重要法律著作在大城市之外付梓。地方对王室的效忠并未消除后来的政治分裂。胡安·德桑多瓦尔领导韦特的城市公社运动，维利亚拉尔战败后，支持者与王室当局谈判求赦。王室特权、法律学术与反抗王权的行动，共同构成这座城市晚期中世纪至近世初年的经历。

english:
Huexotzinco stood on the central Mexican plateau west of Tlaxcala, beneath the slopes of the great volcanoes. Its Nahua rulers resisted the expansion of neighbouring powers and eventually allied with the Spaniards. The town’s artists left a remarkable record of the demands placed upon their community after the conquest.

In 1531 the people of Huexotzinco joined Hernán Cortés in a complaint against officials of the First Audiencia, whom they accused of demanding excessive tribute. Indigenous painters recorded the goods supplied on sheets of amate paper, alongside written testimony. The surviving Huexotzinco Codex includes quantities of cloth and other objects, and even a featherwork image of the Virgin and Child. The case reveals how a community used both pictorial and written evidence to defend its interests under Spanish rule.
simp_chinese:
韦绍钦科位于墨西哥中部高原，特拉斯卡拉以西的大火山山坡下。纳瓦统治者抵抗邻近强权的扩张，后来与西班牙人结盟。当地画师为征服后社群承受的要求留下了非凡记录。

1531年，韦绍钦科人与埃尔南·科尔特斯共同控告第一审判院官员，指责他们索取过重贡赋。原住民画师在阿马特纸上绘出交纳的物品，并附上书面证词。留存的《韦绍钦科绘本》记录了布匹等物品的数量，甚至包括一幅圣母圣子羽毛画。这一案件显示社群如何在西班牙统治下结合图像与文字证据维护自身利益。

english: The waters around Hugon lie off the western coast of New Caledonia, among scattered coral reefs and small islands. Kanak communities lived on Grande Terre long before European expeditions arrived. In 1792 the French navigator d’Entrecasteaux sailed along the island’s western coast.
simp_chinese: 于贡附近的水域位于新喀里多尼亚西岸外，散布着礁体和小岛。欧洲探险队到来之前，卡纳克社群早已在大地岛生活。1792年，法国航海家当特尔卡斯托沿该岛西岸航行。

english:
Huguan's mountain communities maintained a distinctive religious landscape, including the Zhenze Palace at Shenjiao. The sanctuary honoured two sisters of the Yue family, remembered in local tradition for their filial devotion. Their cult became one of the characteristic forms of worship in the district, with a temple complex enlarged and repaired across successive dynasties.

Surviving inscriptions record repeated investment during the Qing period. They include repairs in 1645, work on the ceremonial archway in 1727, and reconstruction of the central hall together with new buildings for the sisters' parents in 1765. Further inscriptions commemorate works in 1792, 1801 and 1813, followed by repairs to the Chahua Tower and riverside stone steps in 1827. These records preserve the local history of a sanctuary sustained through repeated rebuilding.
simp_chinese:
壶关山区的村落拥有鲜明的地方信仰景观，神郊真泽宫便是其中之一。宫中奉祀乐氏二女，地方传说以她们的孝行著称。二仙崇拜成为当地具有代表性的信仰，庙宇建筑也历经各代扩建和修缮。

现存碑刻记录了清代多次营修：1645年修补庙宇，1727年重修牌楼，1765年重修当央大殿，并营建供奉二仙父母的院落。另有碑记纪念1792年、1801年和1813年的工程，1827年又修缮插花楼及临河石梯。这些具体记录保存了一座地方神庙通过反复修建延续下来的历史。

english: Chuchk Dodo’ag lies in the desert country associated with the Hu:huhla, an O’odham group east of the Hia-Ced O’odham. The Sonoran Desert is a landscape of widely spaced mountains and dry valleys, where rain and springs determine the availability of water. O’odham communities gathered desert plants and used knowledge of seasonal conditions to sustain life across this arid country.
simp_chinese: 丘克多多阿格位于与胡胡拉人相关的沙漠地带。胡胡拉人是生活在沙塞奥德汉人以东的一支奥德汉人。索诺拉沙漠山脉稀疏、谷地干旱，降雨和泉水决定了水源的分布。奥德汉社区采集沙漠植物，凭借对季节变化的认识在这片干旱土地上生活。

english: Huì’ān lies on the Fújiàn coast north of Quánzhōu. The county was established in 981 under the Northern Sòng, when land was separated from Jìnjiāng and a seat was set beneath Luó Mountain. Known as Luóchéng, the town became the centre of a coastal district facing the waters between Fújiàn and Taiwan.
simp_chinese: 惠安位于福建海岸、泉州以北。北宋太平兴国六年（981年），朝廷从晋江划地设县，县治设于螺山之阳，称螺城。这里成为一个沿海县份的中心，面向福建与台湾之间的海域。

english: Huìchāng lies in the hills of southeastern Jiāngxī at the head of the Gàn River's eastern branch, next to Fújiàn. Established in 982 from Yúdū County, it took its name from twelve tiles bearing the seal characters for Huìchāng found by diggers of a well, though some trace it to the Huìchāng Gorge. From 1231 to 1269 it was a military prefecture; in 1297 the Yuán raised it to Huìchāng Department, ruling Huìchāng and Ruìjīn, and the early Míng restored the county under Gànzhōu Prefecture.
simp_chinese: 会昌位于江西东南部的丘陵地带，赣江东源上游，东邻福建。北宋太平兴国七年（982年）自雩都县析置，县名来自建县时凿井发现的十二块刻有“会昌”篆文的砖瓦，也有一说得名于会昌峡。南宋绍定四年（1231年）至咸淳五年（1269年）一度改为军；元大德元年（1297年）升为会昌州，领会昌、瑞金两县；明洪武初年复为县，隶赣州府。

english:
Huicheon was a county of Joseon Korea's Pyeongan province. In 1396 it regained a separate local office after an earlier period of joint administration with Gaeju. The name changed from Huiju to Huicheon in 1413, when the court replaced the character ju in the names of many lower-ranking districts with san or cheon. This brought the county into a wider reform of local administration.

The magistrate's title changed again in 1466 to gunsu. He combined administrative, judicial and military responsibilities under the provincial governor. A teaching official served the local Confucian school before that post was later abolished. Huicheon initially shared military duties in the Ganggyedo left wing and subsequently belonged to the Yeongbyeon defence district. The eighteenth-century Yeojidoseo records a substantial supporting establishment of military officers, clerks, messengers and government slaves. Behind the county's changing titles lay an office that mobilised labour and linked this inland district to provincial government.
simp_chinese:
熙川是朝鲜王朝平安道的一个郡。此前曾与价州共用地方长官，1396年重新设置独立官署。1413年，朝廷整顿地方区划，将许多较低等级地区名称中的“州”改为“山”或“川”，熙州也因此改名熙川，纳入这轮地方行政改革。

1466年，长官的职称再改为郡守，在观察使指挥下统理行政、司法与军事事务。地方乡校曾配有训导负责教学，这一职位后来被裁撤。熙川起初兼负江界道左翼兵马职责，随后归入宁边镇管。十八世纪编成的《舆地图书》记载，郡中有军官、衙前、通引、使令及官奴婢等相当规模的人员。职称变化背后，是一个征调劳力、执行政务并将内陆地区与省级官府联系起来的机构。

english:
Huichuan was the county seat of Qingzhou in the North China plain. Its name dates from 1153, when the Jin renamed Qianning County. Under Mongol rule the same seat served Qingning Prefecture from 1230 to 1234 and then Qingzhou again. An administrative consolidation in 1265 briefly absorbed neighbouring jurisdictions into Huichuan before Qingzhou was restored.

In 1337 Huichuan therefore stood within the Yuan administrative landscape of Hejian Route. Its separate county administration ended in 1368, when the new Ming government merged it into Qingzhou. Six years later Qingzhou itself was reduced to Qing County under Hejian Prefecture. The settlement continued as a local government seat through these changes of name and rank. Under the Qing, the county's superior jurisdiction shifted again: in 1725 it was placed under Tianjin Zhou, and in 1731 under Tianjin Prefecture. Huichuan's history is thus embedded in the successive county, prefectural and provincial arrangements through which rulers administered this part of the northern plain.
simp_chinese:
会川是华北平原上清州的治县。1153年，金朝将乾宁县改名会川。蒙古统治下，同一治所在1230至1234年间作为清宁府治，随后又恢复为清州治。1265年一度合并邻近辖区，由会川承接其行政范围，不久清州重新设置。

因此，1337年的会川属于元朝河间路的清州行政体系。1368年，明朝初立，会川县并入清州，独立县级建置结束。1374年，清州又降为青县，隶属河间府。名称和等级虽有变化，这一聚落作为地方治所的作用延续下来。清朝时期，上级隶属再次调整：1725年青县改属天津州，1731年转属天津府。会川的历史由此贯穿县、州、府多层建置的更替，反映历代王朝如何重新安排北方平原的地方治理。

english:
Huichuan, the old town of Huìlǐ, stood on the high plateau above the Jīnshā River, where the road from Yunnan climbs into the Liangshan country. The Han called the district Huìwú County. The Tang renamed it Huìchuān in 675, for the plains and rivers that meet here. Local tradition holds that Zhuge Liang crossed the Lu, as the Jinsha was then called, in the south of this district during his southern campaign. In 1277 the Yuan raised Huichuan Route, with seven prefectures under it.

After the Ming armies put down the revolt of Yuèlǔ Tiémùér in 1392, the post was made Huichuan Guard, and in 1394 it was placed under the Sichuan Regional Military Commission. Soldiers and their families settled on the land along the Sichuan–Yunnan frontier, and the gazetteers recorded a Yuelu city that kept the rebel chief's name. In the late 1720s the Qing abolished the guard and moved the seat of Huili Department to its walled town. Temples to Confucius, to Zhuge Liang and to the God of War, and the Yuanquan Temple, filled the old town.
simp_chinese:
会川是会理旧城，坐落在金沙江之上的高原台地，从云南通往凉山地区的道路由此爬升。汉代这里置会无县，唐上元二年（675年）改称会川，取“川原并会”之意。当地传说诸葛亮南征时在这一带渡过泸水，即当时的金沙江。元至元十四年（1277年）设会川路，下辖七州。

1392年明军平定月鲁帖木儿之乱后，这里改设会川卫，1394年改隶四川行都司。军士及其家眷在川滇交界的土地上屯垦，方志还记有一座沿用叛军首领之名的月鲁城。清雍正年间，朝廷裁撤会川卫，把会理州治迁到卫城。城内有文庙、武侯祠、武庙，以及元泉寺等寺观。

english:
Huifa City occupied a steep hill beside the Huifa River, with the Huangni River helping protect its approaches. It became the royal stronghold of the Huifa, one of the Haixi Jurchen groupings. Wangjinu gathered communities in the river valley and established his seat on Huerqi Hill. The Ming-period fortress had inner, middle and outer walls, using the summit and lower terraces to create successive defensive enclosures. A diverted watercourse supplied a moat outside the eastern wall.

In 1607 Nurhaci attacked and conquered Huifa; its ruler Baindari and his son were killed. The place subsequently witnessed a different kind of political union. In 1614 Hong Taiji met the daughter of the Khorchin leader Manggus at Huerqi Hill and celebrated their marriage, strengthening ties between the ruling families. Qing emperors later visited the ruined stronghold. During his eastern tour of 1754, Qianlong composed poems recalling its walls and the conquest that had ended Huifa independence.
simp_chinese:
辉发城踞辉发河畔的陡山，黄泥河也为其通道提供屏障。它是海西女真辉发部的王城。王机砮招集河谷诸部，在扈尔奇山建立驻地。明代城堡具有内、中、外三道城墙，依山顶与山下台地层层设防，东墙外还引水修筑护城河。

1607年，努尔哈赤攻灭辉发，首领拜音达里父子被杀。随后，这里又见证了一次政治联姻。1614年，皇太极在扈尔奇山迎娶科尔沁首领莽古斯之女，通过婚姻加强两家联系。清朝皇帝后来曾到访这座旧城。1754年东巡时，乾隆赋诗追忆城垣与结束辉发独立的征服。

english: Huihe was a county in the northern frontier country governed from Dading. Under the Liao it belonged to Huizhou, one of the prefectures around the Khitan central capital. In 1143 the Jin abolished Huizhou and transferred Huihe to Dading Prefecture. Its name recalls the succession of Liao, Jin and Yuan administrations in a region where settled communities and pastoral lands lay close together.
simp_chinese: 惠和是大定辖区北方边地的一县。辽代它属于惠州，后者是契丹中京周围的州之一。1143年，金朝撤销惠州，将惠和改属大定府。这个地名保存了辽、金、元政权在北方先后治理的记忆；在这一地区，定居社群与牧地相邻。

english: Huilai lies on the coast of eastern Guangdong, between Chaoyang and Haifeng. Its name comes from the district chosen for the county seat, south of the Kui hills and near the sea. In 1524 the Ming established Huilai County from parts of Chaoyang and Haifeng. The following year work began on a new walled town, with water diverted from the Yanling River to fill its moat. Officials went on to establish a county office, a school and a temple to the city god, giving the new jurisdiction its administrative and ritual centre.
simp_chinese: 惠来位于广东东部沿海，地处潮阳与海丰之间。县名取自设治所在的惠来都，城在葵岭之南，面向大海。1524年，明朝划潮阳和海丰部分地区设置惠来县。次年开始筑城，引盐岭河水为护城河；此后又修建县衙、学宫和城隍庙，使新县有了治理和祭祀的中心。

english: Huili lies among the mountains north of the Jinsha River, on the routes between Sichuan and Yunnan. Its old walled town dates from the early Ming, and its streets, gates, temples and courtyard houses bear the imprint of the two regions. Local craftspeople also worked copper into household vessels; the making of copper hotpots was already established in the Ming and supplied markets in neighbouring districts.
simp_chinese: 会理位于金沙江以北的群山间，是四川与云南之间道路上的城镇。旧城始建于明初，城门、街巷、寺庙和院落呈现出川滇交汇的风貌。当地工匠也以铜制作日用器皿；铜火锅制作始于明代，产品销往周边地区。

english: Huiqi rises beside the Bei River southwest of Qingyuan, where the river bends on its way towards the Pearl River delta. The mountain stood near the boundary of the old Qingyuan district and the country of Sanshui. Its slopes overlooked a waterway that carried travellers and goods between the northern interior of Guangdong and the lowlands around Guangzhou.
simp_chinese: 回岐山位于清远西南的北江边，河流在此曲折南行，通向珠江三角洲。山地靠近旧清远县与三水地区的交界，俯瞰着连接广东北部内陆和广州附近低地的水路。

english: Huista was an Indigenous province on the Pacific coast of Chiriquí, in western Panama. Spanish expeditions reached this coast in the early sixteenth century as they extended their search for wealth and provisions westward from Panama. The chroniclers record that Gaspar de Espinosa came to Huista during his expedition and loaded a ship there with maize for the return journey. Its inhabitants were among the communities whose lives were changed by the Spanish advance along the coast.
simp_chinese: 维斯塔是巴拿马西部奇里基太平洋沿岸的一个原住民地区。十六世纪初，西班牙远征队从巴拿马向西寻找财富与补给，抵达这片海岸。编年史记载，加斯帕尔·德·埃斯皮诺萨在远征期间来到维斯塔，在此将玉米装船，运回巴拿马。随着西班牙人沿海岸推进，当地居民的生活也随之改变。

english: Huìtóng lies in the mountainous country of southwestern Hunan, near the border with Guizhou. The area was part of Lóngbiāo County under the Tang, before Lǎngxī County was separated from it. In 1102 the Song established Sānjiāng County here and renamed it Huìtóng the following year, placing it under Jìngzhōu. The district's river valleys and wooded hills became home to communities with different languages and traditions, including Dong and Miao people.
simp_chinese: 会同位于湖南西南山地，靠近贵州边境。唐代此地属龙标县，后来析置朗溪县。北宋崇宁元年（1102年）设三江县，次年改名会同县，隶属靖州。县境河谷与林木覆盖的山岭间，世代居住着侗族、苗族等不同语言和传统的社群。

english: Huitzquilic was an Indigenous settlement in the Ameca district of western Mexico, two leagues south of Ameca across level ground. Its name was explained through the thorny plants growing there. In 1579 it counted twenty tribute-paying householders, a small dependent community beside the district's principal town. Colonial government brought Huitzquilic under the same jurisdiction and tribute system as Ameca, whose dependent settlements belonged to the Crown. Memories of earlier rulers and of conflict with the lord of Pátzcuaro survived among Spanish residents and Indigenous elders. After Spanish authority replaced that political landscape, Huitzquilic kept its own name and its tributary households.
simp_chinese: 维茨基利克是墨西哥西部阿梅卡辖区内的一处原住民聚落，位于阿梅卡以南两里格，中间是平地。它的名称被解释为当地生长的带刺草木。1579年，这里登记有二十名纳贡户主，是紧邻辖区主镇的小型附属社群。殖民政府通过管辖与贡赋关系，把维茨基利克纳入与阿梅卡相同的制度。阿梅卡及其附属聚落归王室所有。早期统治者的记忆，以及与帕茨夸罗领主冲突的往事，仍在西班牙居民与原住民长者中流传。西班牙权力取代旧有政治格局后，维茨基利克仍保留自己的地名和纳贡家庭。

english:
Huivulau Bay belongs to the coastal world of Culiacan in northwestern Mexico, facing the Gulf of California. River valleys cut through the drier country and supported Indigenous farming communities, while shore and estuary produce supplied fish and other foods. Local exchange joined coastal settlements with the interior before Spanish conquest.

During the sixteenth century, Spanish expansion into Sinaloa brought new towns, livestock, missions and demands on Indigenous labour. The process was contested and uneven, with resistance and negotiation shaping the reach of colonial authority. The wider northwest later became connected to mining districts and missionary frontiers farther north. Coastal movement could carry supplies between settlements, although shallow waters, storms and limited harbour facilities constrained navigation.

Farming and stock raising supported both local households and distant demand. Huivulau Bay's historical setting consequently joins a productive river coast to a changing colonial frontier. Indigenous communities continued to adapt within that landscape, while imported animals, new religious institutions and commercial routes altered the relationships between sea, valley and upland.
simp_chinese:
维武劳湾属于墨西哥西北部库利亚坎海岸世界，面向加利福尼亚湾。河谷穿过较干旱土地，支撑原住民农业社群，海岸与河口资源则提供鱼类和其他食物。西班牙征服以前，地方交换已经连接沿海聚落与内陆。

十六世纪西班牙势力进入锡那罗亚，带来新城镇、牲畜、传教机构和对原住民劳动力的要求。这一过程并不均衡，抵抗与谈判共同决定殖民权力能够到达的范围。更广阔的西北地区后来又与矿区及更北方的传教边疆相连。沿海交通可在聚落间运送补给，但浅水、风暴和有限港湾条件制约航行。

农业和畜牧既维持本地家庭，也回应远方需求。海湾的历史环境因此把富于资源的河流海岸与变化中的殖民边疆结合起来。原住民持续调整生活，而外来牲畜、宗教机构及商业道路，也改变海洋、河谷和高地之间的关系。

english:
Huixian lies at the eastern foot of the Taihang Mountains in northern Henan, where the plain of Weihui meets the road up into Shanxi. The old county was Gong, a state of the Western Zhou, and in 1216 the Jin made it Huizhou, naming it for the Qinghui Hall built beside the springs under Sumen Mountain. Those springs, the Baiquan, are the setting of the Book of Songs verse about the bubbling spring that flows into the Qi.

Early in the Hongwu reign the Ming reduced Huizhou to a county under Weihui Prefecture. Its county school, founded under the Yuan, was repaired in 1376. The springs drew scholars: Shao Yong studied the Book of Changes here in the Northern Song, and the Yuan statesman Yelü Chucai and the philosopher Xu Heng were remembered by pavilions at Baiquan. In the 1550s the radical thinker Li Zhi served as school instructor at Gongcheng, as the county seat was still known, and in the 17th century the Confucian Sun Qifeng retired to the county to teach.
simp_chinese:
辉县位于河南北部太行山东麓，卫辉一带的平原在此与通往山西的道路相接。旧县名为共，西周时是共国。金贞祐四年（1216年）这里升为辉州，州名取自苏门山下泉边所建的清辉殿。这处泉水即百泉，《诗经·卫风》里“毖彼泉水，亦流于淇”所咏的就是这里。

明洪武初年，辉州降为辉县，隶卫辉府。县学建于元代，洪武九年（1376年）重修。百泉吸引了不少学者：北宋邵雍在这里研读《周易》，元初的耶律楚材和理学家许衡则在泉边亭榭中留下了记忆。嘉靖年间（16世纪50年代），思想家李贽曾任共城教谕；明末清初，大儒孙奇逢隐居于辉县讲学。

english: Huizache forms the northern basin of the Huizache–Caimanero lagoon system on the Pacific coast of Sinaloa. A sandy barrier separates its waters from the sea, while the winding Ostial estuary links Huizache with the Presidio River. Red, white and black mangroves grow along the estuaries; in the dry season, much of the lagoon becomes marsh as its waters retreat.
simp_chinese: 维萨切是锡那罗亚太平洋海岸维萨切—凯马内罗潟湖水系的北部盆地。沙洲将潟湖与大海隔开，蜿蜒的奥斯蒂亚尔河口水道则把维萨切与普雷西迪奥河相连。河口沿岸生长着红、白、黑三种红树；旱季湖水退去时，大片潟湖变成沼泽。

english:
Huizhou in the Longyou country governed the area around present-day Hui County in Gansu. Its position connected the Qin and Long districts with routes towards Hanzhong and Sichuan. Writing in the seventeenth century, Gu Zuyu stressed this relationship: the old Hechi district was a place contested whenever forces fought between the northwestern uplands and the Sichuan approaches. His geographical account treated its roads and neighbouring jurisdictions as matters of military importance.

The administrative name also changed during the period. Established as Huizhou in 1264, the prefecture was reduced to a county in 1377 and subsequently restored to subprefectural status under Gongchang Prefecture. It governed Liangdang as its subordinate county. In 1729 the Qing administration again reduced Huizhou to Hui County and placed it under Qinzhou. This was the northwestern Huizhou of the old Shaanxi administrative world, with a history shaped by the routes between Longyou and Sichuan.
simp_chinese:
陇右的徽州管辖今甘肃徽县一带，其位置联系秦陇地区与通往汉中、四川的道路。十七世纪，顾祖禹在地理著述中强调：旧河池地区在陇蜀发生战事时往往成为争夺之地。他对这里的道路和周边政区的记述，着眼于它们在军事上的意义。

这一时期，当地行政名称也数度变化。1264年设置徽州，1377年降为县，后来恢复州制，属巩昌府，领两当县。1729年，清朝再次将徽州降为徽县，归秦州管辖。这是旧陕西行政体系中的西北徽州，其地方历史与陇右通往四川的交通位置密切相连。

english:
Huizhou in Longyou was the predecessor of Huining in Gansu. By the Yuan period its administrative seat occupied the former Xining fortified town near the Zuli River. The site consisted of three adjoining enclosures built of rammed loess, protected by gates, projecting entrance defences and an outer ditch. Its position joined a substantial defensive circuit to the river valley.

In 1352 the government changed Huizhou's name to Huiningzhou following destructive earthquakes in the district. Ming administration subsequently placed it within Gongchang prefecture. A further reorganisation in 1377 reduced the department to Huining county and transferred the seat to the location of the later county town. The old fortified site gradually lost its administrative purpose and fell into disuse. Huizhou's history therefore includes a movement of the governing centre as well as a change of name and rank. The abandoned earth walls belong to that earlier seat, rather than to an unchanged town occupying one site throughout the Ming and Qing.
simp_chinese:
陇右会州是甘肃会宁的前身。元代时，州治设在祖厉河附近的旧西宁城，三个相连城垣以黄土夯筑，设城门、瓮城及外濠，将坚固防御与河谷地势结合起来。

1352年，当局因当地强烈地震，将会州改名会宁州。明代随后将其纳入巩昌府，1377年又降州为会宁县，把治所迁到后来的县城位置。旧城逐渐失去行政职能而荒废。因此，会州历史既包含名称、等级改变，也包含治理中心的移动。遗存土墙属于早先州治，不能视作明清始终原址延续的一座城。河岸军事要塞与后来县城之间的差别，是理解地方沿革及遗址的关键。

english:
Huju lay in the upper Yalu frontier country, where Joseon repeatedly opened, abandoned and restored military settlements. In the fifteenth century the area belonged to the frontier districts associated with Muchang and the Four Counties. Their remoteness made defence difficult, and the abolition of the counties in the 1450s left a long-lasting gap in regular administration.

A renewed garrison was established at Huju in 1674, when the Eomyeon post was transferred there. It was abolished in 1685 and its soldiers and civilians assigned to Eomyeon on the Jangjin River. Ginseng gatherers crossing the border and provoking friction with Qing China were the immediate reason for withdrawal. The post was restored in 1796 after repeated proposals to reopen the northern territory; in 1798 its command received the designation of an independent defensive garrison. In 1822 Huju became a dohobu under Hamgyeong administration. Settlement, military protection and control of border crossings remained closely connected.
simp_chinese:
厚州位于鸭绿江上游边地，朝鲜王朝曾多次在此设置、撤销和恢复军事据点。十五世纪，这一带属于茂昌及四郡所联系的边疆区域。距离遥远使防御与居民保护困难，十五世纪五十年代四郡陆续撤销，留下长期的行政空缺。

1674年，鱼面堡迁至厚州，重新建立驻军地。1685年厚州镇又被撤销，军民划归长津江畔的鱼面镇。采参者越境引发与清朝的摩擦，是撤镇的直接原因。朝廷反复讨论重新经营北方领土后，于1796年恢复厚州镇，1798年又将其长官称号改为独镇防守将。1822年，厚州升为都护府，当时隶属咸镜道。居民安置、驻军保护与越境管理，始终紧密交织。

english:
Hukawng lies in northern Myanmar, where broad valleys are surrounded by forested mountains. Rivers and passes connect different areas, though seasonal water and dense vegetation can make travel difficult.

The wider northern frontier lay between Burmese kingdoms, Shan-speaking principalities, and routes toward Assam and southwestern China. Authority often depended on local chiefs and negotiated relationships rather than continuous direct administration from a distant capital. Trade carried salt, textiles, metals, and forest products through chains of intermediaries. Political power could follow the main valleys, while upland communities retained considerable influence over passage through their own country. Hukawng's historical background is therefore that of an interconnected mountain frontier, where commerce and migration crossed cultural boundaries and where control of a route or a productive valley could matter more than a sharply surveyed border.
simp_chinese:
胡康位于缅甸北部，宽阔谷地周围环绕着森林山地。河流和山口连接不同地区，季节水情与茂密植被也可能使交通困难。

更广阔的北部边疆处在缅甸王国、掸语政治体及通往阿萨姆和中国西南的路线之间。权威常依靠地方首领与协商关系维持，远方都城难以实行连续直接治理。盐、纺织品、金属及森林物产通过多层中介流通。政治力量可能沿主要河谷推进，山地社群则对穿越其领地的通行保有重要影响。胡康的历史背景因此属于相互联系的山地边疆，贸易与迁移跨越文化界线。控制一条路线或一片可耕谷地，有时比划定清楚边界更具实际意义。

english:
Hukou occupies the outlet of Poyang Lake into the Yangtze, beneath the landmarks of Stone Bell Mountain. Its river traffic repeatedly attracted the attention of Ming and Qing revenue officials. A customs establishment was built below Lower Stone Bell Mountain in 1563 and abolished in 1567. In 1598 the tax eunuch Li Dao rebuilt it; after a fire, the offices rose again on a lavish scale. When the customs station moved away in 1615, local officials burned its main hall, fearing Li Dao's return and renewed exactions.

The Qing also tried to draw revenue from passing vessels. In 1717 the Jiangxi governor Bai Huang dredged Wuqu Harbour to berth merchant boats and established a tax office on its bank. Education occupied some of the same riverside ground. In 1724 the county magistrate Zhu Qizheng removed Buddhist images from premises beside the Jiangsheng Pavilion and converted them into the Stone Bell school. The school moved inside the town in 1741. Customs buildings, harbours and classrooms thus marked successive attempts to organize life at the lake's gateway.
simp_chinese:
湖口位于鄱阳湖注入长江的出口，石钟山耸立于水道旁。往来船运屡次吸引明清官府在此设厂征税。嘉靖四十二年（1563），下钟山麓建起税厂，隆庆元年（1567）撤销。万历二十六年（1598），税监李道重建税厂；火灾之后又大兴土木。万历四十三年（1615）关移别处，地方官恐李道重来横征，烧毁正厅，以内厅改作察院公馆。

清代官府继续设法从航运征收税款。康熙五十六年（1717），江西巡抚白潢疏浚武曲港，供商船停泊，并在港岸设税厂。教育也占用了江边的空间：雍正二年（1724），知县朱奇政移走江声阁旁的佛像，将房屋改为石钟义学。乾隆六年（1741），义学迁入城内。税厂、商港和学舍的兴废，留下了官府经营这一湖江门户的具体痕迹。

english: Hulagan, or Great Hula, was known to European traders as Grand Popo. It lay among the lagoons and waterways of the coast, and the Hula people regarded it as a common ancestral home. Hula settlements extended eastwards along the shore, including Glēxwé in the kingdom of Hueda. At Hulagan itself, a ruler based on an island in the lagoon was remembered as the “master of the lagoon”. Fishing and the coastal traffic sustained communities whose history was closely bound to the water.
simp_chinese: 胡拉甘意为“大胡拉”，欧洲商人称之为大波波。它坐落在海岸潟湖与水道之间，胡拉人视其为共同的祖居地。胡拉人的聚落沿海岸向东分布，休达王国的格莱克斯韦也是其中之一。胡拉甘的统治者居于潟湖中的岛上，被称作“潟湖之主”。捕鱼与沿岸交通养育了当地社群，他们的历史与水域紧密相连。

english:
Hulan's Qing development centred on the fertile lower Hulan River plain and the provisioning of northeastern garrisons. In 1734 the court strengthened the local military establishment partly to police unauthorized ginseng gathering. Troops were selected from Bodune, Dashing Ula and Guwalca, together with men from Qiqihar; cultivation around the garrison helped meet its food requirements.

In 1737 the court established forty official agricultural estates and selected four hundred able cultivators from Shengjing banner households to move there with their families. The migrants received travel provisions, assistance with transport, clothing, seed and materials for settling in; taxes were remitted in the first year and reduced in the second. This was organized relocation tied to banner institutions and state estates. On Hulan's alluvial farmland, military supply and the resettlement of households from more crowded banner lands became closely connected parts of Qing frontier policy.
simp_chinese:
呼兰在清代的发展，围绕呼兰河下游肥沃平原与东北驻军的粮食供应展开。1734年，朝廷加强当地驻防，其中一项任务是缉查私采人参的流民。兵丁从伯都讷、打牲乌拉、瓜尔察等处及齐齐哈尔挑拨，驻军周围的垦殖则帮助解决粮食需求。

1737年，清廷设立四十所官庄，从盛京八旗户中挑选四百名能耕种的壮丁，携家迁往呼兰。迁民获得沿途口粮、车船运输、衣物、种籽及安置援助，第一年免税，第二年减半。这是一项依托八旗组织与官庄的有计划移民。在呼兰的冲积平原上，军粮供应与从人地紧张的旗地迁入家庭，成为清代边疆政策彼此关联的两部分。

english: Hulawen was a name used for Jurchen communities in the country north of the Songhua, around the Hulan River. Their lands extended towards the hills east of the river and the forests beyond. The river valleys joined a broad plain where hunting, fishing and cultivation brought different communities into contact. Korean sources also used the name in connection with the Ula Jurchen, reflecting the varied names applied to peoples of the region.
simp_chinese: 忽剌温是松花江以北、呼兰河流域女真社群的名称之一。其地向东延伸至河东的丘陵及更远的森林。河谷与广阔平原相接，渔猎和耕作使不同社群在此往来。朝鲜史料也用这一名称指称乌拉女真，反映出该地区族群名称的多样性。

english: Hulbuk was the medieval capital of Khuttal, between the Vakhsh and Panj rivers. Its citadel enclosed the palace of the rulers, whose walls bore carved decoration and paintings. Arab geographers described a Friday mosque in the city, and roads through Khuttal linked Bukhara with Badakhshan and India. Hulbuk flourished under the Banijurids and their Samanid overlords, but was damaged in conflict and declined; nearby Kulob later emerged as a regional centre.
simp_chinese: 胡勒布克是瓦赫什河与喷赤河之间虎特尔地区的中世纪都城。城堡内有统治者的宫殿，墙面饰以雕刻与绘画。阿拉伯地理学家记载城中有主麻清真寺，穿过虎特尔的道路把布哈拉与巴达赫尚、印度联系起来。胡勒布克在巴尼朱尔王朝及其宗主萨曼王朝时期繁盛，后来因冲突受损并衰落，附近的库洛布逐渐成为地区中心。

english: Huliaipole lies on the Haichur River in the steppe north of the Sea of Azov. Its name evokes an open, roaming field, and the area was known for fairs before a permanent military settlement arose. A Russian outpost was established here in the 1770s as part of a defensive line facing the Crimean Khanate; in 1785 it was expanded into a state military settlement on former Zaporozhian lands.
simp_chinese: 古利艾波列位于亚速海以北草原上的海丘尔河畔。它的名称令人联想到可以漫游的开阔田野；在永久军事聚落出现之前，这一带就有集市。十八世纪七十年代，俄国在此建立哨所，作为面向克里米亚汗国的防线一部分；1785年，这里在原扎波罗热土地上扩建为国家军事聚落。

english: Hulin lies south of the Wanda Mountains near the Ussuri River. Forests, wetlands and river plains meet in this eastern part of the Amur basin. The Hezhen people lived by fishing and hunting along the river, making clothing from fish skin and vessels and other objects from birch bark. In the Ming period, the authorities established the Shilīmian guard in the Hulin area as part of their relations with communities along the Ussuri.
simp_chinese: 虎林位于完达山南麓、乌苏里江附近，是黑龙江流域东部森林、湿地与河流平原交汇之处。赫哲人长期沿江渔猎，用鱼皮制作衣服，并以桦树皮制作容器和其他日用器物。明代朝廷在虎林一带设立失里绵卫，将当地纳入与乌苏里江沿岸各社群的联系网络。

english:
Kingston upon Hull stands where the River Hull meets the Humber, connecting the rivers of Yorkshire and the Midlands with the North Sea. Founded as a port for the export of wool from the surrounding countryside, it grew into one of England's leading provincial harbours. Ships carried wool to northern Europe and returned with timber and other goods from ports around the Baltic Sea.

In April 1642 Charles I sought entry to Hull and its arsenal, but Governor Sir John Hotham barred the gates against the king. The confrontation preceded the outbreak of the Civil War. Hull remained in Parliamentary hands and resisted Royalist sieges in 1642 and 1643, its strong walls protecting both a valuable port and a large store of arms.
simp_chinese:
赫尔河畔金斯顿位于赫尔河与亨伯河交汇处，将约克郡和英格兰中部的河流与北海连接起来。它起初是羊毛出口港，后来发展为英格兰重要的地方港口之一。船只将羊毛运往北欧，返航时从波罗的海地区带回木材等货物。

1642年4月，查理一世试图进入赫尔并控制军械库，却被守将约翰·霍瑟姆爵士拒于城门之外。这场对峙发生在内战爆发前夕。赫尔始终掌握在议会派手中，抵御了1642年和1643年的王党围攻，城墙保护了宝贵的港口和大量军械。

english: Hulst, in the eastern part of the Flemish coastal lowlands, received its town rights in the twelfth century. Its position near the Scheldt made it a valuable fortified place during the long struggle between Spain and the Dutch Republic. Maurice of Orange took it in 1591, only for Archduke Albert to recover it five years later. Frederick Henry's forces failed to capture Hulst in 1640, but returned in 1645 and took the town after a siege. The star-shaped fortifications built in the seventeenth century surrounded it with ramparts and bastions. Hulst later endured another attack in 1702 and was taken by the French in 1747.
simp_chinese: 许尔斯特坐落在佛兰德海岸低地东部，于十二世纪获得城市权利。它靠近斯海尔德河，因而在西班牙与荷兰共和国的长期争斗中成为重要的设防城镇。奥兰治的毛里茨于1591年夺取此地，五年后阿尔布雷希特大公又将其收复。腓特烈·亨德里克的军队在1640年进攻许尔斯特失利，1645年再次归来，经过围攻后攻下城镇。十七世纪修筑的星形防御工事以城垣和棱堡环绕全城。1702年，许尔斯特再次经受进攻，1747年则被法国军队占领。

english: The upper Baram lies deep in the highlands of northern Borneo, where tributaries gather before the river flows west to the South China Sea. Kayan and Kenyah communities moved through the headwaters across the interior ranges into the Baram basin, a country also inhabited by other highland peoples. The river offered a route between their settlements and the trading centers nearer the coast.
simp_chinese: 巴兰河上游深入婆罗洲北部高地，支流在此汇合，河水随后向西流入南中国海。加央与肯雅社群穿越内陆山脉的河流源头，进入巴兰河流域；这片土地也有其他高地民族居住。河流为他们的聚落与更靠近海岸的贸易中心提供了通道。

english: Hulu Barito denotes the upper reaches of the Barito River in Borneo, where river travel connected inland Dayak communities with the markets downstream. Historical research places the upper basin within the Banjar sultanate's wider sphere from the sixteenth century, although this did not make its communities culturally uniform. Bakumpai traders played an important intermediary role, linking merchants at Muara Bahan and the Banjar estuary with traders from Hulu Barito and neighbouring watersheds. Their journeys carried goods as well as religious connections. A study of the fifteenth to nineteenth centuries describes Bakumpai settlement along the river and the spread of Islam through trade, marriage and friendship with other Dayak communities. Conversion was therefore part of continuing local relationships and movement, rather than a single event affecting the whole basin at once. The river joined settlements with different languages and religious practices into a commercial network, while the court at Banjarmasin represented a more distant layer of political authority.
simp_chinese: 上巴里托指婆罗洲巴里托河上游，河流交通将内陆达雅克社群同下游市场联系起来。历史研究把上游流域置于十六世纪以来班贾尔苏丹国更广泛的势力范围之内，但各地社区并未因此成为文化一致的整体。巴贡派商人发挥了重要的中介作用，将穆阿拉巴汉、班贾尔河口的商人与上巴里托及邻近流域的交易者连接起来。他们的往来既运送货物，也建立宗教联系。一项研究十五至十九世纪历史的论文描述，巴贡派人沿河建立聚落，并通过贸易、婚姻及同其他达雅克社群的交往传播伊斯兰教。改宗因而属于持续的地方关系和人口流动，不能归结为一次同时改变整个流域的事件。河流使语言与信仰不同的聚落参与同一商业网络，而班贾尔马辛王廷则构成较远的一层政治权威。

english: Hulu Jelai is the upper river country of the Jelai in southern Borneo. Its streams descend through the forested interior toward the lower river and the Java Sea. Downstream, the Jelai is joined by the Mapam, one of the tributaries that add water to its course. The river forms a long natural connection between inland forests and the lowlands near the coast, where its waters are affected by the tides.
simp_chinese: 上惹莱位于婆罗洲南部惹莱河的上游地区。溪流穿过森林内陆，向下游及爪哇海流去。下游的惹莱河接纳马帕姆河等支流，河水因此不断汇集。河流是内陆森林与近海低地之间漫长的天然通道；靠近海岸的河水还受到潮汐影响。

english: The upper Kahayan flows through the forested interior of central Borneo, gathering streams from the island's highlands before turning south toward the Java Sea. Ngaju Dayak communities inhabit the river country and its tributaries, speaking related local varieties of their language. The upper valleys form part of a landscape where rivers provide the principal connections between settlements scattered through the forest.
simp_chinese: 卡哈扬河上游流经婆罗洲中部森林覆盖的内陆，汇集岛屿高地的溪流后向南流向爪哇海。恩加朱达雅克社群居住在河流及支流沿岸，使用彼此相关的地方语言变体。上游河谷属于一片河流为森林中分散聚落提供主要联系的土地。

english: Hulu Kapuas is the upper country of the Kapuas River of southern Borneo. This river is distinct from the much longer Kapuas that crosses the western part of the island. Flowing south from the interior highlands, the southern river belongs to a landscape of forested watersheds and waterways leading toward the Java Sea. Communities along the Kapuas and its branches formed settlements connected by the river and its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 上卡普阿斯位于婆罗洲南部卡普阿斯河的上游。这条河不同于横贯岛屿西部、长度更大的同名河流。南部卡普阿斯河从内陆高地向南流，穿过森林覆盖的流域，通往爪哇海。沿河及其支流的社群形成聚落，河流和支流将它们联系起来。

english: The upper Kinabatangan lies in the forested interior of northern Borneo. From its headwaters in the mountains of southwestern Sabah, the river winds eastward for hundreds of kilometres to the Sulu Sea. Its great basin gathers the waters of tributaries including the Kuamut, Maliau and Lokan. Rainfall in the upper country feeds the floods of the lower river, where meanders and abandoned channels mark the movement of water across the plain.
simp_chinese: 京那巴当岸河上游位于婆罗洲北部的森林内陆。河流发源于沙巴西南部山地，向东蜿蜒数百公里注入苏禄海。广大的流域汇集库阿穆特、马廖和洛干等支流的河水。上游降雨补给下游洪水，平原上的河曲与废弃河道记录着水流的迁移。

english: The upper Labuk lies among the forested hills of northern Borneo, upstream from the river's mouth on Labuk Bay. The Labuk Dusun are one of the indigenous communities associated with this country. Tributaries gather in the interior before the river turns toward the eastern coast, connecting the high valleys with the lowlands and the waters of the Sulu Sea.
simp_chinese: 拉布克河上游位于婆罗洲北部森林覆盖的丘陵间，下游河口通向拉布克湾。拉布克杜顺人是与这一地区有关的原住民社群之一。支流在内陆汇集，河流随后转向东岸，将高地河谷与低地及苏禄海水域联系起来。

english: Hulu Lamandau lies in the upper basin of the Lamandau River in southern Borneo. Forested hills and tributary valleys feed a river that runs toward the lowlands and the Java Sea. The river belongs to a landscape in which waterways carry the drainage of the interior through broad tropical forests before reaching the coast. Its upper country lies inland from the settlements of the lower Lamandau basin.
simp_chinese: 上拉曼道位于婆罗洲南部拉曼道河的上游流域。森林覆盖的丘陵与支流河谷汇成河水，流向低地和爪哇海。这条河所在的地带，水道穿过广阔热带森林，将内陆的水带往海岸；上游地区位于拉曼道河下游聚落的内陆一侧。

english: The upper Limbang lies in the forested mountains of northern Borneo, where streams gather before the river flows north to Brunei Bay. Its basin formed part of the hinterland of Brunei, linking inland communities with the riverine capital and coast. Bisaya communities lived in the Limbang country, while the upper valleys extend toward the highlands separating the river from neighboring watersheds.
simp_chinese: 林梦河上游位于婆罗洲北部森林覆盖的群山中，溪流汇合后向北流入文莱湾。流域是文莱腹地的一部分，将内陆社群与河上都城及海岸联系起来。比沙亚社群居住在林梦地区，上游河谷则延伸至分隔邻近流域的高地。

english: The upper Mahakam rises in the mountains of central Borneo and flows eastward through steep forested country. Tributaries gather along its course before the river reaches the broader lowlands and lakes downstream. Kayan and Kenyah communities moved through the headwaters of the Mahakam and neighboring rivers, crossing the interior ranges into other basins. The river links this highland world to the coast of eastern Borneo.
simp_chinese: 马哈坎河上游发源于婆罗洲中部群山，向东流经陡峭的森林地带。支流沿途汇合，河流再抵达下游较宽阔的低地与湖泊。加央和肯雅社群曾穿行于马哈坎河及邻近河流的源头，越过内陆山脉进入其他流域。河流将这片高地世界与婆罗洲东岸相连。

english:
Hulu Melawai forms part of the upper Melawi river country, connected downstream with Sintang at the meeting of the Melawi and Kapuas. River junctions gave the court at Sintang a means to watch traffic, but upstream communities also supplied forces capable of challenging its power. In 1722, Kayan and Tebidah groups from the Melawi country launched a major attack on Sintang during the rule of Pangeran Tunggal.

The court's survival depended on an alliance reaching beyond the Melawi. Tunggal sought assistance through his sister, Putri Nyai Cili, whose marriage linked her to Mangku Melik of Embaloh in the upper Kapuas. Reinforcements from Iban and Batang Lupar groups helped force the attackers to withdraw. The episode places the upper Melawi within a political world of competing river communities and marriage alliances. Connections with downstream rulers could carry conflict and military obligations as well as commerce, without making every inland community a passive dependency of the court.
simp_chinese:
上美拉威属于美拉威河上游地区，沿水路向下可达美拉威河与卡普阿斯河交汇处的新当。河流交汇点使新当王廷得以监视往来交通，上游社群也能集结足以挑战王权的力量。1722年，在邦厄兰·通加尔统治期间，来自美拉威地区的卡扬人与特比达群体向新当发动大规模进攻。

王廷的存续依靠跨出美拉威流域的联盟。通加尔通过妹妹普特里·尼艾·吉利求援；她的婚姻将王室与卡普阿斯上游恩巴洛的芒库·梅利克联系起来。伊班与巴当鲁帕尔群体的增援，帮助迫使进攻者撤退。这段事件把上美拉威置于相互竞争的河流社群与婚姻联盟之中：通往下游王廷的联系，既传递商业往来，也带来冲突与军事义务，内陆各社群仍是能够主动行动的政治力量。

sources.title: Budaya Sungai pada Masyarakat Kota Sintang, Provinsi Kalimantan Barat.pdf

english: Hulu Mendawai is the upper country of the Mendawai, also known as the Katingan River, in southern Borneo. The river rises in the Schwaner Mountains and flows south through the forested interior toward the Java Sea. Its basin lies beside that of the Mentaya, another great river draining the island's central highlands. Together these waterways cross a broad landscape of tropical forest and lowland river country before reaching the coast.
simp_chinese: 上门达瓦伊位于婆罗洲南部的门达瓦伊河上游；这条河也称卡廷岸河，发源于施瓦纳山脉，向南穿过森林内陆，流向爪哇海。其流域与门塔亚河流域相邻，后者也是从岛屿中央高地流下的大河。两条水系穿越广阔的热带森林与低地河谷，最终抵达海岸。

english: Hulu Mentaya lies in the upper basin of the Mentaya River, also called the Sampit, in southern Borneo. The river runs south from the interior to Sampit Bay and the Java Sea. North of its lower course it receives a number of tributaries, which drain a wide area of forested country. The neighbouring Katingan basin carries another river from the island's highlands toward the same southern coast.
simp_chinese: 上门塔亚位于婆罗洲南部的门塔亚河上游流域；这条河也称桑皮特河，从内陆向南流入桑皮特湾和爪哇海。其下游以北汇集多条支流，排泄广阔森林地区的水。邻近的卡廷岸流域也有一条河流从岛屿高地流向同一片南岸。

english: The upper Mesuji lies in the forested lowlands of southern Sumatra, north of the Tulang Bawang river system. Its streams flow east towards the coastal plain and the Java Sea. The rivers of this country cross wet ground and low hills, linking inland settlements with the broad estuaries of the east coast. Farther south, the Tulang Bawang served as a route for the pepper trade between Lampung and the maritime world across the Sunda Strait.
simp_chinese: 默苏吉河上游位于苏门答腊南部森林低地，在杜朗巴旺水系以北。溪流向东流往沿海平原和爪哇海。这片地区的河流穿越湿地与低丘，将内陆聚落与东海岸宽阔的河口相连。更南方的杜朗巴旺河曾是胡椒贸易的路线，连接楠榜与巽他海峡对岸的海上世界。

english: The upper Musi rises in the Barisan Mountains of southern Sumatra and flows through forested valleys towards the eastern plains. From its mountain sources the river gathers many tributaries before passing Palembang and reaching the Bangka Strait. Rapids and bends mark the upper course, while streams descending from neighbouring ridges add to its waters. The Musi forms the principal artery of a basin that connects the highlands with the island's eastern coast.
simp_chinese: 穆西河上游发源于苏门答腊南部巴里桑山脉，穿过森林河谷流向东部平原。从山地源头出发，河流汇集许多支流，经过巨港后抵达邦加海峡。上游河段布满急流和河弯，邻近山岭流下的溪水不断汇入。穆西河是整个流域的主要干道，将高地与岛屿东海岸连接起来。

english: Hulu Padas is the headwater country of the Padas River in northern Borneo. Mountain ridges and forested valleys shelter the streams that feed the river before it passes through the interior toward the South China Sea. The upper basin lies close to the great watersheds of the island, where rivers descend in different directions from the high country. The Padas continues through a deep gorge before reaching the coastal lowlands near Beaufort.
simp_chinese: 上巴打斯是婆罗洲北部巴打斯河的源流地带。山脊与森林河谷中汇集的溪流注入巴打斯河，继而穿越内陆，流向南海。上游流域靠近岛上重要的分水岭，河流从高地分向不同方向。巴打斯河穿过深峡谷，最终抵达博福特附近的沿海低地。

english:
Hulu Paser denotes the inland, upper-river side of the Paser region in southeastern Borneo. Its early modern context belongs to a wider royal domain, whose coastal court should not be confused with every upstream community. Local dynastic history traces the kingdom of Sadurengas to the sixteenth century and identifies the female ruler Putri Di Dalam Petung with its beginnings.

The same historical tradition records a succession of titled rulers during the seventeenth century. In the early eighteenth century Aji Geger bore the title Sultan Aji Muhammad Alamsyah, marking the sultanate within this regional genealogy. By 1799 Sultan Sulaiman Alamsyah appears in the surviving diplomatic correspondence, including a letter sent from Batavia to Paser. These records place the region within relations extending beyond Borneo.
simp_chinese:
上琶设指婆罗洲东南部琶设地区的内陆河流上游。其近世背景属于更大的王权领域，沿海王廷不能直接等同于每一个上游社群。地方王朝史将萨杜伦加斯王国追溯至十六世纪，并把女王普特丽·迪达兰佩通同其开端联系起来。

同一历史传统记载了十七世纪一系列有封号的统治者。十八世纪初，阿吉·格格尔使用苏丹阿吉·穆罕默德·阿兰沙之号，使苏丹制度进入这条区域谱系。到1799年，苏丹苏莱曼·阿兰沙见于存世的外交通信，包括巴达维亚发往琶设的信件。这些记录将地区放入超越婆罗洲的关系中。

english: The upper Pawan drains the forested interior of western Borneo towards the South China Sea. Downstream the river passes Tanjungpura and reaches the coast at Ketapang. In the seventeenth century Indra Laya, on the Puye tributary of the Pawan, became a centre of the Tanjungpura royal house; upstream communities and coastal rulers shared the river basin.
simp_chinese: 帕万河上游汇集婆罗洲西部森林内陆的水，流向南中国海。下游的河流经过丹戎普拉，在吉打邦抵达海岸。17世纪，帕万河支流普耶河畔的因德拉拉亚成为丹戎普拉王室的中心之一；上游社群与沿海统治者共享这一河流流域。

english: The upper Sambas lies in the forested hills of western Borneo, where tributaries gather before the river reaches the coast. Downstream, the Sambas became the center of a Malay sultanate connected to the trade of the South China Sea. Its upper valleys were home to inland communities whose waterways and paths led toward the lower river and neighboring basins.
simp_chinese: 三发河上游位于婆罗洲西部森林覆盖的丘陵中，支流在此汇集后流向海岸。下游的三发后来成为马来苏丹国中心，与南中国海贸易相连。上游河谷则是内陆社群的家园，水道与小径通往下游河流和邻近流域。

english: The upper Segama is a forested river country in northeastern Borneo. Rising in the Brassey Ranges, the river passes through hills and the country near Danum Valley before making its way toward the Sulu Sea. The Danum and Bole are among the principal tributaries of its large catchment. Streams and rivers cut through the tropical forest, carrying water from the higher ground toward the lowlands of the eastern coast.
simp_chinese: 西加麦河上游是婆罗洲东北部的一片森林河谷。河流发源于布拉西山脉，穿过丘陵和丹浓谷附近的地带，随后流向苏禄海。丹浓河与博勒河是其广阔流域的主要支流。溪流与河道穿过热带森林，将高地的水带往东岸低地。

english: The upper Sembakung lies in the forested interior of northeastern Borneo, far upstream from the river's coastal channels. The river basin is part of the traditional territory of Tidung-speaking communities, whose lands extend from the headwaters toward the estuaries north of Tarakan. Its tributaries cut through hills before joining the lower river and the waters of the Celebes Sea.
simp_chinese: 森巴贡河上游位于婆罗洲东北部森林覆盖的内陆，远在沿海河汊的上游。流域是说迪东语社群的传统家园之一，他们的土地从源头延伸至打拉根以北的河口。支流穿过丘陵，汇入下游河道及西里伯斯海水域。

english: The upper Seruyan lies in the forested interior of southern Borneo, beneath the Schwaner Mountains where the river rises. From these hills the Seruyan runs south through a broad basin towards the Java Sea. Its course joins the upland streams to the lower river country and the coast, crossing landscapes that change from rugged hills to flat, wet lowlands. The river and its tributaries form the principal natural routes through this heavily wooded region.
simp_chinese: 塞鲁扬河上游位于婆罗洲南部森林覆盖的内陆，河流发源于施瓦纳山脉。塞鲁扬河从山地向南流过广阔流域，最终抵达爪哇海。它把高地溪流同下游河区及海岸连接起来，沿途景观从崎岖丘陵变为平坦湿润的低地。河流及其支流构成穿越这片茂密林地的主要天然通道。

english: The upper Telen lies in the forested interior of eastern Borneo, where tributaries gather among the hills before flowing toward the Mahakam. The river is part of a vast basin that reaches the Makassar Strait through the Mahakam delta. Its upper valleys form a landscape of tropical forest and waterways, connected to the lower river by a succession of streams and channels.
simp_chinese: 特伦河上游位于婆罗洲东部森林覆盖的内陆，支流在丘陵间汇集后流向马哈坎河。它属于广阔的马哈坎流域，河水经三角洲注入望加锡海峡。上游河谷由热带森林与水道构成，一连串溪流和河道将它与下游连接起来。

english:
Hulun's Qing administrative centre developed beside the Yimin River, in the country later known through the name Hailar. Earlier imperial institutions had already reached this district: in 1433 a Haila'er thousand-household office and the Hanhan relay station were established within the area's present limits, under the Nurgan regional command.

A different frontier settlement took shape in the early 1730s. The Qing established a Hulunbuir commander in 1732 and transferred banner soldiers to guard the northern grasslands. The new centre on the Yimin's western bank was named Hulunbuir, joining the names of the Hulun and Buir lakes. Military organization connected several local and resettled peoples, including Daur and Oroqen soldiers, with Qing frontier administration. In 1820 the regional superintendent was recorded as stationed at Hulun Buyur, the same administrative centre. The town's development therefore followed the establishment of a fixed military headquarters within a much larger pastoral landscape.
simp_chinese:
呼伦的清代行政中心在伊敏河畔形成，这片地区后来更多以海拉尔之名称闻名。此前，帝国机构已经进入这里：1433年，在今海拉尔区境内设置海刺儿千户所与寒寒寨站，隶属奴儿干都司。

十八世纪三十年代初，新的边疆据点开始形成。1732年，清廷设置呼伦贝尔统领，调拨旗兵守卫北部草原。伊敏河西岸的新城命名为呼伦贝尔，将呼伦湖与贝尔湖的名称合在一起。驻防组织把当地及迁入的不同人群，包括达斡尔、鄂伦春兵丁，与清代边疆行政联系起来。1820年的建置记录，仍将呼伦布雨尔列为地区总管驻地。城镇的发展因此围绕固定军事总部展开，其周围则是范围广大的游牧地区。

english: Hum is a Guenoa name for the Río Negro, the great river that crosses the grassy interior of the Banda Oriental before joining the Uruguay. Its course bends westward through rolling country, receiving tributaries and providing crossings between the lands on either bank. Guenoa and other Indigenous peoples knew this landscape long before colonial ranches spread across the plains. The river remained a prominent landmark in a region where livestock and mounted travel later transformed life on the open grasslands.
simp_chinese: 胡姆是格诺亚人对内格罗河的称呼。这条大河横贯东岸地区的草原腹地，最后汇入乌拉圭河。河道穿过起伏的土地向西蜿蜒，沿途接纳支流，渡口连接两岸。在殖民牧场遍布平原之前，格诺亚人及其他原住民早已熟悉这片河流与草地。后来，牲畜和骑乘改变了开阔草原上的生活，河流仍是这一地区醒目的地理标志。

english: The Humadea River descends from the eastern Colombian Andes into the Llanos, contributing its waters to the upper Meta system. Mountain streams join on the foothill plain before flowing east through savannas and wetlands toward the Orinoco. Rainfall in the highlands can swell the rivers, while the plains experience a marked dry season. The river is one of several waterways connecting the mountain slopes with the extensive lowlands.
simp_chinese: 乌马德亚河从哥伦比亚安第斯山东部流入亚诺斯，为梅塔河上游水系提供河水。山间溪流在山麓平原汇合，然后向东穿过稀树草原和湿地，流向奥里诺科河。高地降雨可能使河流暴涨，平原则有明显的旱季。乌马德亚河是连接山坡与广阔低地的众多水道之一。

english: Humar is the river country of the Greater Khingan, where the Huma flows from forested hills toward the Amur. Oroqen communities of its valley called themselves Kumarchen, taking their name from the river. Hunting and fishing linked their lives to its tributaries and the surrounding woods. In 1655 Qing forces attacked a Russian fort near the mouth of the Huma, held by Onufriy Stepanov's men. The battle damaged the Russian force, though the Qing could not maintain the siege for lack of supplies. Later Qing administration organized Oroqen hunters into districts and collected sable tribute, while some served in the Buteha banners.
simp_chinese: 呼玛是大兴安岭中的河流地区，呼玛河从森林山地流向黑龙江。河谷中的鄂伦春人以河名自称库玛尔千，狩猎和捕鱼把他们的生活与支流及周围山林联系在一起。1655年，清军在呼玛河口附近进攻由斯捷潘诺夫部众据守的俄军堡垒。战斗重创俄军，但清军因补给不足而未能继续围攻。后来清朝将鄂伦春猎人划入各路，征收貂皮贡赋，也有部分人编入布特哈旗服役。

english: Humati was an Indigenous town recorded during Hernando de Soto's passage through the Alabama interior in 1540. The expedition camped beside a river with Humati on the opposite bank, after leaving Casiste and before reaching the domain of the chief Tuskaloosa. The Spanish account gives only a glimpse of the town, yet places it among the communities that occupied the river valleys long before the expedition made its violent journey through the Southeast.
simp_chinese: 胡马蒂是一座原住民城镇，1540年埃尔南多·德·索托穿过阿拉巴马内陆时曾将它记入远征记录。一行人离开卡西斯泰、抵达首领塔斯卡卢萨的领地之前，在一条河边扎营，胡马蒂就在对岸。西班牙人的记载只留下这座城镇的一瞥，却表明远在远征队沿途施暴以前，河谷中已有社群居住。

english: Humbe lies in the country of the Cunene, where cattle gave wealth and standing to pastoral communities. The Humbe kingdom was one of the Nhaneca-Humbe states of southern Angola and was known for its herds. Its traders sold ivory, while raids in the neighbouring highlands supplied captives for the trade through Benguela. Conflict with neighbouring peoples brought danger to Humbe itself, as cattle and people alike could be taken in raids.
simp_chinese: 洪贝位于库内内河流域，牛群是当地牧民的财富和地位来源。洪贝王国是安哥拉南部的尼亚内卡—洪贝诸国之一，以牲畜众多著称。商人出售象牙，对邻近高地的袭击则为经本格拉进行的贸易提供俘虏。与邻族的冲突也威胁洪贝自身，袭击者可能掠走牛群和人口。

english: The Humber is a broad tidal estuary linking the rivers of Yorkshire and the East Midlands to the North Sea. Its waters pass Hull and open to the sea between the Lincolnshire shore and the long spit of Spurn Head. At the junction of the Humber and the River Hull, a medieval port grew under the patronage of Meaux Abbey. Wool from inland estates passed through it to northern Europe, while timber arrived from the Baltic; smaller boats carried cargo onward to towns on the rivers beyond the estuary.
simp_chinese: 亨伯河口宽阔而受潮汐影响，连接约克郡、东米德兰兹的河流与北海。水道流经赫尔，在林肯郡海岸与细长的斯彭角之间通向外海。亨伯河与赫尔河交汇处的中世纪港口，在莫修道院的扶持下发展起来。内陆庄园出产的羊毛经此运往北欧，波罗的海木材则从这里输入；小船再将货物沿河运往河口以上的城镇。

english: The Humboldt River flows west across the northern Great Basin, gathering streams from mountain ranges before ending in an inland sink. Its valley lies within the homelands of Northern Paiute and Western Shoshone peoples, who used the river, wetlands and neighbouring uplands through the seasons. In 1828 the Hudson's Bay Company trader Peter Skene Ogden reached the river and called it the Unknown River, uncertain where its waters went. His party followed a corridor already familiar to its Indigenous inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 洪堡河向西流过大盆地北部，汇集来自山脉的溪水，最终终止于内陆洼地。河谷位于北派尤特人与西肖肖尼人的故土中，人们随季节利用河流、湿地和邻近高地。1828年，哈德逊湾公司商人彼得·斯基恩·奥格登抵达此河；他不知水流去向，称其为“未知河”。他的队伍沿着原住民居民早已熟悉的通道前行。

english:
The waters of Humboldty Bay belong to the northern Pacific coast of North America, where river mouths, forests and sheltered inlets supported Indigenous communities. Fishing, gathering shellfish and using woodland produce were parts of a seasonal economy that joined the shore to inland valleys. Canoes and coastal paths connected settlements, while local knowledge of tides, surf and river bars guided movement along a demanding coast.

European voyages began charting the wider Pacific shore during the early later period, but a sighting from a ship did not immediately establish control over the land. Spanish, British and other navigators later approached the northern coast in the context of exploration and imperial rivalry. By the late eighteenth century, maritime fur trading added new commercial demands, drawing coastal communities into exchanges for metal goods and other imports.

Contact could bring opportunities, conflict and unfamiliar disease. Around this bay, the regional historical setting therefore combines an older Indigenous seascape with the gradual approach of foreign shipping. Forested shores were inhabited and named long before they were entered on distant charts, and their produce depended on social relationships as well as physical access.
simp_chinese:
洪堡湾水域属于北美北太平洋海岸，河口、森林与避风海湾支撑原住民社群。捕鱼、采贝和利用林产是季节经济的一部分，把岸边接向内陆谷地。独木舟、沿岸小路连接聚落，地方对潮汐、浪涌和河口沙坝的知识，引导人群穿过艰难海岸。

近代早期，欧洲航行开始描绘更大太平洋岸线，但船上望见陆地并不立即形成控制。西班牙、英国及其他航海者后来在探险、帝国竞争中接近北部海岸。十八世纪末，海上毛皮贸易增加新商业需求，让沿海社区用兽皮交换金属物和其他进口品，接触也可能带来冲突、陌生疾病。

因此，本湾区域历史环境结合更古老原住民海洋世界，以及外国船运逐渐到来。森林海岸早于远方海图已有居民、地名，资源获取依赖社会关系，也依赖实际通行条件。新商业进入以后，既有社群仍是海岸生活的参与者。

english: Humcumqua is a name associated with the Inqua, Khoekhoe herders of the interior beyond the southern Cape mountains. Seventeenth-century accounts place the Inqua north of the coastal Gouriqua and Attaqua peoples. Their cattle and sheep drew the interest of the Dutch East India Company at the Cape. In 1689 an expedition under Isaac Schrijver reached the Inqua leader Hykon, who met the visitors and traded livestock with them.
simp_chinese: 洪昆夸是与因夸有关的名称；因夸是开普南部群山以外内陆的科伊科伊牧人。十七世纪的记载将因夸置于沿海古里夸和阿塔夸人以北。他们的牛羊引起了开普荷兰东印度公司的兴趣。1689年，伊萨克·施赖弗率领的远征队抵达因夸领袖海孔的地区，海孔会见来客，并与他们交换牲畜。

english:
Humenné stands near the meeting of the Laborec and Cirocha rivers, on an important route between Hungary and Poland. It became the seat of the Drugeth family, whose great estate encompassed many villages in Upper Zemplín. Trade and a royal customs station contributed to the life of the market town beneath their residence.

Around 1610 the Drugeths built a Renaissance manor on the site of an older stone castle. George Drugeth, having become Catholic, invited the Jesuits to Humenné; their school opened in 1613 and the college was formally endowed in 1615. It played a part in the restoration of Catholic influence in the town and its surrounding villages. The college moved to Užhorod in 1640, though Jesuits continued to work in Humenné thereafter.
simp_chinese:
胡门内坐落在拉博雷茨河与奇罗哈河汇合处附近，位于匈牙利和波兰之间的道路上。它成为德鲁盖特家族的驻地，其庞大领地包括上曾普林的许多村庄。贸易和关税站为这座领主宅邸下的集镇带来了生机。

约1610年，德鲁盖特家族在旧石堡的原址上建起文艺复兴式宅邸。改信天主教的德鲁盖特·久尔吉邀请耶稣会来到胡门内；学校于1613年开办，学院于1615年正式获得捐赠。它在当地天主教势力的恢复中发挥了作用。1640年，学院迁往乌日霍罗德，但耶稣会士此后仍在胡门内活动。

english:
Huncun lies near the lower Tumen, where wooded hills approach the sea. The old walled site at Baliencheng is commonly identified with Longyuan, the eastern capital of Balhae. For a time in the late eighth century it served as the kingdom's royal capital, and a route from here toward the coast carried envoys bound for Japan. Earthen walls and palace foundations preserve the outline of this earlier centre.

After Balhae's fall, Jurchen communities inhabited the surrounding country. In 1714 the Qing established a garrison command at Huncun, making the area an important station of its northeastern frontier administration. The old capital and the later garrison belonged to different ages, but both looked toward the routes linking the Tumen valley with the eastern sea.
simp_chinese:
珲春位于图们江下游附近，林木山岭在此接近大海。八连城遗址通常被认为是渤海东京龙原府。八世纪末，龙原府曾一度作为渤海王都，从这里通向海岸的道路供赴日本的使节使用。土城墙和宫殿基址保存着旧都的轮廓。

渤海灭亡后，女真社群居住于周围地区。1714年，清朝在珲春设驻防协领，使这里成为东北边疆的重要据点。古都与后来的驻防城属于不同时代，却都面向连接图们江谷地和东海的道路。

english:
Hunedoara grew beneath the castle of the Hunyadi family, at the edge of the Transylvanian mountains. Its towers and long bridge rise above the stream and rock on which an earlier royal fortress stood. The castle combined a defensive position with halls and chambers worthy of one of the kingdom's most powerful families.

In 1409 King Sigismund granted the estate to Voicu, father of John Hunyadi. After 1441 John, voivode of Transylvania and later governor of Hungary, transformed the old fortress with new walls and towers. As his power grew, he added a chapel and ceremonial halls, including a great hall whose inscription bears his name and the date 1452. After his death in 1456, building continued under his son Matthias Corvinus. A northern wing with arcades and secular paintings brought Renaissance decoration to the Gothic residence.
simp_chinese:
胡内多阿拉在特兰西瓦尼亚山地边缘、匈雅提家族的城堡下发展起来。塔楼和长桥高出溪流与岩石，早先的王室要塞便建在这里。城堡将防御地势与适合王国最强大家族之一的厅堂居室结合在一起。

1409年，西吉斯蒙德国王将领地赐给沃伊库，他是匈雅提·亚诺什的父亲。1441年后，身为特兰西瓦尼亚总督、后来成为匈牙利摄政的亚诺什，以新城墙和塔楼改造旧要塞。随着权势增长，他增建礼拜堂和典礼大厅，其中一座大厅的铭文刻有他的名字及1452年。1456年他去世后，儿子马加什·科尔温继续工程。北翼的拱廊和世俗题材绘画，为哥特式居所增添了文艺复兴装饰。

english:
Hünfeld developed within the lands of Fulda, above the Haune River. Its origins lay in Charlemagne's donation of Campus Unofelt to Fulda monastery in 781 and the religious community established there. By around the year 1000 the settlement had two churches. The grant of Gelnhausen town rights in 1310 gave another impulse to its development.

The town's livelihood was closely connected to movement. The old Antsanvia military and trading road, followed by the Frankfurt–Leipzig commercial route, brought merchants needing accommodation, craft services and additional teams to pull their wagons. The same location became a liability during warfare, when passing armies demanded quarters and supplies or plundered the town. Napoleon passed through Hünfeld repeatedly on his campaigns. Goethe also stopped there and left a poem reflecting the effects of the Napoleonic wars. Hünfeld's history thus connects its ecclesiastical origins and municipal rights with the practical fortunes of a small road town.
simp_chinese:
欣费尔德在富尔达领地内、豪讷河上方发展起来，其起源与查理曼于781年将“乌诺费尔特原野”捐给富尔达修道院及当地宗教社群有关。约公元1000年，聚落已有两座教堂；1310年获授盖尔恩豪森式城市权利，又推动了城镇发展。

行旅交通是居民的重要生计。较早的安特桑维亚军商道路，以及后来的法兰克福—莱比锡商道，带来需要住宿、手工业服务和加牲口牵引货车的商人。战争期间，同样的位置却使城镇承受驻军、征发与劫掠。拿破仑多次在征途中经过欣费尔德，歌德也曾停留，并留下反映拿破仑战争影响的诗作。宗教领地的起源、城市法权与道路带来的实际收入和负担，共同塑造了它的历史。

english: Betpak-Dala, the Hungry Steppe, is an arid expanse between the lower Sarysu, the Chu River and Lake Balkhash. Its stony and clay plains have little rainfall, and salt depressions interrupt the desert vegetation. The lower Sarysu offered winter pasture and a way across this difficult country. Beyond the desert lie the Kazakh uplands, whose river valleys and hills contrast with the open dry plains.
simp_chinese: 别特帕克达拉又称饥饿草原，是萨雷苏河下游、楚河与巴尔喀什湖之间的一片干旱地带。石质和黏土平原降雨稀少，盐碱洼地散布在荒漠植被之间。萨雷苏河下游提供冬季牧场，也为穿越这片艰难地带提供通路。荒漠之外是哈萨克高地，其河谷与丘陵同开阔干燥的平原形成对比。

english:
The country later called Hungry Horse lies at the junction of the Flathead River and its South Fork in northwestern Montana. Before the dam and its settlement existed, these mountain valleys formed part of a wider Indigenous landscape used by Salish, Pend d'Oreille and Kootenai peoples. The rivers, mountain crossings and hunting grounds belonged to networks extending beyond the immediate confluence.

Around 1700, Salish and Pend d'Oreille communities acquired horses through neighbouring peoples. Horses enlarged the seasonal round, increased visits and intermarriage with allies, and made journeys to buffalo country easier. They also intensified raiding and conflict. Fire helped maintain the grasslands needed by growing horse herds. In the early nineteenth century, the North West Company and Hudson's Bay Company entered the Flathead Valley and established trading posts north of Flathead Lake. Their commerce added a new demand for furs to existing regional connections. The name Hungry Horse arose much later; the history of this place before 1837 centres on Indigenous travel, land use and the arrival of the fur trade.
simp_chinese:
后来称羸马溪的地区位于蒙大拿西北部弗拉特黑德河与其南支汇流处。在水坝和配套聚落出现以前，这些山谷属于萨利什人、彭多雷人和库特奈人活动的广大地域。河流、越山通道与猎地相互连接，居民的生活范围远远超出这一处汇流点。

约1700年前后，萨利什人和彭多雷人通过邻近族群获得马匹。马扩大了季节活动范围，使居民更频繁探访盟友、缔结婚姻，也让前往野牛产地的旅行更加便利，同时加剧了袭扰与冲突。不断增加的马群需要牧草，人们运用火来维持相应草场。十九世纪初，西北公司和哈德逊湾公司进入弗拉特黑德河谷，在弗拉特黑德湖以北设置贸易站，将毛皮商业需求带入原有地区联系之中。羸马溪这一名称出现得更晚；1837年以前，此地的历史主要围绕原住民的旅行、土地利用，以及毛皮贸易逐渐进入山谷展开。

english: Hunguy belongs to the river country east of Khyargas Lake, on the western side of the Khangai highlands. The Khungui is among the rivers that traverse the broad valleys between the mountains, before the landscape opens towards the salt lakes of the Great Lakes Depression. Hills, steppe and dry basins lie close together here, giving the western Khangai a varied landscape despite its inland climate.
simp_chinese: 洪古位于哈尔嘎斯湖以东、杭爱高地西侧的河流地带。洪古河等河流穿过群山之间的宽谷，向西则逐渐展开为通往大湖盆地盐湖的开阔土地。丘陵、草原与干旱盆地在此相邻，使杭爱西部虽处内陆，景观仍十分多样。

english:
Huntingdon stands on the Great Ouse, where a medieval stone bridge links the town to Godmanchester. Its market and position on the road north made it a familiar stopping place for travellers. The old inns around its streets recall a town that served both the surrounding countryside and those passing through it on the long road north.

Oliver Cromwell was born here in 1599 and attended the grammar school in the former hospital of St John. During the Civil War he returned to raise a cavalry regiment, using the Falcon as his headquarters in 1643. The town's association with Cromwell was not its only connection to the conflict: King Charles I also stayed at the George before the battle of Naseby in 1645.
simp_chinese:
亨廷登坐落在大乌斯河畔，一座中世纪石桥将它与戈德曼彻斯特相连。市场和通往北方的道路使它成为旅人熟悉的歇脚处。街道上的古老客栈见证了这座城镇既服务周围乡村，也接待过路客商的历史。

奥利弗·克伦威尔于1599年出生于此，曾在圣约翰医院旧址内的文法学校求学。英国内战期间，他回乡组建骑兵团，1643年以猎鹰旅馆为总部。亨廷登与这场战争的联系并不止于克伦威尔：1645年纳斯比战役前，查理一世也曾下榻乔治旅馆。

english: Hunucmá lay within the Maya territory of Ah Canul in northwestern Yucatán. Its lands reached towards the Gulf coast, where the port of Sisal connected the interior with maritime routes. After Spanish conquest Hunucmá entered the encomienda system; one holder was Beatriz de Montejo in 1571. Sisal later served as an outlet for Mérida’s trade with Havana, giving the coastal district a place in the colonial Caribbean economy.
simp_chinese: 乌努克马位于尤卡坦西北部阿卡努尔玛雅领地。土地向墨西哥湾海岸延伸，西萨尔港在那里将内陆与海上航路连接起来。西班牙征服后，乌努克马纳入恩科米恩达制度，1571年的领有人之一是贝阿特丽斯·德·蒙特霍。西萨尔后来成为梅里达与哈瓦那贸易的出海口，使沿海地区参与殖民时期加勒比经济。

english: Hunyuan lies beneath Mount Heng, one of China’s sacred northern mountains. In a gorge south of the town, the Hanging Temple clings to a sheer cliff, its halls joined by narrow galleries and supported on beams set into the rock. Founded in the Northern Wei period, the temple was repaired under the Jin, Ming and Qing. Its precarious setting made it one of the mountain’s most celebrated sights.
simp_chinese: 浑源位于北岳恒山脚下。城南峡谷中，悬空寺贴着峭壁而建，殿阁以栈道相连，梁木嵌入岩壁支撑建筑。寺院始建于北魏，金、明、清时期均有修缮，险峻的选址使它成为恒山最著名的景观之一。

english: The Huolin River flows east from the Greater Khingan into the grasslands and wetlands of the western Songnen plain. On the low ground its waters spread through marshes rather than remaining in a single channel. The river feeds lakes and wet meadows, including the basin of Chagan Lake. In years of abundant water the lake could overflow toward the Nen. Reeds, shallow pools and pasture meet in this broad transition between the upland river and the plain.
simp_chinese: 霍林河发源于大兴安岭，向东流入松嫩平原西部的草地与湿地。河水在低洼处漫散，难以保持单一河道，滋养了查干湖等湖泊和湿草甸。丰水年份，查干湖的水还可向嫩江方向溢流。芦苇、浅水泡和牧草在此相接，构成山地河流进入平原后的广大过渡地带。

english:
Huolu stood near the eastern entrance to the Taihang routes, where traffic from Shanxi reached the North China Plain. The road east of the county town supported a chain of postal stopping places. In the early Ming, Yuecun, fifteen li east of Huolu, became a yipu, or postal station, as routes linking the capital with the provinces were restored.

Trade gathered around this transport infrastructure. Goods from Beijing and Tianjin met products coming from Shanxi and Shaanxi, alongside coastal salt and other merchandise. Shops and services spread beside the road, and Yuecun became a busy trading place within the county. This local example shows how Huolu's position at the mountain approaches could support commerce beyond the county seat itself, with official communications and private exchange sharing the same corridor.
simp_chinese:
获鹿位于太行山通道东口附近，山西方向的交通在此进入华北平原。县城以东的道路沿线设有递送官文的站点。明初恢复都城通向各地的驿道时，城东十五里的岳村升为驿铺。

贸易也围绕这些交通设施聚集起来。京津货物在此与山陕特产相遇，沿海食盐等商品同样沿路流通。店铺与服务行业分布于大道两旁，岳村成为获鹿县境内繁忙的交易地点。这个具体例子表明，太行山口的交通位置，使县城之外的聚落也能发展商业，官府通信与民间交换共用着一条通道。

english: The waters off Huon Atoll lie at the northwestern end of the Entrecasteaux reefs, far beyond New Caledonia's Grande Terre. A barrier reef some seventy-five kilometres long surrounds the atoll, broken by several passages and a wider opening to the northwest. In 1792 Antoine Bruny d'Entrecasteaux named Huon after his second-in-command, Jean-Michel Huon de Kermadec.
simp_chinese: 于翁环礁外的水域位于昂特卡斯托礁群西北端，远离新喀里多尼亚大地岛。一道约75公里长的堡礁环绕环礁，其间有数处水道，西北面还有一个较宽的缺口。1792年，安托万·布吕尼·当特尔卡斯托以副指挥官让-米歇尔·于翁·德凯尔马代克的姓氏为此地命名。

english: Huon Gulf cuts into the northeastern coast of New Guinea, between the Huon Peninsula and the mountainous mainland. In 1793 the expedition searching for La Pérouse sailed north through these waters towards Dampier Strait, surveying the coast on its way. The gulf takes its name from Jean-Michel Huon de Kermadec, who commanded the expedition's ship Espérance.
simp_chinese: 雨昂湾深入新几内亚东北海岸，位于雨昂半岛与多山的大陆之间。1793年，搜寻拉佩鲁兹的探险队经过这片水域向北驶往丹皮尔海峡，沿途测绘海岸。海湾以探险队“希望”号的指挥官让-米歇尔·于翁·德凯尔马代克命名。

english:
Huoqiu's county town guarded a contested corridor in the western Huai country. Its older defences were earthen walls without a surrounding moat. During the Ming Chenghua reign Magistrate Gao Sheng strengthened the earthworks. In 1492 Wang Qi added a moat and protective tiles. The approach of insurgents in 1512 prompted a more substantial rebuilding in brick and stone, supervised by Fengyang prefectural official Fang Bin. Magistrate Sun Cheng continued the work, which was completed eight years later.

Four gateways, each with a tower, organised access to the enclosed town. Subsequent magistrates repaired its battlements, towers and wall-top passages, but warfare at the end of the Ming destroyed the towers. In 1668 Magistrate Ji Zhigui repaired the battlements and provided watch buildings. Huoqiu's defences were therefore the product of successive officials and repeated demands on local labour, rather than a single construction campaign. The county gazetteer's account ties the changing fabric of the town to military danger and the practical responsibilities of local government.
simp_chinese:
霍邱县城扼守淮西的一条重要通道，旧有防御只是没有城濠的土墙。明成化年间，知县高升增筑土垣；1492年王启加覆瓦片并开挖城濠。1512年，流动武装逼近，官府组织改筑砖石城墙，由凤阳府通判方宾督工，知县孙诚继续经营，八年后完工。

城内外通过四座建有城楼的城门联系。后任知县继续修补雉堞、楼宇和城顶马道，但明末战火毁去诸楼。1668年，知县姬之簋修缮城堞，增设更楼。霍邱城防因此由多任官员接续营建，并非一次完工的工程。县志所记修筑、毁坏与重建，将城市具体形态同军事危险及地方政府职责紧密联系，也显示城防需要反复组织居民劳动和修缮资源。

english:
Huoshan was re-established as a county under Lu'an in 1494. The historical geographical account explains the decision through the difficult distance between Lu'an and Yingshan: the new county was placed at Gubu town. County formation thus addressed the practical problem of governing mountain country rather than marking the beginning of settlement there.

Tea connected this upland district to the imperial court. Much of the tea known by the regional name Lu'an was actually produced in Huoshan. Under the Ming tribute allocation, Huoshan supplied 253 jin out of a total of 300, with Lu'an forwarding the tea to the capital. In the Qing period the allocation increased; by 1684 Huoshan was responsible for 263 of the 300 tribute bags. These obligations gave cultivation and preparation an administrative dimension. Growers and processors supplied a product whose recorded name could refer to the superior jurisdiction, while county and prefectural arrangements determined how the tribute was assembled and delivered.
simp_chinese:
1494年，霍山重新设县，隶属六安。历史地理记述以六安、英山之间道路险远解释这一决定，新县治设在故埠镇。因此，设县回应的是山地治理的实际困难，并不代表当地聚落由此才开始出现。

茶叶将这一山地县份同宫廷连接起来。许多以六安地域名称闻名的茶，实际产于霍山。明代贡茶分担中，三百斤总额由霍山承办二百五十三斤，再由六安统一解送京城。清代额度增加，到1684年，三百袋贡茶中霍山承担二百六十三袋。这些义务赋予种植和加工以行政意义：农户与制茶者生产的货品，记载名称可能指向上级辖区，贡品如何汇集、运送则由州县制度安排。

english: Huoyi is an old town in the Fen River valley, later the seat of Huozhou. Its administrative compound centred on a great hall rebuilt in 1304 under the Yuan. Raised on a stone platform, the hall used massive timber beams and a broad interior to provide a setting for official audiences. Much of the compound was damaged in the turmoil at the end of the Yuan, but the hall survived; Ming and Qing officials repaired and added gates, pavilions and other buildings around it.
simp_chinese: 霍邑是汾河谷地的古城，后来成为霍州治所。州署以大堂为中心，大堂于元代1304年重建，立于高台之上，巨大的木梁支撑起宽敞的厅堂，供官员理事。元末战乱中州署多处受毁，大堂却得以保存；明清官员又在其周围修建、增建仪门、亭阁等建筑。

english: Huǒzhù is another recorded name for Huǒzhuó Fort, a stronghold of the Shuǐxī chiefs north of Qiánxī. Also called Zhuó City, it lay among the steep and defensible mountains of western Guizhou. During the rebellion of the Shuǐxī rulers against the Ming, the commander Wáng Sānshàn marched into Dàfāng in 1623. Shē Shèhuī and Ān Wèi burned their stronghold there and fled to Huǒzhuó. The fort thus offered refuge to the hereditary rulers when imperial armies entered the heart of their territory.
simp_chinese: 火著又作火灼堡，是黔西以北水西土司的据点，亦称火灼城，地处贵州西部险峻山地。明末水西土司反抗朝廷时，王三善于天启三年（1623年）率军直入大方，奢社辉、安位焚毁大方的巢寨，逃往火灼堡。帝国军队进入土司统治中心之际，这座险堡成为世袭首领退避之地。

english: Rita Blanca Creek begins in the high plains near the border of New Mexico and the Texas Panhandle. Its branches cross rolling ground and sandy dunes covered with bunch grasses before joining and flowing southeast. Farther downstream the creek meets the Canadian River. Along its course, brush and hardwoods grow beside the drainage, contrasting with the open grassland and dry arroyos of the surrounding plain.
simp_chinese: 丽塔布兰卡溪发源于新墨西哥与得克萨斯狭长地带交界附近的高平原。它的支流穿过起伏地面与生长丛生草的沙丘，汇合后向东南流去，在下游注入加拿大河。溪流沿岸生长着灌木和阔叶树，与周围开阔草地和干燥沟谷形成对照。

english:
Huraydah stood in Wadi Amd, one of the inland valleys of Hadramawt. Its reputation in the seventeenth century became closely tied to the scholar Umar bin Abd al-Rahman al-Attas, who made the town his home after travelling through the valley's settlements. Teaching and religious patronage connected this small place with the learned world of Tarim and other Hadrami centres.

Al-Attas's biographical tradition remembers him as a mediator among quarrelling tribes and a founder of village mosques. He travelled with students, helped establish places of worship and appointed teachers, bringing religious instruction into settlements beyond his own. After his death in 1661, his body was taken to Huraydah, where his disciple Ali Ba Ras later raised a dome above the grave. His descendants maintained the family's prominence through inherited learning and the office of mansab, a form of religious leadership important in Hadramawt. These lineages could mediate between rulers, tribes and villagers without simply becoming another branch of government. Huraydah's place in the valley therefore rested on a particular combination of settlement, teaching and saintly ancestry, sustained through family succession and the movement of students and visitors.
simp_chinese:
胡赖达坐落在哈德拉毛内陆的阿姆德河谷。十七世纪，学者欧麦尔·本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿塔斯游历诸村后定居于此，城镇声望逐渐与他紧密相连。讲学和宗教庇护使这处小镇接上塔里木及其他哈德拉毛学术中心。

阿塔斯的传记传统将他记为部族冲突的调解者和乡村清真寺的创建者。他带领学生往来村落，协助修建礼拜场所、委任教师，将宗教教育扩展到本镇之外。1661年去世后，遗体运回胡赖达安葬，弟子阿里·巴拉斯后来在墓上修建穹顶。他的后裔凭借代代相传的学问和曼萨布职位，维持家族在地方的影响。曼萨布是哈德拉毛重要的宗教领袖，能够在统治者、部族和村民之间居间调解。胡赖达在河谷中的地位，由定居生活、教学与圣者祖系共同塑造，并通过家族继承和学生、访客的往来延续。

english:
Huriel was a walled town and barony in the Bourbonnais near Montluçon. Its stone keep, later known as La Toque, and the church of Notre-Dame preserve the medieval relationship between fortified lordship and a Benedictine priory. The lordship passed to the de Brosse family through marriage in 1265, and they retained it into the later fifteenth century. Their history gave Huriel connections with the wider conflicts of the French kingdom.

Louis I de Brosse died at the battle of Poitiers in 1356. Jean I de Brosse, lord of Huriel and Boussac, entered royal service under Charles VII, became marshal of France in 1426 and participated in the campaigns alongside Joan of Arc in 1429. Later inheritance and partition carried Huriel through several other families before it passed to the Bartillats in 1673. Étienne Jehannot de Bartillat served Louis XIV as a royal secretary, councillor and guardian of the royal treasury. Thus the small barony's history joined local fortification and ecclesiastical life with military and financial service to successive French kings.
simp_chinese:
于列勒曾是蒙吕松附近波旁地区的设防城镇与男爵领。后来称为拉托克的石砌主楼，以及圣母教堂，保存着中世纪军事领主与本笃会修道院之间的联系。1265年，领地通过婚姻转入德布罗斯家族，后者一直掌握至十五世纪后期，将地方领主史同法国王国更广阔的战争连接起来。

路易一世·德布罗斯于1356年战死普瓦捷。于列勒与布萨克领主让一世·德布罗斯效力于查理七世，1426年成为法国元帅，并在1429年参加贞德所在的作战行动。其后，继承与分割使领地经过数个家族，1673年落入巴尔蒂亚家族手中。埃蒂安·让诺·德巴尔蒂亚曾任路易十四的王室秘书、顾问与王室金库主管。这一小型男爵领由此同时联系地方城防、教会生活，以及历代法国国王所需的军事和财政服务。

english: The Hurunui River flows east from the Southern Alps across the northern Canterbury plains. Its upper valley leads towards mountain passes used in Māori travel between the east and west coasts. Across these ranges, routes carried prized pounamu from western rivers to communities farther east and north.
simp_chinese: 胡鲁努伊河从南阿尔卑斯山东麓流出，穿过坎特伯雷北部平原。其上游河谷通向毛利人往来东西海岸所用的山口。越过这些山脉的道路将西部河流出产的珍贵绿玉运往更东和更北的社群。

english: Húsavík stands on Skjálfandi Bay on Iceland's northern coast. The Book of Settlements tells how Garðar Svavarsson sailed around Iceland, came into the bay and spent a winter on its shore. The houses he built gave the place its name, “bay of houses.” When Garðar departed, Náttfari remained on the other side of the bay with two companions. The sheltered inlet later became a landing place for foreign ships, bringing the northern coast into contact with the wider North Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 胡萨维克坐落在冰岛北岸的斯卡尔凡迪湾。《定居之书》讲述，加达尔·斯瓦瓦尔松环航冰岛后驶入海湾，在岸边度过一个冬天。他建造的房屋使此地得名「房屋之湾」。加达尔离开时，纳特法里与两名同伴留在海湾对岸。后来，受庇护的海湾成为外国船只的停泊地，将北岸与更广阔的北大西洋联系起来。

english: Husaynabad lies near Shantipur in the Bengal delta. Shantipur became known for its handwoven cloth and its association with the Vaishnava teacher Advaita Acharya. By the eighteenth century, its weavers made fine muslin as well as other cotton textiles. Merchants bought Shantipur cloth for markets beyond the town, including Calcutta.
simp_chinese: 侯赛纳巴德位于孟加拉三角洲，靠近尚蒂布尔。尚蒂布尔以手织布和毗湿奴派导师阿德韦塔·阿阇梨而闻名。到十八世纪，当地织工生产细薄的穆斯林布及其他棉织品，商人将布匹售往城外市场，其中包括加尔各答。

english:
Huseyinabad belongs to the inland Anatolian country around present-day Alaca, south of Çorum. The related name Hüseyinova denoted a district whose extent reached beyond the modern town. During the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries it formed part of the administrative landscape associated with Zile, within the Ottoman province of Rum. Before 1574, Hüseyinova had become a separate kaza. Its widest boundaries extended toward Sorgun and south of present-day Yozgat, linking the Alaca country to a much larger network of villages and revenue districts.

The Ottoman settlement also acquired religious buildings that outlasted changes in administrative boundaries. The Eski Mosque was built in 1763 by Ömer Osman Pasha. Together with the Hüseyin Gazi tomb, it forms part of Alaca's inherited Islamic landscape. The history of Huseyinabad thus includes both the changing jurisdiction of an Anatolian district and the patronage that gave its town a lasting place of communal worship.
simp_chinese:
侯赛因阿巴德位于乔鲁姆以南、今阿拉贾一带的安纳托利亚内陆。相关名称Hüseyinova曾指一个范围超过今城镇的行政区。十五至十六世纪，它属于奥斯曼鲁姆省内、与济莱相连的行政地域；1574年以前，Hüseyinova已经单独设为卡扎。其范围最广时向索尔贡及今约兹加特以南延伸，将阿拉贾一带与更大的村落和赋税辖区网络联系起来。

行政边界更动之外，奥斯曼时期的聚落也留下延续至后的宗教建筑。厄梅尔·奥斯曼帕夏于1763年创建老清真寺，与侯赛因加齐陵墓共同构成阿拉贾的伊斯兰历史景观。侯赛因阿巴德的历史由此兼有安纳托利亚行政辖区的变化，以及为城镇留下公共礼拜场所的地方赞助。

sources.title: 346403164 Yozgat'in Kuzey Ilcelerinin Osmanli Tasra Teskilati Icerisindeki Yeri XV ve XVI YuzyilThe Place of Northern Counties of Yozgat in Ottoman Local Administration XV and XVIth Centuries

english:
Huși lies among the vine-covered hills west of the Prut. Vineyards in the district are recorded before the town itself, whose name appears in a letter written by Stephen the Great in 1487. Stephen maintained a princely residence here and founded the Church of Saints Peter and Paul in 1495. Later Moldavian princes also stayed at Huși, drawn by its position and its wines.

In 1574 Prince Ioan Vodă assembled his camp at Huși before his campaign against the Ottomans. The town became an Orthodox episcopal see under Ieremia Movilă in 1598, with Stephen's church serving as its cathedral. The bishopric extended its care over lands east of the Prut as well as the country around Huși. Its court, vineyards and episcopal seat gave the town a place in both the government and religious life of Moldavia.
simp_chinese:
胡希位于普鲁特河以西的葡萄园丘陵之间。当地葡萄园的文书记载早于城镇本身；斯特凡大公于1487年写出的一封信中出现了胡希的名称。斯特凡在此设有亲王居所，并于1495年创建圣彼得与保罗教堂。后来的摩尔达维亚诸公也因这里的位置和美酒而在胡希驻留。

1574年，约安·沃德公爵在发动对奥斯曼的战役前于胡希设营。1598年耶雷米亚·莫维勒统治时，胡希成为东正教主教座，斯特凡的教堂成为座堂。主教区的管辖范围既包括胡希周边，也包括普鲁特河以东的土地。亲王行宫、葡萄园与主教座使这座城镇在摩尔达维亚的政务和宗教生活中占有一席之地。

english: Husinec lies on the Blanice in the foothills of the Bohemian Forest. Recorded in 1291 and raised to town status in 1359, it depended on trade along the Golden Trail, which carried salt and other goods across the mountains. The reformer Jan Hus was born here. After the Battle of White Mountain, many of his followers left Husinec for exile. The estate passed to the Schwarzenberg family in 1655.
simp_chinese: 胡西内茨位于波希米亚森林山麓的布拉尼采河畔。一二九一年这里已见于记载，一三五九年升为城镇；当地生计依靠黄金古道的贸易，盐和其他货物沿这条道路越过群山。宗教改革者扬·胡斯出生于此。白山战役后，许多追随他教义的居民离开胡西内茨，流亡国外。一六五五年，庄园归属施瓦岑贝格家族。

english: Husum stands on the North Frisian coast. When first mentioned as Husembro in 1252 it was inland, but the great storm flood of 1362 inundated the settlement and opened an inlet that became its harbour. A marketplace followed, and the population grew in the late fourteenth century. Husum acquired its first church in 1431 and town privileges in 1603. Like its neighbours on the low coast, it suffered badly in the floods of 1634 and 1717.
simp_chinese: 胡苏姆位于北弗里西亚海岸。1252年首次以胡森布罗之名见于文献时，它尚在内陆；1362年的大风暴潮淹没聚落，冲出一条后来成为港口的水道。市场随之建立，人口在十四世纪末增长。1431年，胡苏姆建起第一座教堂；1603年获得城市特权。与低洼海岸上的邻地一样，它在1634年和1717年的洪水中遭受重创。
